titles.title: 100 Days to Live
titles.description: When a serial killer abducts a young woman's fiancé, she must race against the clock to discover the identity of the killer and his motive.

titles.title: 13 Assassins
titles.description: In this remake of a 1963 film based on historical events, Shinzaemon Shimada leads a team of assassins in 19th-century Japan to eliminate the ruthless Lord Naritsugu Matsudaira, who is wreaking havoc against his own people. Hired secretly by a government official hoping to end Matsudaira's reign of terror, Shimada recruits the best samurai in Japan and then sets a trap for the lord's large contingent of faithful bodyguards.
When Earth's air becomes unbreathable, a message from the future sends a man on a dangerous mission to an unknown world to save the human race.

Officer Mike Chandler and a young civilian passenger find themselves unprepared and outgunned when fate puts them squarely in-the-crosshairs of a daring bank heist that is being carried out by a fearless team of highly trained and heavily armed men.

titles.title: 24 Hours to Live
titles.description: After a mercenary dies in a brutal firefight, a new regenerative surgery gives him a second chance at life and another shot at redemption.

titles.title: 5th Street
titles.description: Joe (Eric Arthur Martinez) vows revenge when his wife is killed in a gang shooting.

titles.title: 60 Days In
titles.description: Attempting to eliminate rival gangs, drugs and corruption at their facilities, chief jailers are enlisting members of the public to help; building on the tremendous success of previous undercover operations in Clark County, Ind., and Atlanta, "60 Days In" continues in Pinal County, Ariz., as law-abiding citizens live among the facility's general population for 60 days to help expose the root of the jail's many problems; filmed around the clock, A&E Network's hourlong docuseries provides a warts-and-all view of life behind bars, as the volunteers adapt to unfamiliar and terrifying surroundings.

episodes.title: Unusual Suspects
episodes.description: Seven volunteer civilians become undercover inmates in an effort to root out crime and corruption in Indiana's Clark County Jail.

episodes.title: First Timers
episodes.description: The experimental program begins; the first participants include a Marine, a police officer; a teacher and a stay-at-home mother.

episodes.title: Cell Shock
episodes.description: Maryum, the eldest daughter of boxer Muhammad Ali, joins the program and fits into F-pod effortlessly; the inmates grow suspicious of Robert; a mistake places Zac in peril; Barbra questions her commitment to the experiment.

episodes.title: Fight Face
episodes.description: Isaiah and Robert worry that their covers may be blown; Capt. Maples follows through with consequences for Robert makes a risky move; Zac hunts for illegal drug use in C-pod; Tami clashes with another inmate.

episodes.title: Friends Without Benefits
episodes.description: An unexpected call to court tests Zac's strength as an inmate; Barbra abandons a friendship with Tami in order to survive; a series of catastrophic mistakes endangers Jeff.

episodes.title: Full Inmate
episodes.description: The midway point of the experiment approaches; anger rises among the women of F-Pod; an inmate in C-Pod poses a danger to one of the men.

episodes.title: Pod Drama
episodes.description: Inmate Ricky attacks Jeff, jeopardizing the program; Zac and Isaiah move from the familiar confines of C-Pod to the more violent D-Pod; Barbra feels betrayed by her F-Pod bunkmates; Robert learns that he will return to general population.

episodes.title: Shakedown
episodes.description: The participants cross the halfway point of the experiment; the sheriff orders a raid due to increased tensions and drug activity in D-pod; the residents of F-pod worry about a contagious rash.

episodes.title: Alone for the Holidays
episodes.description: Thanksgiving presents new challenges and opportunities; one of the six remaining participants is pushed to the breaking point.

episodes.title: Institutionalized
episodes.description: The participants near the end of the experiment; the program is compromised when a woman in F-Pod is pushed over the edge; both men in D-Pod struggle to avoid serious criminal activity.

episodes.title: 11th Hour
episodes.description: The five remaining participants try to finish up their final days inside jail as pressure builds within the pods.

episodes.title: Exodus
episodes.description: Three participants remain in jail; Tami finds herself on the verge of a meltdown after a woman is released from F-Pod; a power struggle erupts when a boss is removed from D-Pod.

episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.description: All seven participants discuss their experiences; the women relive a contentious moment from inside jail; Tami confronts Robert about not taking the program seriously.

titles.title: A Bucket of Blood
titles.description: Nerdy Walter Paisley (Dick Miller), a maladroit busboy at a beatnik café who doesn't fit in with the cool scene around him, attempts to woo his beautiful co-worker, Carla (Barboura Morris), by making a bust of her. When his klutziness results in the death of his landlady's cat, he panics and hides its body under a layer of plaster. But when Carla and her friends enthuse over the resulting artwork, Walter decides to create some bigger and more elaborate pieces using the same artistic process.

titles.title: A Christmas Carol
titles.description: Scottish business tycoon Mr. Scrooge faces some big changes when a trio of atypical spirits pay him a visit at Christmastime.

titles.title: A Christmas Horror Story
titles.description: Not even Santa Claus is safe from the evil that descends on Bailey Downs, a small town that is suddenly plagued with malevolent spirits, zombie elves and Krampus -- the anti-Santa Claus.

titles.title: A Good Day to Be Black & Sexy
titles.description: In six vignettes from Los Angeles, the subject of sexuality and relationships within the black community shatters stereotypes about black sexuality.

titles.title: A Hijacking
titles.description: After Somali pirates hijack a Danish cargo ship and take the crew hostage, authorities in Copenhagen begin negotiations with the pirates to free the crew.

titles.title: A House on Fire
titles.description: Brilliant doctor and mother Deborah Green had the epitome of a picture-perfect life with two children, an adoring husband and a beautiful house in an opulent neighborhood.

titles.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
titles.description: In Wes Craven's classic slasher film, several Midwestern teenagers fall prey to Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), a disfigured midnight mangler who preys on the teenagers in their dreams -- which, in turn, kills them in reality. After investigating the phenomenon, Nancy (Heather Langenkamp) begins to suspect that a dark secret kept by her and her friends' parents may be the key to unraveling the mystery, but can Nancy and her boyfriend Glen (Johnny Depp) solve the puzzle before it's too late?

titles.title: A Royal Affair
titles.description: A young queen falls in love with her physician, and they start a revolution that changes their nation forever.

titles.title: A Savage Art: The Life & Cartoons of Pat Oliphant
titles.description: Political cartoonist Patrick Oliphant used his biting wit and drawing skills to take on presidents, popes and the powers that be.

titles.title: A Score to Settle
titles.description: Diagnosed with a fatal condition, a mob enforcer leaves prison after 19 years and plots a bloody course of revenge against his old gang.

titles.title: A War
titles.description: A Danish commander (Pilou Asbæk) faces a courtroom trial after a judgment call leads to the deaths of 11 civilians during the war in Afghanistan.

titles.title: Abandoned: Angelique's Isle
titles.description: Newlyweds are left stranded on Lake Superior's Isle Royale and struggle to survive a brutal winter.

titles.title: Abducted: The Carlina White Story
titles.description: Ann Pettway (Aunjanue Ellis) kidnaps an infant from a New York hospital and raises the child as her own daughter.

titles.title: Above Majestic
titles.description: A look at the origins, history, and conspiracies behind the Majestic 12, a clandestine group of military and corporate figureheads charged with reverse-engineering extraterrestrial technology.

titles.title: Acts of Violence
titles.description: Three Midwestern brothers, a crime lord, and an incorruptible cop are on a deadly collision course when the youngest brother's fiancée is kidnapped by human traffickers. To save her, the MacGregor boys call on their military training -- and the strength of family -- to fight the most important battle of their lives.

titles.title: Adriana Trigiani's Very Valentine
titles.description: A woman tries to save her family's wedding shoe business that is teetering on the brink of financial collapse.

titles.title: Aenigma
titles.description: The spirit of a comatose teen girl possesses the body of a newcomer to her girls boarding school to enact bloody revenge against the elitist, lingerie-clad coeds responsible for her condition.

titles.title: After the First 48
titles.description: Viewers are taken behind the scenes of real-life investigations as homicide detectives work in the critical first 48 hours of murder investigations.

episodes.title: Cassidy's Keys
episodes.description: When a mother of four goes missing, the Tulsa community rallies to help her family locate her; at trial, the prosecution argues for nothing less than life without Parole, but the credibility of a key witness gets dismantled by the defense.

episodes.title: No Road Home
episodes.description: After an unknown woman is gunned down on the side of a busy road, Gwinnett County Homicide struggles to identify a motive for the brutal, execution-style killing; at trial, the defendant takes the stand and reveals a shocking story that challenges the prosecution's version of events.

episodes.title: Mini-Bike Murder
episodes.description: When a man is gunned down in front of his Tulsa home, detectives and prosecutors must contend with a community's reluctance to interact with the police; when the suspect is finally brought into custody, his case hinges on whether this could be considered self-defense.

titles.title: Ai Weiwei: Never Sorry
titles.description: Alison Klayman documents the life and work of Chinese artist and activist Ai Weiwei. She showcases his artistic process as he prepares for a museum exhibition, his relationships with family members and his clashes with the government.

titles.title: Alaska State Troopers
titles.description: Patrolling America's largest state is the job of roughly 400 troopers in one of the toughest law enforcement agencies in the nation. Essentially, these cops say, nearly every Alaskan resident is armed and they know how to use their weapons, which makes any scenario a trooper encounters a potentially fatal one. Follow along as the "blue shirt" Alaskan State Troopers police the towns and villages, and the "brown shirt" Alaska Wildlife Troopers enforce regulations covering both commercial and sport fishing and hunting activities.

episodes.title: Winter Under Fire
episodes.description: It's below freezing, but crime is heating up; in Fairbanks, troopers respond to a man shot in the head by a masked gang; in a remote village, a violent attack on a neighbor ends with an arrest and remand to Bethel.

episodes.title: Cold and Reckless
episodes.description: In western Alaska, a village goes into lockdown after three armed and intoxicated men make threats; in the Mat-Su Valley, troopers pursue a reckless driver who may be drunk; in Fairbanks, CSU apprehends an escaped felon.

titles.title: Ali & Nino
titles.description: Ali Khan Shirvanshir, the male descendant of a royal Muslim family, falls in love with the beautiful Nino Kipiani, a Georgian princess who is Christian, while he is in Azerbaijan during World War I.

titles.title: Alien Autopsy: Fact or Fiction? Encore
titles.description: An encore edition with additional unaired footage of the controversial broadcast.

titles.title: Alien From The Abyss
titles.description: When activists attempt to expose an evil corporation dumping nuclear waste into the local volcano, they'll instead discover a giant rampaging alien.

titles.title: Alien Outpost
titles.description: A documentary film crew follows an elite team of soldiers following an alien invasion.

titles.title: Alien Trespass
titles.description: A spaceship crash in 1957 California leads to the escape of the Ghota, a murderous monster bent on destroying all life forms. In order to capture the Ghota, a benevolent alien named Urp takes over the body of an astronomer (Eric McCormack) and enlists the aid of a waitress named Tammy (Jenni Baird). But, unless Urp and Tammy are successful, mankind is doomed.

titles.title: Alive and Kicking
titles.description: After getting involved in swing dancing, some people are inspired to look inside themselves and make changes in their lives.

titles.title: All Cheerleaders Die
titles.description: A rebellious teen convinces the cheerleaders to take down the captain of the football team until a supernatural problem thrusts the young women into a new battle.

titles.title: All Hallows' Eve
titles.description: A babysitter finds a tape with three tales of terror on it, all linked to a murderous clown.

titles.title: All Hallows' Eve 2
titles.description: A woman finds a VHS tape that shows a series of gruesome tales.

titles.title: Alone Yet Not Alone
titles.description: Sisters are taken captive by natives in 1755 and struggle to retain their faith in difficult circumstances.

titles.title: America's Cutest Puppies
titles.description: Host Allen Lee Haff and a panel of judges travel the country in search of the cutest puppy they can find. Since everyone is positive their own puppy is the cutest, there's plenty of competition for the title!

episodes.description: The Los Angeles competition includes a terrier mix.

episodes.description: Puppies from Miami.

episodes.title: Chicago, Ill.
episodes.description: Puppies from Chicago.

episodes.description: The cutest puppy is chosen.

titles.title: America's Top Dog
titles.description: Police and civilian K-9 teams are tested on their speed, agility, scenting ability and teamwork by completing a series of tasks on obstacle courses designed by experts to mimic real-life challenges that the furry heroes face every day on the beat.

episodes.title: Raising the Woof
episodes.description: A veteran K-9 nicknamed The Wonder Mutt may be taken out by younger and hungrier competitors; his challengers include a police dog with hundreds of narcotics arrests and a trick dog with a talent for wagging his tail.

episodes.title: Small Dog, Big Bite
episodes.description: A fur missile, a veteran K-9 named Murphy and a small civilian underdog compete.

episodes.title: Young Dog, Old Tricks
episodes.description: The youngest dog in the competition sets a fur-ious pace; the more experienced dogs must take matters into their own paws or a youngster will bring home all the biscuits.

episodes.title: Country Boys and Rescue Dogs
episodes.description: Among the K-9 combatants are a dog who once took down a crossbow-wielding creep, a pooch whose trainer is allergic to him, and a team with inspiration on their side.

episodes.title: Are You Not Entertained?
episodes.description: It's raining cats and dogs, but the K-9 combatants show their gladiatorial spirit, battling through bad weather and tricky tunnels right down to the final seconds.

episodes.title: The Battle of the Garden State
episodes.description: With some of the most decorated doggies ever to set paw on the K-9 combine, records may be broken.

episodes.title: Young Pups and Silver Foxes
episodes.description: The lineup raises burning questions such as if old can defeat young and if skill can beat experience.

episodes.title: Gaga for Doggles
episodes.description: A Doggle-wearing K-9 faces some tough competition including a Connecticut K-9 who's ready to declare war and a cancer-surviving civilian underdog named Bruce.

episodes.title: It Ain't Over Until There's a Top Dog
episodes.description: Six winning K-9s and one champion underdog battle it out for $25,000 and the bragging rights for the ultimate title of "America's Top Dog."

episodes.title: Premiere Pooches
episodes.description: A Hollywood superstar pup takes on a bird hunter; a talented pit bull goes up against a punk rock border poo; two K9s named after movie villains face off.

episodes.title: Cute but Means Business
episodes.description: A 17-pound underdog takes on a protective Czech shepherd; two K9s from the same department duke it out; a therapy dog goes against the smallest dog of the season; in the Doghouse, one dog gets disqualified for the first time in Top Dog history.

episodes.title: Pulling a Fast One
episodes.description: A speedy pit bull takes on a Belgian Malinois that trains K9s; a rebellious schnauzer goes up against a brainy border collie; a grill-sporting K9 challenges a friendly female K9.

episodes.title: Beauty, Brains and Bark
episodes.description: A female K9 aims to dominate her male opponent; three Belgian Malinois give their handlers a workout; and an old contender shows up to prove that age is nothing but a number.

episodes.title: Tricks, Trials and Takedowns
episodes.description: In a series of head-to-head matchups, an Ibizan hound won't get tied up by the rules, a fearless K-9 unleashes its inner avenger, and a detective working dog is determined to have the last bite.

episodes.title: The Tall, the Brave and the Engaged
episodes.description: A flying disc-catching pro takes on a resilient demo dog; a female K-9 goes up against the tallest dog of the season; an engaged couple compete against each other with their sibling terriers; only one dog will move on to the finale.

episodes.title: The Comeback Dogs
episodes.description: Second place left them hungry for a win, so these top-notch competitors are back to battle it out for the last remaining spot in the season's grand finale; it's working dogs versus underdogs, competing for one last chance.

episodes.title: Title Match to Top Them All
episodes.description: It's a battle between the best of the best when the season's seven winning teams face off in the final showdown.

titles.title: Amityville: The Awakening
titles.description: A mother moves with her three children into the notorious, supposedly haunted Amityville house to try using its dark powers to cure her comatose son.

titles.title: An American Werewolf in London
titles.description: David (David Naughton) and Jack (Griffin Dunne), two American college students, are backpacking through Britain when a large wolf attacks them. David survives with a bite, but Jack is brutally killed. As David heals in the hospital, he's plagued by violent nightmares of his mutilated friend, who warns David that he is becoming a werewolf. When David discovers the horrible truth, he contemplates committing suicide before the next full moon causes him to transform from man to murderous beast.

titles.title: An Officer and a Murderer
titles.description: A tenacious detective from a small-town police department investigates Col. Russell Williams (Gary Cole) for murder and assault.

titles.title: And Baby Will Fall
titles.description: A man and his wife become prime suspects when a pregnant woman disappears while attending their yard sale.

titles.title: Anger Management
titles.description: Following his tumultuous, and highly publicized, departure from hit sitcom "Two and a Half Men," Charlie Sheen returns to series television in this comedy loosely based on the 2003 Adam Sandler film "Anger Management." Sheen stars as Charlie, a former professional baseball player whose career was ended by an injury caused by his anger issues. Charlie went back to school after his playing career ended and now works as a therapist who specializes in anger management. In addition to weekly sessions with his primary group of patients, Charlie does pro bono counseling for a group of inmates at a state prison. Even though he now helps others control their anger problems, Charlie continues to battle his own anger issues. Complicating his life are his relationships with his own therapist -- his ex-wife, whose positive outlook frustrates Charlie -- and his teenage daughter, who has obsessive-compulsive disorder.
categories: Shows to Save and Watch Later

episodes.title: Charlie Goes Back to Therapy
episodes.description: Charlie, a baseball player with anger issues decides to return to therapy after a bad run-in with his ex-wife's new boyfriend.

episodes.title: Charlie and the Slumpbuster
episodes.description: The new Charlie deals with a ghost from his baseball-playing days when an unattractive woman he slept with shows up as a new patient.

episodes.title: Charlie Tries Sleep Deprivation
episodes.description: Charlie challenges his group to do 36 hours of sleep-deprivation therapy so that their inhibitions come down.

episodes.title: Charlie and Kate Battle Over a Patient
episodes.description: A long-standing rivalry over who's a better therapist leads to Kate stealing one of Charlie's group patients.

episodes.title: Charlie Proves Therapy Is Legit
episodes.description: Charlie falls for Jen's hot new business partner only to find she thinks therapy is a scam; Patrick asks Charlie to counsel the angry ghost of his mother.

episodes.title: Charlie Dates Kate's Patient
episodes.description: Charlie starts covertly dating a brilliant coffee-shop barista who is a patient of Kate's; Charlie encourages his therapy group to call each other when facing moments of weakness.

episodes.title: Charlie's Patient Gets Out of Jail
episodes.description: One of Charlie's patients from his prison anger therapy group shows up on his doorstep; Jennifer gets back at Charlie by dating an ex-con.

episodes.title: Charlie Outs a Patient
episodes.description: Charlie evaluates the depth of his involvement in his patient's lives when he accidentally helps his patient hook up with a crazy woman.

episodes.title: Charlie's Dad Visits
episodes.description: Charlie gets an unexpected visit from his hypercritical father; Charlie attempts to help Lacey with road rage.

episodes.title: Charlie Gets Romantic
episodes.description: Charlie and Kate's sexual episode leads to complications when he innocently asks her to a movie; Sam kisses a girl and the picture winds up on a social media site.

titles.title: Anna Nicole
titles.description: Voluptuous beauty Anna Nicole Smith (Agnes Bruckner) marries an elderly millionaire (Martin Landau) and poses for Playboy, but after her husband's death, her excessive drinking, pill-popping and weight fluctuations take their toll.

titles.title: Annie Oakley
titles.description: The suspenseful tales of the Old West's famous sharpshooter.

episodes.title: Gunplay
episodes.description: An outlaw (Myron Healey) poses as a marshal in an attempt to free his brother from jail. With Paul McGuire, Gail Davis.

episodes.title: The Dude Stagecoach
episodes.description: Annie (Gail Davis) challenges a mine owner's spoiled rich daughter (Maura Murphy) to a race. With Tom London.

episodes.title: Annie Calls Her Shots
episodes.description: After being framed and serving seven years in prison, a bitter man (Harry Lauter) returns to town. With Gail Davis.

episodes.title: Valley of the Shadows
episodes.description: Annie, Lofty and Tagg (Gail Davis, Brad Johnson, Jimmy Hawkins) step in when a store owner is killed and his young daughter is left blind. With Judy Nugent.

episodes.title: Annie and the Lily Maid
episodes.description: Annie becomes suspicious of Elaine Forbes, the seemingly innocent niece of a recently deceased rancher.

episodes.title: The Hardrock Trail
episodes.description: Outlaw Vic Carver (Robert B. Williams) seeks revenge against Sheriff MacTavish (Kenneth MacDonald) for sending him to jail.

episodes.title: Justice Guns
episodes.description: Annie (Gail Davis) races to save her retired mentor (Stanley Andrews) from a suicide mission with a merciless young gunman. With Ric Vallin.

episodes.title: Sharpshooting Annie
episodes.description: Annie and Tagg (Gail Davis, Jimmy Hawkins) track a masked bandit who holds up an acrobatic troupe. With Brad Johnson.

episodes.title: Annie Makes a Marriage
episodes.description: Annie (Gail Davis) plays matchmaker for her friend Bess Murdock (Nancy Hale). With Don Kennedy, Brad Johnson.

episodes.title: Outlaw Mesa
episodes.description: Annie relies on Tagg's ability as a ventriloquist to save an innocent stage driver from angry townspeople.

episodes.title: The Runaways
episodes.description: Tagg (Jimmy Hawkins) and his friend Billy (Stuffy Singer) run away to a ghost town inhabited by an outlaw gang. With Gail Davis.

episodes.title: The Iron Smoke-Wagon
episodes.description: Annie uses the town's new fire engine to capture some bank robbers who are hiding in a shack near town.

episodes.title: Trigger Twins
episodes.description: Annie (Gail Davis) investigates when a young dance teacher has a seemingly ironclad alibi for a series of crimes. With Lou Smith, Sue Smith.

episodes.title: Diablo Doctor
episodes.description: A young doctor (David Alpert) faces a moral dilemma when asked to treat the escaped convict (Gregg Barton) who killed his father (Stanley Andrews).

episodes.title: Hard Luck Ranch
episodes.description: An injured rancher summons all his strength to help Annie and Lofty when outlaws hold his wife hostage.

episodes.title: Thunder Hill
episodes.description: Annie (Gail Davis) looks beyond local gossip to uncover a plot against a struggling family. With Stanley Andrews, Bill Henry.

episodes.title: Sure-Shot Annie
episodes.description: Annie (Gail Davis) attempts to prove a beautiful woman (Eve Miller) is involved in two bank robberies. With Rick Vallin.

episodes.title: The Troubleshooter
episodes.description: An outlaw keeps his convict brother from going straight.

episodes.title: Powder Rock Stampede
episodes.description: Annie (Gail Davis) has hopes of acquiring a prime piece of land in a newly opened territory. With Douglas Kennedy, James Griffith.

episodes.title: Annie and the Twisted Trails
episodes.description: Annie (Gail Davis) becomes involved in a controversy between a teen (Carolyn Craig) and her overly possessive father (Ewing Mitchell).

episodes.title: The Robin Hood Kid
episodes.description: Annie (Gail Davis) and Lofty (Brad Johnson) try to discover the identity of a masked man known as the Robin Hood Kid (Tyler MacDuff).

episodes.title: Indian Justice
episodes.description: Annie (Gail Davis) and Lofty (Brad Johnson) step in when a young cavalry officer (Harry Lauter) is framed for murder.

episodes.title: Showdown at Diablo
episodes.description: Lofty (Brad Johnson) faces a moral dilemma when confronted with a notorious outlaw who once saved his life. With Lane Bradford, Bill Henry.

episodes.title: Renegade's Return
episodes.description: A notorious outlaw arrives during an election to shed a bad light on his brother, an honest lawyer running for office.

episodes.title: Outlaw Brand
episodes.description: The son (Stuffy Singer) of a slain deputy has suspicions about his caregiver (Leonard Penn), a reformed outlaw.

episodes.title: The Reckless Press
episodes.description: Annie, Lofty and Tagg (Gail Davis, Brad Johnson, Jimmy Hawkins) attend a friend's wedding and investigate the best man's murder.

episodes.title: Flint and Steel
episodes.description: Annie (Gail Davis) uncovers a scheme involving honest ranchers, a band of greedy crooks and a valuable oil pool. With Monte Blue, Jim Bannon.

episodes.title: Tagg Oakley, Sheriff
episodes.description: A contractor agrees to deliver government gunpowder to Geronimo.

episodes.title: The Waco Kid
episodes.description: Annie's childhood sweetheart has become an outlaw, the Waco Kid.

episodes.title: The Saga of Clement O'Toole
episodes.description: A clumsy fortune-hunter doubles for a notorious gunfighter.

titles.title: Answer This!
titles.description: Academics finally get a chance to drink beer and hit on women when they enter a trivia tournament.

titles.title: Antiviral
titles.description: Syd sells illegal samples of live viruses from sick celebrities to piracy groups, smuggling them in his own body. He becomes infected with the disease that kills Hannah Geist. He must unravel the mystery of her death before he suffers the same fate.

titles.title: Apocalypse Now Redux
titles.description: Secret ops assassin Captain Willard (Martin Sheen) is sent on a mission up a river during the Vietnam War to "terminate with extreme prejudice" the errant Colonel Kurtz (Marlon Brando). In addition to being re-edited with the new footage, the film has been completely restored, converted to digital, and reprinted by dye-transfer, improving color reproduction.

titles.title: Arsenal
titles.description: The Lindel brothers, Mikey and JP, only had each other to rely on growing up. As adults, JP finds success as the owner of a construction company, and Mikey becomes a small-time mobster. When Mikey is kidnapped and held for a ransom by ruthless crime boss Eddie, JP turns to the brothers' old pal Sal, who is a plain clothes detective, for help. JP must risk everything and unleash his vengeance against King's relentless army of gangsters to rescue his brother.

titles.title: Ash and Bone
titles.description: A destructive teen keeps finding her way into trouble, so her father moves her to a small town. But this small town has a deadly secret.

titles.title: Ash vs Evil Dead
titles.description: Ash is baaaack! Bruce Campbell reprises his "Evil Dead" film role as heroic, chainsaw-handed monster fighter Ash Williams, now an aging lothario who has successfully avoided responsibility, maturity and heinous villains for the past 30 years. Constantly peering over his shoulder, Ash somehow knew that the Evil Dead would return for him. That day arrives when Ash commits an act of carelessness, unleashing a Deadite plague that threatens to destroy mankind. Co-starring in the half-hour series are Lucy Lawless as mysterious Ruby; Ray Santiago as Ash's loyal sidekick, Pablo Simon Bolivar; and Dana DeLorenzo as moody wild child Kelly Maxwell.

episodes.title: El Jefe
episodes.description: Three decades of relative calm are shattered when an act of stoned stupidity unleashes Deadite mayhem back into the life of braggart Ash Williams.

titles.title: Ask Me to Dance
titles.description: Jack and Jill see a fortune-teller who predicts they will meet the love of their lives before the end of the year, which happens to be five days away. The countdown begins as they both go on a series of horrible and hilarious dates, each worse than the next. With a string of missed encounters and New Year's Eve approaching, Jack and Jill seem destined to fall in love with each other.

titles.title: Awake
titles.description: While undergoing surgery, a young man (Hayden Christensen) experiences intraoperative awareness. He becomes fully alert -- but paralyzed -- and therefore cannot tell his doctors that he is not sedated and is enduring the whole process. Meanwhile, his wife (Jessica Alba) wrestles with demons of her own while her husband suffers through his ordeal.

titles.title: Bad Tutor
titles.description: Single mom Karen is focused on getting daughter Emily graduated and off to college. When she hires Devin to boost Emily's grades, the tutor becomes dangerously obsessed.

titles.title: Badland
titles.description: Gunslinging detective Matthias Breecher is hired by one of the first African American senators to track down the worst of the Confederate war criminals. As he traverses the titular hellish badlands seeking justice, his resolve is tested when he meets a determined pioneer woman who is far more than she seems.

titles.title: Band Aid
titles.description: Anna and Ben can't stop fighting. Advised by their therapist to try and work through their grief unconventionally, they are reminded of their shared love of music. In a last-ditch effort to save their marriage, they decide to turn all of their fights into songs, and with the help of their neighbor, Dave, they start a band.

titles.title: Bandslam
titles.description: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

titles.title: Bart Got a Room
titles.description: Everyone is searching for love in director Brian Hecker's semi-autobiographical story. Danny Stein, a high school senior at the bottom of the social food chain, needs a prom date. As a cause of anxiety for Danny, Bart Beeber, the nerdiest guy in school, has already found a date -- and booked a hotel room. At the same time, Danny's divorced parents are both looking for relationships again.

titles.title: Battle of the Bulge: Winter War
titles.description: Lt. Cappa and his platoon defend a field hospital just behind the frontline near Lanzerath, Belgium, and hope to keep supplies out of German hands. They grow suspicious of a squad of American MPs with exaggerated accents.

titles.title: Battle of the Bulge: Wunderland
titles.description: On Christmas day in 1944, the Germans make one final push against the attacking allied armies in the Western Hemisphere. Lt. Robert Capa and his platoon of 2nd Infantry Division soldiers are ordered to hold a vital road junction against the German aggressors. Somehow, Capa and his men must find the strength to stand against their enemy in the fight known as "The Battle of the Bulge."

titles.title: Battle Royale
titles.description: 42 9th graders are sent to a deserted island. They are given a map, food, and various weapons. An explosive collar is fitted around their neck. If they break a rule, the collar explodes. Their mission: kill each other and be the last one standing. The last survivor is allowed to leave the island. If there is more than one survivor, the collars explode and kill them all.

titles.title: Battle Royale II: Requiem
titles.description: Teenagers are shackled together in pairs and sent on a violent mission to kill a terrorist leader (Tatsuya Fujiwara) and his followers.

titles.title: Before We Go
titles.description: A chance encounter between two strangers (Chris Evans, Alice Eve) in Grand Central Terminal sparks a life-changing, nighttime sojourn through New York City.

titles.title: Begin Again
titles.description: Gretta and her songwriting partner/lover Dave head for New York when he lands a record deal with a major label. However, Gretta is suddenly left on her own when Dave gives in to the temptations that come with his newfound success. Things take a turn for the better for her when Dan, a disgraced record executive, discovers Gretta performing in a club. A mutually life-changing bond forms between the pair as they work together on Gretta's first album.

titles.title: Being Human
titles.description: Deciding to turn over a new leaf, a group of friends who also happen to be vampires and werewolves move into a house together, only to find that it is haunted by ghosts of people who have been killed under mysterious circumstances. As they deal with the challenges of being supernatural creatures, their desire to be human bonds them.

episodes.title: Flotsom and Jetsom
episodes.description: While Mitchell struggles with his growing lust for blood, Annie has a harder time dealing with her emotions than she thought when she comes face-to-face with someone from her past.

episodes.title: Tully
episodes.description: Another werewolf befriends George and begins to take him under his wing.

episodes.title: Where the Wild Things Are
episodes.description: Mitchell tries to restrain his taste for blood; Annie deals with her past; George needs a new place to transform.

episodes.title: Cure and Contagion
episodes.description: Vampire society is about to implode following the death of Herrick; George seems like a changed man; Nina reveals a shocking secret.

episodes.title: Lia
episodes.description: The net is closing in on Mitchell; Annie is trapped in purgatory; George and Nina battle domestic challenges.

episodes.title: The Longest Day
episodes.description: The housemates must make a decision about Herrick.

episodes.title: The Graveyard Shift
episodes.description: Hal reluctantly works at the café with Tom, but his encounter with the vampires introduces an alternative proposition; Annie's determination to safeguard the baby drives her to contemplate extreme measures.

episodes.title: The War Child
episodes.description: The Old Ones have arrived and are intent on taking over the world by force; Cutler has other plans, but when they go awry, his revenge on his own kind is plotted.

episodes.title: The Trinity
episodes.description: Ghost Alex adjusts to life after death with werewolf Tom and vampire Hal; meeting poisonous pensioner Captain Hatch, behind whose foul exterior lurks an ancient evil.

titles.title: Belly Timber
titles.description: John McCormick makes a settlement along White River. However, his peace is soon disturbed by an evil entity.

titles.title: Benders
titles.description: One can discern hockey's greatness live or by watching a game on TV, but the sport's ultimate attractions -- speed, skill, toughness, heart -- are best felt by playing it. For Paul Rosenberg and his buddies, the thrill of lacing the skates and hitting the ice to compete for local men's team The Chubbys is their bonding agent, strong enough that it's turned irrational and caused Paul all sorts of issues with his wife, Karen. Meanwhile, along for the ride are Paul's best friends Anthony, the charmer who schemes his way through life; Dicky, the wealthy hedge fund manager whose answer to everything is in his wallet; and Sebalos, the slacker on a misguided search for his purpose.

episodes.title: Choke
episodes.description: Paul's grandfather puts him in a difficult position and makes him an offer he can't refuse; Anthony asks his uncle for his help.

episodes.title: Wake 'Em Up
episodes.description: The guys gain a team sponsor while Paul tries to reschedule a family commitment; Karen shares a questionable new joke with her acupuncturist.

episodes.title: Prodigal Son
episodes.description: Paul, Sebalos and Dickie clean up their act to try to one-up Anthony in a higher hockey division; Karen hosts a book club.

episodes.title: Fight Club
episodes.description: Paul and Karen take a sick day after they both get the chicken pox but the Chubbys decide to crash it and teach Paul how to deal with a disruptive neighbor.

episodes.title: The Sport of Kings
episodes.description: The Chubbys get a new goalie causing an issue among the team; the team is presented with a promising new business venture.

episodes.title: Secrets and Lies
episodes.description: Paul finds out Karen has a secret journal; after doing a favor for Vito, Sebalos and Anthony receive a few massages; Sebalos is attracted to a masseuse.

episodes.title: Nice Day for a Boat Ride
episodes.description: Karen returns from a business trip in Las Vegas with a couple of surprises for Paul; Anthony tries to tune out the noise of a new relationship.

episodes.title: California Here We Come
episodes.description: Paul and Karen discuss the future after Karen receives an exciting new job offer; the Chubbys host a wild farewell party.

titles.title: Berlin, I Love You
titles.description: Ten stories of love, compassion, redemption and acceptance set against the vivid backdrop of Berlin.

titles.title: Bernie the Dolphin
titles.description: A brother and sister befriend a badly sunburned dolphin that has been separated from its family, uncovering a secret plan that could destroy the beach and their new friend's home.

titles.title: Bernie the Dolphin 2
titles.description: The kids are thrilled that Bernie has come back. But so has their old enemy Winston, who's about to kidnap the talented dolphin. Kevin and Holly must rescue their splashy friend before it's too late.

titles.title: Best Worst Movie
titles.description: This documentary reviews the making of the film "Troll 2" from the perspective of its former child actor star, Michael Stephenson. In 1989, a group of actors and an Italian production crew join forces to produce a slice of unwitting cinematic history. Stephenson and those involved with the ill-fated sequel tell the story of Italian director Claudio Fragasso's B-movie classic, among them the Alabama dentist who became a cult star because of his famous, immortal line.

titles.title: Betty & Coretta
titles.description: After the assassinations of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. and Malcolm X, their widows, Coretta Scott King and Betty Shabazz, continue to raise their children and fight for the cause.

titles.title: Beware: Children at Play
titles.description: A disturbed teen brainwashes children, turning them into cannibalistic zombies.

titles.title: Beyond Existence
titles.description: To save the human race, a government agent must protect a professor with a deadly secret from an immortal bounty hunter.

titles.title: Beyond the Law
titles.description: A former mobster turned businessman and a police detective must contend with a dirty ex-cop looking to bring the killer of his son to justice.

titles.title: Big Driver
titles.description: With her mind shattered, a novelist seeks revenge on the man who brutally assaulted her on a desolate New England road.

titles.title: Bitterbrush
titles.description: In the remote and rugged mountains of the American West, two young women contemplate the future as they work alone herding cattle.

titles.title: BKO: Bangkok Knockout
titles.description: Friends in a fight club battle assassins after their pals are kidnapped.

titles.title: Black Bear
titles.description: A filmmaker plays a calculated game of desire and jealousy in pursuit of a work of art that blurs the boundaries between autobiography and invention.

titles.title: Black Roses
titles.description: A small-town teacher (John Martin) saves teenage souls from a heavy-metal rocker (Sal Viviano) and his band from hell.

titles.title: Black Sails
titles.description: A prequel to the classic Robert Louis Stevenson novel "Treasure Island," "Black Sails" is a pirate adventure that centers on the tales of Captain Flint, who has a reputation throughout the West Indies as being the most brilliant, most feared of all the Golden Age pirates. It's 1715, and as Flint fights for the survival of New Providence Island -- a debauched paradise teeming with pirates, prostitutes, thieves and fortune seekers -- in the wake of threats from British and Spanish forces, he aligns himself with Eleanor Guthrie, daughter of the local kingpin, to hunt the ultimate prize and ensure his people's survival. But standing in the way are rival captains, Eleanor's intrusive father, and perhaps the bigger obstacle of all: John Silver, a young, fast-talking, authority-flouting sailor recently added to Flint's crew.

episodes.title: I.
episodes.description: Pirate Capt. Flint faces a mutiny from his own crew; John Silver hides something of great value; Eleanor keeps order on New Providence as the Royal Navy grows stronger.

titles.title: Black Snow
titles.description: Detective James Cormack works to solve cold cases, uncovering long-buried secrets along the way; at the same time, he's haunted by his personal quest to find his younger brother, who vanished when they were children.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.description: When a time capsule is opened and a secret is unearthed, Detective James Cormack is put on the trail of a murderer from a 1994 case that was never solved.

episodes.title: Predators
episodes.description: After the discovery of Isabel's hair, those involved with the time capsule project from 1994 are at the forefront of Cormack's investigation. He makes a huge discovery when the blue car seen following Isabel on the night of the murder shows up in the time capsule documentary. Hazel, Isabel's sister, is unsure if she should trust Cormack or help him with the case, as she's harboring a past secret of her own that threatens to resurface.

episodes.title: Ezekiel
episodes.description: Rumors spread around Ashford, and suspicion lands on Joe, Isabel's father; as Cormack interviews the time capsule kids, more secrets emerge.

episodes.title: The Lost Boys
episodes.description: Cormack investigates the link between Ezekiel's missing cousins. "The lost boys," and Isabel's murder as a new person comes forward with evidence.

episodes.title: Sugar Sugar
episodes.description: Turner concludes that Billy's death was an accident, but Cormack suspects foul play and believes it's linked to the missing workers and Isabel's murder.

episodes.title: Spirits Speak
episodes.description: Cormack tries to track Anton down to question him, but he's disappeared, and when Cormack and Hazel discover that Kalana is also missing, they fear the worst.

titles.title: Blades
titles.description: A peaceful country club becomes the hunting ground for a demonically possessed lawnmower with a taste for human flesh.

titles.title: Bling It On
titles.description: Follow the luxurious daily lives of the rich and famous.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: A day in the life of the rich and famous as they shop their way through ultra-expensive stores to buy ultra-expensive things.

titles.title: Blood Hook
titles.description: A killer tries to snag a Wisconsin teen and his friends during a "Muskie Madness" fishing contest.

titles.title: Blood on the Crown
titles.description: Right after World War I in 1919, citizens of Malta rise up to seek independence from British rule, but the army quashes the riots, the government covers up the bloodbath, and more than 100 Maltese are jailed.

titles.title: Bloody Homecoming
titles.description: Three years after a classmate's death, high-school seniors become the victims of a dark and deadly force.

titles.title: Blue Is the Warmest Color
titles.description: A French teen (Adèle Exarchopoulos) forms a deep emotional and sexual connection with an older art student (Léa Seydoux) she met in a lesbian bar.

titles.title: Blue Lagoon: The Awakening
titles.description: Stranded on a tropical island, two high-school students (Brenton Thwaites, Indiana Evans) fall in love while relying on each other to survive.

titles.title: Bond of Silence
titles.description: Katy McIntosh (Kim Raver) seeks answers when her husband dies while trying to subdue teenage partygoers.

titles.title: Bone Tomahawk
titles.description: In the Old West, a sheriff (Kurt Russell), his deputy (Richard Jenkins), a gunslinger (Matthew Fox), and a cowboy (Patrick Wilson) embark on a mission to rescue three people from a savage group of cave dwellers.

titles.title: Bonnie & Clyde vs. Dracula
titles.description: Gangsters and vampires collide in a gory battle.

titles.title: Boogeyman
titles.description: As a young boy, Tim (Aaron Murphy) witnesses the horrifying event of his father (Charles Mesure) being dragged away by the boogeyman. Despite the reassurances of his mother (Lucy Lawless) that the boogeyman is not real, he is never the same afterward. Years later, Tim (Barry Watson) manages to create a normal life for himself -- though he lives without closets and keeps his mattress on the floor. But when he learns of his mother's death, Tim must return home to face his childhood trauma.

titles.title: Boon
titles.description: Mercenary Nick Boon is trying to atone for his life as an enforcer for a ruthless syndicate. Running from his past, Boon moves to a remote area in the Pacific Northwest, where he meets a struggling widow and her son. When he finds the pair living in fear of a criminal kingpin, Boon realizes the only way to protect them is to do what he does best.

titles.title: Boss Moves with Rasheeda
titles.description: Whether Rasheeda is showing her Pressed boutique, or cooking up new cuisines at Frost Bistro, she's always in boss mode planning her next big move.

episodes.title: Balancing Like a Boss
episodes.description: Being a boss requires a solid physical state of being; Rasheeda works out with her longtime friend and fellow female boss, Toya Johnson, as they talk about the importance of nurturing one's mind and body all while balancing a demanding life.

episodes.title: Securing the Legacy
episodes.description: Rasheeda offers tips and insights, and to add to the fun, she's joined by friends, Kandi Burruss and her husband, Todd as they discuss legacy planning and securing assets for generations to come.

episodes.title: Boss Marketing Magic
episodes.description: Rasheeda invites her friend and marketing guru, Kimberley Blackwell, to discuss how to make the most of one's business, the four P's of marketing and more.

episodes.title: Getting Real With Real Estate
episodes.description: When it comes to real estate, one should have an open mind; Rasheeda and her husband, Kirk, are sharing what they've learned when it comes to looking for property; Virgil Gordon joins them to share his tips on how to start investing in real estate.

episodes.title: Triumph
episodes.description: A look inside Rasheeda's home recording studio as she shares the lessons learned as a music artist and advice for aspiring new artists today; joined by her friend and producer, DJ Jazze Pha, Rasheeda shares what led her to triumph in her career.

episodes.title: Boss Building Blocks
episodes.description: Rasheeda discusses the importance of discipline and taking care of your body so you can achieve your goals; there's also a visit from her good friend and celebrity wellness expert, Eboni Elektra.

episodes.title: Designing the Dream
episodes.description: Rasheeda designs her dream homes like a boss; she is joined by interior designer Sharie Reid to share easy tips on decorating spaces; Rasheeda gives an exclusive look inside her gorgeous ranch house.

titles.title: Boyhood
titles.description: The joys and pitfalls of growing up are seen through the eyes of a child named Mason (Ellar Coltrane), his parents (Patricia Arquette, Ethan Hawke) and his sister (Lorelei Linklater). Vignettes, filmed with the same cast over the course of 12 years, capture family meals, road trips, birthday parties, graduations and other important milestones. Songs from Coldplay, Arcade Fire and other artists capture the time period. Directed by Richard Linklater.

titles.title: Brawl in Cell Block 99
titles.description: A former boxer loses his job as an auto mechanic, and his troubled marriage is about to expire. At this crossroads in his life, he feels that he has no better option than to work as a drug courier. He soon finds himself in a gunfight between police officers and his own ruthless allies. When the smoke clears, Bradley is badly hurt and thrown in prison, where his enemies force him to commit acts of violence that turn the place into a savage battleground.

titles.title: Breathing In
titles.description: On a dark and stormy night during the last days of the Anglo-Boer War, a wounded Boer General is nursed by Anna, a herbalist with powers.

titles.title: Bride vs. Bride
titles.description: Brides, grooms and members of their wedding parties compete with other brides, grooms and family in mental and physical challenges to win a cash prize for their big day.

episodes.title: Shelly & Anthony vs. Kristen & Ed
episodes.description: Shelly and Anthony go up against Kristen and Ed in the Appetizer Obstacle Course and the On Our Way to the Altar and Toss the Bouquet competitions.

episodes.title: Maria & Craig vs. Chrissy & Jason
episodes.description: Maria and Craig take on Chrissy and Jason in the Icing on the Cake, Treasure Hunt and the Old Ball and Chain competitions.

episodes.title: Rebekah & Steve vs. Sabrina & Max
episodes.description: Rebekah and Steve face Sabrina and Max in the Here Comes the Bride, Just Married and Shotgun Wedding challenges.

episodes.title: Suzanne & JJ vs. Allana & Jason
episodes.description: Suzanne and JJ compete against Allana and Jason in the Just Married, Toss the Bouquet and Appetizer Obstacle Course challenges.

episodes.title: Jillian & Zak vs. Andrea & Pete
episodes.description: Jillian and Zak compete against Andrea and Pete in the Champagne Toast, Icing on the Cake and Here Comes the Bride contests.

episodes.title: Kamesha & Craig vs. Ashley & Jon
episodes.description: Kamesha and Craig take on Jon and Ashley in the On Our Way to the Altar, Shotgun Wedding and Old Ball and Chain contests.

titles.title: Brockmire
titles.description: Hank Azaria and Amanda Peet co-star in "Brockmire," a half-hour comedy series that began years ago as a viral short video on the Funny or Die website. The series centers on the fall of Jim Brockmire, a once-famed major league baseball announcer who suffers an embarrassing on-air meltdown caused by his wife's serial infidelity, leading to a decade away from the booth. Older and presumably wiser, Brockmire attempts to reclaim his career, reputation and love life by returning behind the mic, but the setting -- a broken-down rust belt town, home of the minor league's Morristown Frackers -- is not quite what he envisioned. Strong-willed, hard-drinking owner Julia James has a complicated relationship with Brockmire, while whiz-kid intern Charles is simultaneously entertained by and terrified of the new announcer.

episodes.title: Rally Cap
episodes.description: Years after his epic meltdown, sports announcer Jim Brockmire is brought in to call games for a minor league team.

episodes.title: Winning Streak
episodes.description: Jim and Jules hook up the night before the Frackers win a game, and they attempt to keep the lucky streak going on and off the field.

episodes.title: Kangaroo Court
episodes.description: The players hold a mock trial and Jules urges Brockmire to mediate; Charles wonders why Brockmire thinks he is gay.

episodes.title: Retaliation
episodes.description: Brockmire's ex-wife, Lucy, reappears; forced to confront his emotions, Brockmire defaults to drinking.

episodes.title: Breakout Year
episodes.description: Brockmire attempts fame again; Jules and Charles work to make Brockmire a household name and their efforts pay off when he gains a very unexpected fan base.

episodes.title: Road Trip
episodes.description: Jules has a pregnancy scare; Brockmire works out his father issues with Charles; Jules and Brockmire take a road trip to Pittsburgh.

episodes.title: Old Timers Day
episodes.description: Brockmire attends an event honoring broadcasters; Charles attempts to impress a girl.

episodes.title: It All Comes Down to This
episodes.description: Brockmire must choose between staying in Morristown or returning to the major leagues.

episodes.title: The Getaway Game
episodes.description: Now calling minor league games in New Orleans, Jim is up for the major leagues in Atlanta; he competes against Raj, a likable young announcer; Charles works on the podcast despite Brockmire's antics; a friend from Morristown stops by for a visit.

episodes.title: Platoon Player
episodes.description: Despite Jim's protests, Charles needs the night off for his birthday; Jim attempts to throw him a party, but things quickly get out of hand; tensions arise when Jim shows up at Charles' birthday dinner and meets his judgmental family.

episodes.title: Knuckleball
episodes.description: Jim and Uribe go on an epic bender; Charles discovers a sad truth about Brockmire; when announcing with Raj, Brockmire has a few too many drinks.

episodes.title: Retirement Ceremony
episodes.description: Jim faces his dysfunctional family at his father's funeral; he struggles to mend his broken relationship with his sister; Brockmire must make peace with someone from his past.

episodes.title: Make-Up Game
episodes.description: Jules visits Jim, who gives her a tour of New Orleans; they reconnect for an evening, but have trouble figuring out the new terms of their relationship.

episodes.title: Broadcasters Jinx
episodes.description: Jim takes a new gig as an Atlanta major league announcer; Charles focuses on the new direction his career might take; confronted with the truth about a legendary announcer, Jim attempts to do the right thing in the most Brockmire-way possible.

episodes.title: Caught in a Rundown
episodes.description: After Jim ends up in the hospital, Charles has an intervention to stop Brockmire's destructive habits; in attendance are a rag-tag group of friends and enemies from Brockmire's past; Jim meets a dangerous new friend.

episodes.title: In the Cellar
episodes.description: Jim goes on a bender with his new nihilistic friend, Elle, who pushes him towards a new level of destruction; Brockmire ends up in the hospital again and finally takes rehab seriously; Charles approaches Jim with a new opportunity.

titles.title: Brown Sugar
titles.description: Sidney and Dre can attribute their friendship and the launch of their careers to one single childhood instant ... witnessing the birth of hip-hop on a New York street corner. Now some 15 years later, she is a revered music critic, and he is a successful, though unfulfilled, music executive. Both come to realize that their true life passions will only be fulfilled by remembering what they learned that day on the corner.

titles.title: Bruce Lee: The Way of the Warrior
titles.description: A comprehensive look at the legend that is Bruce Lee, told by the people closest to him. Co-stars, long time friends and even family members share exclusive details on the life of Bruce in a bid to discover what made him so great.

titles.title: Bukowski: Born Into This
titles.description: This documentary chronicles the writer Charles Bukowski, who is as well known for his drinking binges as for his poetry and prose. Using interviews with Bukowski and other footage, filmmaker John Dullaghan tells the story of a man who struggles to make a living while he writes from the heart. Then, after editor John Martin of Black Sparrow Press discovers Bukowski, his work becomes much more widely read. The film also includes comments from famous fans Bono, Sean Penn and Harry Dean Stanton.

titles.title: Bullets for the Bad
titles.description: A down-on-his-luck bounty hunter rides into a town in the middle of a power struggle between a gang of desperadoes and the local cattle baron. When the baron's daughter is abducted, he hires the bounty hunter to rescue her by any means necessary.

titles.title: Burden
titles.description: Illustrated with performances, private videos, and recollections from those who knew him, we observe the life of the always provocative artist Chris Burden, whose work consistently challenged ideas about the limits and nature of modern art, from his notorious performances in the 1970s to his later assemblages, installations, kinetic and static sculptures, and scientific models.

titles.title: Burning Man
titles.description: After the death of his wife (Bojana Novakovic), a father (Matthew Goode) gives in to grief and anger and uses casual sex to cope with his pain.

titles.title: Bury the Past
titles.description: The past comes back to haunt a woman in hiding who killed her abusive husband in self-defense.

titles.title: Burying the Ex
titles.description: A horror fan's (Anton Yelchin) dead girlfriend (Ashley Greene) comes back as a zombie and wants to continue their relationship forever.

titles.title: But Deliver Us From Evil
titles.description: Lilith, a succubus, emerges in the present day to seek revenge against mankind for her expulsion from the Garden of Eden.

titles.title: Butcher, Baker, Nightmare Maker
titles.description: An obsessive and murderous woman (Susan Tyrrell) tries to control her nephew, a 17-year-old basketball player (Jimmy McNichol).

titles.title: Byzantium
titles.description: Mayhem follows when two female vampires who are on the run from a kindred group take refuge at a seaside British community.

titles.title: Cabin Fever
titles.description: Fresh out of college, five friends (Nadine Crocker, Matthew Daddario, Samuel Davis) face the horrors of a flesh-eating virus while staying at a remote cabin.

titles.title: Cabin Fever 2: Spring Fever
titles.description: As students prepare for their high school prom, they have no idea a flesh-eating virus is spreading via a popular brand of water.

titles.title: Cabin Fever: Patient Zero
titles.description: Vacationers think they've found the perfect place for a bachelor party, but a deadly, flesh-eating virus is waiting to infect them.

titles.title: Camp
titles.description: At Camp Ovation, kids of all ages spend their summer expressing themselves through dance, music and theater. Vlad (Daniel Letterle) is a singer-songwriter and first-time camper caught between talented but insecure Ellen (Joanna Chilcoat) and provocative Jill (Alana Allen). Besides romance, the campers grapple with complicated issues, including sexual identity, self-respect and parental pressure, as they grow closer together and prove their talents to the bitter camp director (Don Dixon).

titles.title: Cannibal! The Musical
titles.description: A man (Juan Schwartz) convicted of cannibalism tells a reporter his story, complete with singing and dancing.

titles.title: Cardi B: The Hustle
titles.description: Cardi B is one of the most famous artists of the last decade. Despite being a "regula degula schmegula" girl from the Bronx, she became one of the most influential female artists of all time. She knew if she wanted to reach her dreams, she would have to work... Hard. On the streets, there's a fine line between wrong and right, good and bad. Her journey to the top, although successful, isn't seen as ideal. But she isn't ashamed of it. She started from the bottom and hustled her way to the top.

titles.title: Cashback
titles.description: Would-be artist Ben (Sean Biggerstaff) realizes he has an extraordinary way of dealing with the tedium of his dead-end job stocking shelves at a store - he has acquired the ability to halt time and explore the world while the rest of the earth's population remains frozen in place. Ben's unusual talent helps him forget about a nasty breakup with his ex-girlfriend Suzy (Michelle Ryan), but he begins to stop time so often that he may miss out on a new romance with his coworker Sharon (Emilia Fox).

titles.title: Casino Jack and the United States of Money
titles.description: This documentary tracks the high life and eventual downfall of wealthy lobbyist and businessman Jack Abramoff, who was convicted of conspiracy and fraud, among other charges, in a corruption scandal during the George W. Bush administration. The film details Abramoff's decadent and lavish lifestyle and reveals the shady dealings that led to his getting arrested, which ultimately resulted in a prison sentence for him and tarnished reputations for others.

titles.title: Caught in Providence
titles.description: Real people with real cases enter Providence Municipal Court to stand before Chief Municipal Court Judge Frank Caprio. Caprio hears cases involving traffic, parking, and arraignments for criminal offenses. There's always a bit of fun when the cameras are rolling, but Caprio makes it clear that he is there to do his job. Judge Frank Caprio is the Chief Municipal Judge in Providence, R.I. and former Chairman of the Rhode Island Board of Governors. He was appointed in 1985 and has been reappointed six times.

episodes.title: Caught in Providence

titles.title: Centurion
titles.description: In ancient Scotland, the Ninth Legion liberates a Roman officer named Quintus Dias (Michael Fassbender) from his Pict captors. The soldiers are in pursuit of the Pict leader, and Quintus joins their quest. Soon afterward, the Romans' Pict guide betrays them, resulting in the slaughter of all but a handful of men. The Roman survivors try desperately to reach safety, as the indigenous warriors pick them off one by one.

titles.title: Certain Women
titles.description: Three strong-willed women (Kristen Stewart, Laura Dern, Michelle Williams) strive to forge their own paths amidst the wide-open plains of the American Northwest: a lawyer who finds herself contending with both office sexism and a hostage situation; a wife and mother whose determination to build her dream home puts her at odds with the men in her life; and a young law student who forms an ambiguous bond with a lonely ranch hand.

titles.title: Chasing 3000
titles.description: Mickey (Ray Liotta) recounts the cross-country journey of his 15-year-old self (Trevor Morgan) and his young brother, Roger (Rory Culkin), who suffers from muscular dystrophy, to see baseball player Roberto Clemente's 3,000th hit. Their mother (Lauren Holly) doesn't know where they went, so the cops track down the stolen car as they travel to Pittsburgh. Determined to see their idol's historic event, the boys will do anything to get to the baseball stadium, including hitch a ride on a train.

titles.title: Chillerama
titles.description: A closing drive-in theater shows four lost film prints to its cinephile patrons.

titles.title: Chopping Mall
titles.description: Eight teens are trapped in a shopping mall with three security robots out of control.

titles.title: Christmas Evil
titles.description: Eavesdropping on mother turns a boy into a killer (Brandon Maggart) who roams the streets dressed as Santa Claus.

titles.title: Circle of Deception
titles.description: A small island community is turned upside down when one of the town's citizens, Russel Douglas, is found dead the day after Christmas.

titles.title: City of Gold
titles.description: Filmmaker Laura Gabbert follows Pulitzer Prize-winning food critic Jonathan Gold as he explores the culinary culture of Los Angeles.

titles.title: Class of Nuke 'Em High
titles.description: Tromaville's honor students are transformed into rampaging freaks when toxic waste leaks into the water supply.

titles.title: Class Rank
titles.description: Two high school misfits join forces in an attempt to overtake the local school board. Guided by their families, they enter the perilous word of politics and, in the process, learn a thing or two about love.

titles.title: Client 9: The Rise and Fall of Eliot Spitzer
titles.description: In the late 2000s, New York Governor Eliot Spitzer is a rising star in the Democratic Party. He's a no-nonsense politician and former attorney general who holds corporations accountable for unethical business practices. But, just one year after he becomes governor, Spitzer resigns after being outed as a frequent client of an expensive and elite escort service. Along with political colleagues and friends, a remorseful Spitzer talks about how his infidelity affected his life and career.

titles.title: Clouds of Sils Maria
titles.description: A veteran actress (Juliette Binoche) comes face-to-face with an uncomfortable reflection of herself when she agrees to take part in a revival of the play that launched her career 20 years earlier.

titles.title: Cocaine Cowboys
titles.description: Filmmaker Billy Corben recalls Miami drug wars of the 1970s and '80s, when Colombian drug lords turned the relatively quiet Florida city into a breeding ground for violence and excess. Corben interviews so-called "survivors" of the era, including dealers, smugglers and hit men.

titles.title: Cocaine Godmother: The Griselda Blanco Story
titles.description: Griselda Blanco becomes a pioneer in the Miami-based cocaine trade. Her willingness to use violence against her rivals leads to numerous assassination attempts, forcing Griselda to move her business to California.

titles.title: Collective
titles.description: Journalists uncover health care fraud in the wake of a deadly nightclub fire in Bucharest, Romania, in 2015.

titles.title: Color of Love
titles.description: An African American widow with two kids who has so much love to give, she often fosters children who need a home. She finds out that Peter and Rachel, the white siblings she fostered twice before, fled from their latest foster home.

titles.title: Comedy Bang! Bang!
titles.description: Upon first look, "Comedy Bang! Bang!" is like any late-night talk show... until the guests sit down and the interviews commence. Then it veers off in all sorts of directions, most of which include unfiltered and improvised dialogue. The show is based on host Scott Aukerman's popular podcast of the same name (and most certainly influenced by the Internet mock-talk show "Between Two Ferns With Zach Galifianakis," which Aukerman produced and directed). In each episode, Aukerman reinvents the traditional celebrity interview by engaging his guests in ad-libbed banter, all of which is punctuated by beats from "bandleader" Reggie Watts or, in later episodes, "Weird Al" Yankovic.

titles.title: Comic Book Men
titles.description: AMC dives into the comic book culture with this unscripted series that follows the antics of the "fanboys" in and around Jay and Silent Bob's Secret Stash, a New Jersey comic shop owned by writer-director Kevin Smith. Cameras capture the banter of the shop's employees and its customers as they collectively discover the treasures of the comic collecting world, and the staff -- de-facto leader Walt, shop whipping boy Ming and comic book virtuoso Mike among them -- shares all the details with Smith via a podcast that is woven throughout the series. Smith has been a comics fan since his youth and has written several comic books based on his movies, including "Clerks," as well as story arcs for the legendary "Green Arrow" and "Daredevil" comics.

titles.title: Countdown to Zero
titles.description: Although the Cold War is behind us, the threat of nuclear disaster remains very real. Director Lucy Walker discusses the invention of the atomic bomb and brings the story into the present day, examining the possibility of nuclear calamity under the categories of "Madness," "Accident" and "Miscalculation." With narration by Gary Oldman, the film includes a hypothetical sequence of a nuclear explosion in New York City's Times Square, timed to coincide with the New Year's Eve countdown.

titles.title: Crank

titles.title: Crime in Progress
titles.description: Follows the evolution of investigations in real time, told exclusively through raw body cam, dash cam and surveillance footage. Each episode follows the entire arc of an investigation-capturing crimes as they unfold in real time, exactly as they happened, with no reenactments or narration. From the first 911 call to the final verdict, every confrontation is presented in vivid detail. The result is a visceral experience, a 360-degree view of each case. Each critical moment occurs in real time as officers and detectives face life-or-death decisions on the front lines for justice.

episodes.title: Mailman Murder
episodes.description: A routine mail route turns deadly when a beloved postal worker is murdered in broad daylight; with body-worn cameras rolling, police and federal agents race to uncover the truth and what they find leads to shocking arrests that stun the entire community.

titles.title: Crock of Gold: A Few Rounds With Shane MacGowan
titles.description: Filmmaker Julien Temple dives deep into the life of Shane MacGowan, the tortured vocalist best known as the lead singer and songwriter of the Pogues, who famously combined traditional Irish music with the visceral energy of punk rock. Features unseen archival footage from the band and MacGowan's family, as well as animation from legendary illustrator Ralph Steadman.

titles.title: Cunningham
titles.description: The artistic evolution of Merce Cunningham -- from his early years as a struggling dancer in postwar New York to his emergence as one of the world's most visionary choreographers.

titles.title: Customer Wars
titles.description: "Customer Wars" spotlights the conflicts that arise when disgruntled and irrational customers come face-to-face with the employees doing their best to take care of their needs. From fiery exchanges at the fast-food drive thru to loss-prevention brawls, this series proves once and for all that "The customer is always right" is the exception rather than the rule.

episodes.title: Line Fail
episodes.description: In a New Jersey coffeehouse, a customer hoping to purchase a sought-after limited edition coffee mug apparently lines up at the wrong door; at an airport in Florida, police respond to an allegedly intoxicated passenger who refuses to leave the plane after being asked to depart; at an Ohio gas station, a dispute apparently over a simple food purchase quickly turns violent; on an Island near Bali, an American tourist's getaway turns terrifying when their ferry home starts to take on water.

episodes.title: Return Rebellion
episodes.description: In Estes Park, Colorado, two customers attempt to return their purchases after the store owner allegedly makes an offensive remark about them to another shopper; at a fast-food restaurant in Rockledge, Florida, police are called to remove a disgruntled customer who refuses to leave; in a Richmond, Canada supermarket parking lot, a bystander films a heated brawl that erupts when two elderly women vie for a handicap spot.

titles.title: Daybreakers
titles.description: Ten years after a plague turns most of the world's population into vampires, a critical blood shortage causes panic and gruesome mutations among the reanimated. Edward (Ethan Hawke), a vampire hematologist, tries to develop a blood substitute when he meets Lionel (Willem Dafoe) and Audrey (Claudia Karvan), two fugitive humans who claim to have a possible cure. Edward casts his lot with them in the hope of perfecting the cure before it's too late.

titles.title: Dead and Buried

titles.title: Deadfall

titles.title: Devil's Pass

titles.title: Dietland
titles.description: Based on Sarai Walker's best-selling novel of the same name, "Dietland" offers a darkly comedic look at the war of the sexes. The series explores a multitude of issues women face today -- including patriarchy, misogyny, rape culture and unrealistic beauty standards -- by following Plum Kettle's journey to self-awakening. A ghostwriter for the editor of one of New York's hottest fashion magazines, Plum has waged a lifelong battle with her image. Fed up, she turns to weight-loss surgery but ends up in the middle of two rival feminist factions -- one that may be responsible for the attacks on male harassers, and the other that preaches female empowerment. As she straddles the two groups, Plum must decide what part she plays in a wildly complicated, changing world.

episodes.description: Plum delves deeper into the fractured, perilous world of Jennifer; her new mission is threatened by a sudden change of circumstance.

titles.title: Diminished Capacity
titles.description: Suffering from concussion-induced memory loss, Chicago newspaper editor Cooper heads to his Missouri hometown for a much-needed break. Discovering that his beloved Uncle Rollie is not only suffering from Alzheimer's but is also facing eviction, Cooper pledges to help the old man.

titles.title: Dispatches From Elsewhere
titles.description: "Dispatches From Elsewhere" is an anthology series from creator and star Jason Segal. The story centers around four ordinary people - Peter, Simone, Janice, and Fredwynn -- who are brought together by chance after they all respond to a flyer. Feeling as though something is missing in their lives, the characters are drawn into a game that unfolds in a serpentine series of events, taking them from parades to shareholders' meetings. As they piece together the puzzle to find a path forward, they come to delve deeper into a mind-boggling mystery hiding just behind the facade of everyday life and their eyes are opened to a world of possibility, whimsy and wonder. The 10-episode series features an ensemble cast including Sally Field, Richard E. Grant, André Benjamin, and Eve Lindley.

episodes.title: Peter
episodes.description: Peter is stuck in the everyday routine of his mundane life until the day he meets a group of strangers who all have something in common; together they begin an adventure into a world that has been hidden all around them.

episodes.title: Simone
episodes.description: The game continues as Simone and Peter follow the clues and explore the city; the gang discovers that the game runs deeper then they thought, and they have to make an important choice.

episodes.title: Janice
episodes.description: While searching for Fredwynn at the shareholders' meeting, the gang has their first encounter with Octavio; Janice explores her past.

episodes.title: Fredwynn
episodes.description: Fredwynn takes matters into his own hands, but he needs his teammates to move on; he searches for the next clue and asks the gang for help; they take it too far in their search for answers, leading them somewhere unexpected.

episodes.title: Clara
episodes.description: The game begins to have a deeper impact on the team members' lives in the real world; the mystery of Clara's disappearance deepens as the gang learns the full story; fresh clues take the game in a new direction.

episodes.title: Everyone
episodes.description: With time running out, the gang splits up in an effort to find Clara; Simone and Janice follow her artwork, while Fredwynn and Peter link the game to a large corporation.

episodes.title: Cave of Kelpius
episodes.description: The Milkman leads the gang underground; the players come together while Peter and Simone grapple with their feelings for each other; Janice meets someone who gives her an unexpected clue.

episodes.title: Lee
episodes.description: The gang reflects on their experiences; Peter and Simone go on their first date; Janice faces an unexpected decision; Fredwynn is convinced there is more to the story.

episodes.title: The Creator
episodes.description: Simone, Peter and Janice explore new interests, while Fredwynn finds it hard to let go.

episodes.title: The Boy
episodes.description: The mysterious puzzle is solved in the end; some flashbacks cause the full story to come to the surface.

titles.title: Documentary Now!
titles.description: "Saturday Night Live" compatriots Fred Armisen, Bill Hader and Seth Meyers serve as creators, executive producers and writers of this IFC original series, using their love of documentary films and combining it with comedy to present a unique take on the form. Hosted by Dame Helen Mirren and starring Armisen and Hader, each episode is shot in a different documentary film style, paying tribute to some of the most important stories that didn't actually happen. "SNL" creator Lorne Michaels also executive produces "Documentary Now!", and guest stars include Jack Black and John Slattery.

episodes.title: Sandy Passage
episodes.description: The lives of two aging socialites, and their deteriorating estate.

episodes.title: Kunuk Uncovered
episodes.description: Investigating the documentary "Kunuk the Hunter," which tries to separate reality from fabrication.

episodes.title: DRONEZ: The Hunt for El Chingon
episodes.description: The hipster media empire, DRONEZ, sends courageous journalists to Mexico to track down a drug lord.

episodes.title: The Eye Doesn't Lie
episodes.description: An investigation into the wrongful conviction of a man sentenced to death for the 1986 murder of John Patrick Winslow.
