episodes.title: A Town, a Gangster, a Festival
episodes.description: A documentary crew travels to Arborg, Iceland, for the festival which honors American gangster, Al Capone.

episodes.title: Gentle and Soft: The Story of the Blue Jean Committee, Part 1
episodes.description: Part one of the documentary chronicling the rise and fall of the band, the Blue Jean Committee.

episodes.title: Gentle and Soft: The Story of the Blue Jean Committee, Part 2
episodes.description: Part two of the documentary chronicling the rise and fall of the band, the Blue Jean Committee.

titles.title: Dog Eat Dog
titles.description: Ex-cons, Troy (Nicolas Cage), Mad Dog (Willem Dafoe) and Diesel (Christopher Matthew Cook), are hired by an eccentric mob boss to kidnap a baby and hold it for a large ransom. When the abduction goes awry, the men find themselves on the run from the mob and the cops. Vowing to stay out of prison at all costs, getting away with the crime is a matter of life and death.

titles.title: Don't Come Back Alive
titles.description: A police detective, prosecutor and beat cop must stop a serial killer before they strike again.

titles.title: Don't Let Him In
titles.description: Two couples spend the weekend in the country and cross paths with a serial killer.

titles.title: Don't Look Deeper
titles.description: In near-future California, high-school senior Aisha learns a dark secret about herself and goes from dreams of graduation to running for her life.

episodes.title: Alpha
episodes.description: When a typical day turns into a nightmare, Aisha heads to a party to unwind, only to discover an unsettling secret about who she really is.

titles.title: Don't Say Its Name
titles.description: Shortly after a Native anti-mining activist is killed in a mysterious hit-and-run, horrific murders start occurring in the snowfields of his isolated reserve. A police chief and a Metis veteran investigate, confronting a world of ancient myths.

titles.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out
titles.description: Dr. Sandra Lee, also known as Dr. Pimple Popper, is the most famous dermatological surgeon in the world and an internationally beloved personality. She has dedicated her life to sharing her incredible skills with her huge audience, as she helps hundreds of suffering patients who are unable or unwilling to find treatment for their painful, oozing cysts, fatty tumors, and infinitely complex, life-affecting dermatological issues. Now, Dr. Lee is ready to take her practice to the next level. The doctor has made modern additions to her main office which include an entire new wing of patient rooms, and many new staff and doctors. For the first time, Dr. Lee will also be providing intimate self-shot footage of her life outside the office.

episodes.title: Lessons in Pimple Popping
episodes.description: "Dottie the Body" lost her confidence when a large bump started growing between her thighs; Dr. Lee brings in a new, young doctor to help Tim with his big, bumpy nose; Karime is insecure about her birthmark that looks like a black eye.

episodes.title: A Juicy Secret
episodes.description: Dr. Lee and a medical student trainee help Emil and his wife, who are afraid the bump and lesion on his back might be cancerous.

episodes.title: Superglue to the Rescue
episodes.description: Tierra is a musician with massive bumps on her ears that hold her back from performing.

episodes.title: Call Me Big Popper
episodes.description: Assisting with Lance's notoriously big bump that halted his rap dreams; Shelby has lost control of the mystery bumps she has developed; Dr. Lee proposes a long-shot cure for Jante, who has been losing pigment in her skin as well as her confidence.

episodes.title: Senior Cyst-Izen
episodes.description: Anthony is trying to move on from his troubled past, but his huge thigh lump is holding him back; Mary has a mysterious 70-year-old bump that amazes Drs. Lee and Tomassian; Sultana has a shocking red rash on her face.

episodes.title: Jaw Dropper
episodes.description: Dr. Lyndsey joins Dr. Lee to help David, who is fearful that the lump on his jaw might be cancer; Carla has a large, mysterious bulge on her thigh that concerns Dr. Lee.

episodes.title: Holey Moley
episodes.description: Bill's swinging arm growth prevents him from living his retirement dreams; Regina distracts from the many moles on her face with a vibrant style; budding med student Gili helps Dr. Lee solve the mystery of Cowboy Carter's extensive rash.

episodes.title: Tag Team My Bumps
episodes.description: Dr. Lee asks Dr. Zoe to help double-team needle-shy Mary Ann's crusty skin; Isaiah's mom is concerned he is ignoring the growing lump over his lower spine; Maressa worries about the dangers of treating the oozing skin covering her ankles and body.

episodes.title: Triangle of Death
episodes.description: Jason has become a recluse because of a giant growth on the back of his neck; Marisa hates the red spider veins on her face; Kobe hums to stay calm as student Gili helps Dr. Lee remove a huge bump near his eye.

episodes.title: Nurse Bumpy Head
episodes.description: Bryan has a genetic condition that may be causing huge mystery bumps; Chalamar cannot dress how she wants because of her ugly chest bump; Dr. Lee enlists Dr. Lyndsey's surgical assistance to help sexy grandma Devi get her bikini body back.

episodes.title: Psoria-Sisters
episodes.description: Dave is a firefighter and avid cyclist whose bump gets in the way of wearing various helmets; Bree empowers others on social media by accepting her own psoriasis, but it has recently become too painful to endure.

episodes.title: Buffalo Hump Bump
episodes.description: Dee has the voice of an angel, but her huge neck hump has stolen her passion to sing; Eli wants to be a chef, but feels ashamed of his cheek bump; Dr. Zoe assists Dr. Lee to remove Showta's many boba-shaped bumps.

episodes.title: My Head Laid An Egg
episodes.description: Stephanie has dreams of being a caterer, but is humiliated by her giant baseball-sized scalp bump; Deb is afraid that the growth on the side of her knee may eventually paralyze her.

episodes.title: Needle Little Help
episodes.description: Jimmy is a Charleston firefighter whose myriad of torso bumps make it painful to play with his young son.

episodes.title: Bye Bye Booty Bump
episodes.description: Denise has a growth on her booty, but scarring from a previous trauma has kept her from getting it removed; Zachary's career is dragged down by his psoriasis; John would love to find a soulmate but will not date because of the huge bump on his cheek.

episodes.title: Hex Marks the Spot
episodes.description: Rachael's arm bump interferes with helping her disabled bestie; medical student Gili assists Dr. Lee with Christian's painful back bump; Soniya hates the superstitions and judgments people have about the dark spots covering her face and torso.

episodes.title: Third Eye Blinded
episodes.description: Allie's lifestyle is ruined by the gumball-sized bump above her eye; Andrew's psoriasis and multiple body bumps have held him back from starting a family; Dr. Lyndsey assists Dr. Lee with Cristina's concerning shoulder lipoma.

episodes.title: Beach Bump
episodes.description: Jon's huge, 25-year-old shoulder blade bump is ruining his family beach days and risking his health. April wants the wedding of her dreams but feels hideous in gowns due to her bumpy underarm "growth". Dr. Zoe gets a front row seat to new father Rondel's frightening looking forearm bump.

episodes.title: My Unlovely Lady Lumps
episodes.description: Tobi is having trouble re-entering the dating pool because of symmetrical bumps around her spine.

episodes.title: Lump in My Throat
episodes.description: Jack searches for the confidence to try surgery on his throat bump, after fainting during a previous attempt; Kristan is a young, bubbly gym teacher who has given up on love after discovering a growth on her back; Dr. Tomassian helps Dr. Lee reconstruct Victoria's earlobes so she can feel confident enough to regain her pro skateboarding career.

titles.title: Dragnet
titles.description: Just the facts, ma'am. Every week, Sgt. Joe Friday follows the clues, interviews witnesses and spews a lot of crime jargon as he tries to catch one perp or another. For the majority of the show's 1950s run, he was partnered with Officer Smith, but when the show was brought back in 1967, he had Officer Gannon as a partner.

episodes.title: The Big September Man
episodes.description: The investigation into a woman's untimely death leads investigators to a drunk and her former boyfriend.

episodes.title: The Big Seventeen
episodes.description: When the teenage crime rate begins to increase, Friday discovers that drugs are involved.

episodes.title: The Big Show
episodes.description: A woman gives a baby to Frank and Joe, claiming a stranger left it with her.

episodes.title: The Big Break
episodes.description: A convict escapes from San Quentin and goes on a crime spree.

episodes.title: The Big Hands
episodes.description: Friday and Smith investigate the suspicious death of a woman.

episodes.title: The Big Betty
episodes.description: Friday must catch con artists who use the names of dead people in their crimes.

episodes.title: The Big Little Jesus
episodes.description: A statue of the infant Jesus is missing from an impoverished church's crèche.

episodes.title: The Big Trunk
episodes.description: A woman is found murdered in her apartment and the only clue is a trunk that she never opened.

episodes.title: The Big Boys
episodes.description: Friday seeks four robbers who have escaped from San Francisco.

episodes.title: The Big Shoplift
episodes.description: An investigation into a shoplifting spree leads Friday to suspect a mentally unstable woman.

episodes.title: The Big Hit-Run Killer
episodes.description: Friday searches for a delivery truck involved in a hit-and-run homicide.

episodes.title: The Big Girl
episodes.description: A gun leads Friday to a hitchhiker committing violent robberies.

episodes.title: The Big Frame
episodes.description: Frank and Joe suspect a hit-and-run victim was murdered. With Carolyn Jones.

episodes.title: The Big False Make
episodes.description: Friday has doubts about the guilt of a gardener who has confessed to a crime.

episodes.title: The Big Producer
episodes.description: Joe Friday investigates a case of obscene literature being sold to children in public schools.

episodes.title: The Big Crime
episodes.description: Friday goes after missing children and their kidnappers in Los Angeles.

episodes.title: The Big Pair
episodes.description: Burglars posing as a couple pawn items taken from vacationers' homes.

episodes.title: The Big Bar
episodes.description: Friday hunts for a holdup man who is targeting bars and killing some of his victims.

episodes.title: The Big Rod
episodes.description: Friday and Smith investigate two teens who run down an expectant mother.

episodes.title: The Big Family
episodes.description: A businessman vanishes, leaving two bullets and a suicide note.

episodes.title: The Big Number
episodes.description: Friday enlists the help of a bank security guard to catch a robber.

episodes.title: The Big Lift
episodes.description: Friday has trouble finding clues to a string of home burglaries.

episodes.title: The Big Gap
episodes.description: The customer of a pawn shop appears to have been victimized by con men.

episodes.title: The Big Look
episodes.description: Investigation of a man with a scarred face who assaults women.

episodes.title: The Big Bird
episodes.description: Friday and Smith investigate burglars in a new housing development who kill pet birds.

episodes.title: The Big Deal
episodes.description: Friday and Smith struggle with their investigation of a car-theft ring.

episodes.title: The Big Net
episodes.description: Friday and Smith must hunt for a man who beats and robs women.

episodes.title: The Big Oskar
episodes.description: After a suspect turns himself in, Friday begins to question the man's guilt.

episodes.title: The Big Counterfeit
episodes.description: Friday must investigate a police impersonator who is collecting cash as evidence.

titles.title: Dreaming Walls: Inside the Chelsea Hotel
titles.description: Residents of New York's legendary Chelsea Hotel continue to live there as it undergoes renovation for a grand reopening.

titles.title: Dual
titles.description: Upon receiving a terminal diagnosis, Sarah opts for a cloning procedure to ease her loss on her friends and family. When she makes a sudden and miraculous recovery, her attempts to decommission her clone fail, leading to a court-mandated duel to the death. Now, she has one year to train her mind and body for the fight of her life.

titles.title: Dublin Murders
titles.description: Detectives Rob Reilly and Cassie Maddox find themselves dispatched to investigate the murder of a young girl on the outskirts of Dublin, Ireland. Based on the books "In the Woods" and "The Likeness" by American-Irish writer Tana French, this psychological thriller features a cast of mostly Irish actors, including Killian Scott and Sarah Greene as the leads. The series follows the detectives, who put their friendship to the test, as they are pulled deeper into the intrigue and darkness that surrounds the case.

episodes.title: Episode 101
episodes.description: Detectives Rob Reilly and Cassie Maddox are on the case after a young girl is found murdered in the woods on the outskirts of Dublin, Ireland.

titles.title: Dumbstruck
titles.description: Five ventriloquists discuss their emotional attachments to their dummies.

titles.title: Dynamite Warrior
titles.description: In the 1920s Thailand a young man sets out to avenge his parents' murder at the hands of vicious cattle rustlers.

titles.title: Emeril Cooks
titles.description: New Orleans locals visit Emeril Lagasse's kitchen to see firsthand how he makes the dishes they helped inspire, from piping hot beignets to icy cold sake made with Louisiana-grown rice.

episodes.title: Ian McNulty
episodes.description: Emeril makes crab and corn bisque, andouille-encrusted redfish with roasted pecan vegetable relish, meunière sauce, and shoestring potatoes with New Orleans food critic Ian McNulty.

episodes.title: Kermit Ruffins
episodes.description: Joined by jazz legend Kermit Ruffins, Emeril makes red bean soup with cornbread croutons, and shrimp stuffed mirlitons with vodka sauce.

episodes.title: Bau Nguyen
episodes.description: Joined by the owner of Singleton's Mini Mart, Bau Nguyen, Emeril draws inspiration from Vietnamese cuisine to create Viet-style curried shrimp with cellophane noodles and slow-cooked beef brisket pho.

episodes.title: Sarah Roland
episodes.description: Using farm-fresh ingredients provided by Sarah Roland, owner of the only water buffalo dairy in Louisiana, Emeril prepares a caprese pasta, braised water buffalo chuck roast, and broccoli rabe.

episodes.title: Janie Glades
episodes.description: Janie Glade inspires a delicious and economical meal.

episodes.title: Scott Maurer
episodes.description: The owner of Louisiana Oyster Co., Scott Maurer, shows us how his oysters grow from little larvae to restaurant ready, and Emeril uses them to cook up a tasty meal.

episodes.title: Gabbi Deculus
episodes.description: Emeril draws inspiration from a NOLA local's family recipes to create a creole-inspired menu of chicken sauce piquante, and creamy grillades and grits.

episodes.title: Maggie Long
episodes.description: We're visiting Mushroom Maggie, a mushroom farm that supplies some of the best restaurants in Louisiana, and Emeril is preparing popular dishes from his restaurants that feature Maggie's mushrooms.

episodes.title: Kim Patton-Bragg
episodes.description: Cocktail expert Kimberly Patton-Bragg gives us the story behind one of Emeril's favorite drinks, the Sazerac, and the reason why it's known as the official cocktail of New Orleans.

episodes.title: Johnny Slamon and EJ Lagasse
episodes.description: Emeril shares the most popular dishes at his namesake restaurant, a New Orleans staple for over 30 years.

episodes.title: Southern Feast Fit for a "Bounce" Queen
episodes.description: TV personality Big Freedia ("Big Freedia: Queen of Bounce") joins, and Emeril prepares the rapper's favorite meal.

episodes.title: Cooking With Louisiana Beer
episodes.description: Emeril meets David Blossman, the head of Louisiana's favorite brewery, Abita Brewing Company, and creates a menu inspired by his bayou brews.

episodes.title: Menu Inspired by New Orleans' Voodoo Fest
episodes.description: Emeril gets inspired by New Orleans' annual Voodoo Fest and creates a meal of black-eyed pea jambalaya, ham hock and cabbage soup, and sweet rum balls.

episodes.title: Emeril's Recipes for Young Chefs
episodes.description: Emeril prepares a meal any kid (or adult) would love, for budding young chef CJ Calhoun, a mentee of the New Orleans non-profit, Son of a Saint.

episodes.title: Delicious Dishes to Share Online
episodes.description: New Orleans Saints tight-end Juwan Johnson and his wife, Chanen, join Emeril in the kitchen and cook up a tasty meal for their large and loyal group of followers on TikTok.

episodes.title: Aaron Sanchez Visits Emeril's Kitchen
episodes.description: Emeril visits with his friend and fellow chef Aaron Sanchez, and explores a menu inspired by their trip to Cuba.

episodes.title: Cooking With Louisiana Sake
episodes.description: Emeril meets local brewers Lindsey Brower and Nan Wallis and makes them a meal inspired by their Louisiana sake: tuna crudo with sake-yuzu vinaigrette and seared halibut with a sake and kasu marinade.

episodes.title: Comfort Food With Heart
episodes.description: Asia Magee and Chassidy Carter of Café Reconcile, a non-profit that helps young people break into the food business, join Emeril to explore a menu inspired by their dishes.

episodes.title: Emeril's Favorite Sandwiches
episodes.description: Chef Justin Kennedy of Parkway Bakery and Tavern teaches the history of the po' boy and other classic New Orleans sandwiches, and Emeril makes him a three-course meal of sandwiches.

episodes.title: Best Brunch in New Orleans
episodes.description: Emeril prepares a meal inspired by Nonno's wildly popular brunch menu for the restaurant's chef, Shermond Esteen.

titles.title: Emeril Live
titles.description: Chef Emeril Lagasse kicks things up a notch, or three, as he whips up an assortment of gourmet dishes before a live audience that treats him like a rock star.

episodes.title: Tailgating
episodes.description: Oyster stew over spinach potato pancakes; wild pecan rice dressing; grilled quail and andouille sausage ragù; sour cream apple cake.

episodes.title: Coffee Talk
episodes.description: Country ham with red-eyed gravy; beignets and café au lait; chicory crème brûlée mocha cheesecake.

episodes.title: Singular Sensations
episodes.description: Mini éclairs; big kahuna; bananas foster ice cream pies.

episodes.title: Breads, Biscuits, and Biscotti
episodes.description: Sticky pecan rolls; country ham and cheese biscuits; dried cherry and chocolate biscotti.

episodes.title: Smokin'
episodes.description: Smoked beef and onion risotto; pork chops stuffed with oyster dressing andouille hollandaise and smothered greens; shrimp cakes with fire-roasted remoulade and sweet potato nests.

episodes.title: Garlic Galore
episodes.description: Garlic butter; garlic aioli; roasted garlic paste; garlicky bread soup; spicy garlic bread; sautéed frog legs with tomato garlic butter.

episodes.title: Hot, Hot Chilies
episodes.description: Hot sauce; duck confit rellenos; fire-roasted corn and tomato salsa; piri piri sauce; piri piri lobster with saffron linguine.

episodes.title: Pipin' Hot Soups
episodes.description: Pasta with Swiss chard in broth with meatballs; seafood chowder; oysters Rockefeller soup garnished with crispy bacon and fried oysters.

episodes.title: Classic Hot Sandwiches
episodes.description: Emeril's savory pain perdu; fresh eggplant and roasted red pepper panini; duck-stuffed pitas.

episodes.title: Oodles of Noodles
episodes.description: Pad thai; bahn pho bo; soba; cellophane noodles; lo mein.

episodes.title: Hearty Soups
episodes.description: Butternut squash and sausage soup; potato; onion and Roquefort soup; ham and split pea; brown Windsor soup.

episodes.title: Snow Day Treats
episodes.description: Hurricane cocktails; clean out the ice box jambalaya; Mediterranean chicken packets; red bean soup; pound cake with ice cream.

episodes.title: Creative Casseroles
episodes.description: Eggplant; sausage and ziti casserole; Mexican breakfast casserole; spinach, mushroom and artichoke casserole; deep-dish banana pudding with chocolate sauce.

episodes.title: Sunday Dinners
episodes.description: Dinner salad with honey mustard dressing; Sunday dinner pork roast; kicked-up bacon-cheese mashed potatoes; nutty green beans; strawberry-cream angel food cake.

episodes.title: Comfort Foods
episodes.description: Spiked hot chocolate; wild cream of mushroom soup; string bean casserole; kicked-up blue cheese-stuffed burgers; tapioca pudding parfait.

episodes.title: Pancakes and Flapjacks
episodes.description: Tried and true buttermilk pancakes with orange syrup and raspberries; goat cheese stuffed zucchini pancakes with tomato sauce; bacon pancakes with walnut butter and caramelized onions; giant apple walnut pancake.

episodes.title: Quiches and Savory Tarts
episodes.description: Savory leek and applewood bacon tart; Mediterranean quiche; onion and Roquefort tart; manly quiche.

episodes.title: White Wine and Food Pairings
episodes.description: Oysters on the half shell; asparagus soup with red pepper sauce and lump crabmeat; chicken club roulades with white wine mustard cream sauce; hazelnut-chocolate soufflé glacé.

episodes.title: Great Gobs of Garlic
episodes.description: Bloody bull with elephant garlic chips; artichoke balls; garlic and red pepper dip; garlic custard with shrimp; garlic mojito granita with garlic brittle.

episodes.title: Sourdough 101
episodes.description: Basic sourdough starter; potato water starter; basic sourdough bread; muffuletta sandwich; blueberry sourdough pancakes; sourdough cornbread.

episodes.title: Happy Happy Hour
episodes.description: Angels and devils on horseback; spinach and artichoke dip; cocktail meatballs; pork egg rolls with hot mustard.

episodes.title: The Ooey Gooey Show
episodes.description: Crab and brie quesadilla with chili-apple glaze; cheese-stuffed sausage with poached eggs and tasso cream sauce; ooey gooey stuffed cupcakes.

episodes.title: Late Night Snacks
episodes.description: Milkshakes; salami coronets; stuffed fried rice balls; Philly cheese steak sandwich; french bread pizza.

episodes.title: Baked, Not Fried
episodes.description: Baked jalapeño poppers; oven-fried potato chips with oven cooked bacon dip; oven-fried pecan crusted chicken fingers and baked sweet potato hand pies.

episodes.title: Winter Treats
episodes.description: Sweet potato-roasted pork au gratin; braised veal shanks on mascarpone cheese polenta; pear and blue cheese crumble.

episodes.title: Hearty Helpings
episodes.description: Hot toddy tea; gorgonzola ravioli with walnut-brown butter; mama's green pumpkin; shrimp and crabmeat casserole; goat cheese-stuffed baked apples.

episodes.title: Stick to Your Ribs
episodes.description: Baby back ribs; beef ribs; stuffed pork crown roast.

episodes.title: Manly Man Snacks
episodes.description: Coconut beer-battered shrimp with mango-orange chutney; crab Rangoon pot stickers with hot mustard sauce; manly Mexican bites; poor man's beef wellington.

episodes.title: Macho Nachos
episodes.description: Chef Emeril Lagasse shares classic Cajun and Creole-inspired cooking with his signature 'kicked-up' approach - and plenty of BAM - with the help of a live studio audience and Doc Gibbs' house band.

episodes.title: Extreme Chili
episodes.description: Turkey and hot sausage chili; Texas-style chili; vegetarian chili; vegetarian chili masa cake stacks.

episodes.title: Pork Fat Always Rules
episodes.description: Bacon-wrapped trout with tomato-thyme butter sauce; Southern-style green beans with bacon and new potatoes; root beer-glazed pork chops with bourbon-mashed sweet potatoes; tangerine-glazed pork belly.

episodes.title: New Orleans Caribbean Connection
episodes.description: Caribbean red beans and rice; New Orleans red beans and rice; Haitian sweet potato pudding cake; fried okra with tomato marmalade; rum-spiked sweet potato pie; Haitian cremasse.

episodes.title: Sunday Dinner
episodes.description: Smothered pork chops and cabbage; pan-roasted salmon with lentils; penne a la vodka casserole; E.J.'s first ice cream sandwich.

titles.title: Emeril Tailgates
titles.description: Football fans visit Emeril Lagasse's kitchen to learn how to make new tailgate dishes that will make their friends and family members proud.

episodes.title: Pittsburgh
episodes.description: Emeril welcomes Pittsburgh Steelers superfan Brad Younkin and takes inspiration from his city's Polish roots to create chorizo-stuffed cabbage rolls and beer braised sausages.

episodes.title: Detroit
episodes.description: Detroit Lions superfan Michael Banks and his wife, Rona, turn their city's famous Middle Eastern dishes into easy to grill lamb meatball skewers, garlic flatbread, and homemade tzatziki sauce.

episodes.title: Buffalo
episodes.description: Buffalo Bills superfan Lindsey Kszos takes inspiration from her city's famous wings with chile-glazed duck wings served with blue cheese crème fraîche, shaved celery and grape salad, and Buffalo chicken and white bean chili.

episodes.title: Boston
episodes.description: Boston native and New England Patriots superfan Kim Mello joins to create savory New England treats with a New Orleans twist, spicing up a classic lobster roll with some crystal hot sauce aioli and pairing chorizo with clams on the grill.

episodes.title: Denver
episodes.description: Denver superfan Catherine Highland, aka The Bronco Babe, grills up dishes to honor the great state of Colorado, including blue cheese-stuffed bison sliders with bacon drunken onions, angels on horseback, and grilled oysters on the half shell.

episodes.title: Dallas
episodes.description: Dallas Cowboys superfan Jesse Prado, aka Big Brother, creates some Tex-Mex barbecue with a Louisiana kick, including slow-cooked brisket tortas with smoky chipotle salsa, charred tomatillo, and fresh chunky guacamole.

episodes.title: Cleveland
episodes.description: Cleveland Browns superfan Ray Prisby joins, as Emeril cooks up Ohio-inspired dishes with his signature flair, including crawfish pierogies with lemony brown butter and tarragon, catfish fingers with homemade tartar sauce, and fried hush puppies.

episodes.title: Atlanta
episodes.description: Atlanta Falcons superfan Thomas Dunn draws from his city's Southern delicacies to make stuffed pimento cheese deviled eggs, fried chicken and biscuits, and peach cobbler on the grill.

episodes.title: Miami
episodes.description: Miami Dolphins superfan Seth Farmer and his girlfriend, Julia Thompson, inspire Emeril's creations of easy-to-grill pressed Cuban sandwiches, corn elotes, marinated blue crab claws, and tostones; plus, Seth pops an exciting question.

episodes.title: Nashville
episodes.description: Tennessee Titans superfans Isiah Washington and Jameson Greer take Southern home cooking to new heights, with hot chicken thighs on buttermilk biscuits, sweet and tangy coleslaw, homemade pickles, and mini whiskey pecan pies.

episodes.title: Chicago
episodes.description: Chicago Bears fan Edgar Mejia, aka Bear Misterio, joins to put a New Orleans spin on Chicago-style hotdogs and deep dish pizza.

episodes.title: Kansas City
episodes.description: Turning Kansas City's world-famous barbecue into tender ribs and bourbon-baked beans for the grill.

episodes.title: Green Bay
episodes.description: Honoring Wisconsin, the cheese capital of the U.S., by making cheesy beer dips and soft pretzels.

episodes.title: San Francisco
episodes.description: A 49ers superfan helps cook up some crowd-pleasing Bay Area seafood dishes.

episodes.title: Las Vegas
episodes.description: Making ribeyes on the grill, spinach, baked potatoes and four cheese mac in honor of Sin City.

episodes.title: Minneapolis
episodes.description: We head to Minneapolis to meet Vikings fans Jim Dazzle and Brandie Pac; we're kicking mini-Swedish meatballs up a notch.

episodes.title: Houston Texans
episodes.description: For a Houston style tailgate, dazzle your friends with a winning Tex-Mex combo of grilled jalapeño poppers, chili con queso, and ancho rubbed flap steak.

episodes.title: Baltimore Ravens
episodes.description: Win over everyone with Emeril's easy crab cakes, fried soft shell crab sandwich, and Maryland crab toast.

episodes.title: Los Angeles Rams
episodes.description: Cali-style carne asada burritos, and crowd-pleasing chicken and green chile nachos.

episodes.title: Seattle Seahawks
episodes.description: For a Seattle style tailgate, Emeril whips up his crowd-pleasing cedar planked salmon.

episodes.title: New York Jets
episodes.description: For a New York style tailgate, indulge in some of New York City's Italian favorites.

episodes.title: Cincinnati Bengals
episodes.description: For a Cincinnati style tailgate, Emeril's Ohio favorites will make you the MVP of any party.

episodes.title: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
episodes.description: For a Tampa Bay style tailgate, treat your guests to Emeril's grilled fish with coconut rice.

episodes.title: Washington Commanders
episodes.description: Nothing says Washington, D.C., like Emeril's crispy chicken wings with mumbo sauce.

episodes.title: Jacksonville Jaguars
episodes.description: At the next home game, turn classic dinner dishes into a fancy tailgate meal.

episodes.title: Los Angeles Chargers
episodes.description: For your next tailgate, let Los Angeles' Asian flavors inspire you.

episodes.title: New York Giants
episodes.description: For a New York style tailgate, keep it old school with Emeril's favorite deli-inspired classics.

episodes.title: Indianapolis Colts
episodes.description: Dine like a Hoosier with chicken fried steak, barbecue chicken, and sugar cream pie.

episodes.title: Carolina Panthers
episodes.description: For a Carolina inspired tailgate, wow your guests with Emeril's take on some hometown faves.

episodes.title: Cleveland Browns
episodes.description: Celebrate Cleveland's roots with a Polish-inspired tailgate menu.

episodes.title: Dallas Cowboys
episodes.description: For a Texan style tailgate, impress your guests with my take on the state's faves.

episodes.title: Tennessee Titans
episodes.description: At your next tailgate, go with a sure-fire southern menu of "meat and three."

episodes.title: Philadelphia Eagles
episodes.description: The flavors of Philadelphia inspire; paned pork sandwich with smothered mushrooms and herbs; grilled steak cheeses on Texas toast; Steen's cane syrup shoofly pie.

episodes.title: New Orleans Saints
episodes.description: For the next tailgate, take a cue from Emeril's home team the New Orleans Saints; Creole glazed turkey wings and poor man's French fry po' boy sandwich.

episodes.title: Las Vegas Raiders
episodes.description: So for the next tailgate, celebrate it Vegas style; truffle Parmesan potato chips; cowboy steak with maître d'butter; potato fennel gratin; pecan pie with caramel sauce.

episodes.title: Green Bay vs. Chicago
episodes.description: Bringing together Green Bay and Chicago fans means whipping up a meal that showcases the best of both cities; air-fryer cheese curds, brat burgers with bacon, lasagna chili soup and brandy-flambéed saganaki.

episodes.title: Balitmore vs. Cincinnati
episodes.description: Bringing together Baltimore and Cincinnati fans with a meal that showcases the best of both cities; shaved beef tenderloin sandwiches with horseradish spread, crab nachos with Old Bay queso, Cincinnati chili nachos and delicious Bengal brownies.

episodes.title: Boston vs. New York
episodes.description: Bringing together Boston and New York fans with a meal that showcases the best of both cities; crispy fish cakes, bacon and clam flatbreads, grilled eggplant, prosciutto and mozzarella cheese roulades, and big boy meatballs for tailgating sliders.

episodes.title: Detroit vs. Kansas City
episodes.description: Bringing together Detroit and Kansas City fans means whipping up a meal that showcases the best of both cities; cola-braised pot roast; pistachio, walnut and almond baklava; KC-style pulled pork BBQ cobb salad; cheesy corn bake.

episodes.title: Las Vegas vs. Denver
episodes.description: We're celebrating Las Vegas and Denver with prime rib roast, crispy onion rings, bison meatballs with blueberry-chipotle BBQ sauce and goat cheese spread and a side of hot spinach and artichoke dip.

episodes.title: Cincinnati vs. San Francisco
episodes.description: Celebrating Cincinnati and San Francisco with porchetta with dandelion greens, savory Belgian waffles topped with turkey drumstick osso buco and salted chocolate chunk cookies.

episodes.title: Miami vs. Boston
episodes.description: Celebrating Miami and Boston with shrimp scampi po boy on garlic bread, Spanish bean soup, bacon-wrapped scallops on the grill with salsa verde, and blueberry cobbler.

episodes.title: Dallas vs. Philadelphia
episodes.description: Celebrating Dallas and Philadelphia with chorizo and black bean chili, queso fundido with mushrooms, Philly cheesesteak burgers and Italian sausage sliders with grilled peppers and onions.

titles.title: Emeril Tailgates: The Postseason
titles.description: This football season Emeril has been sharing recipes inspired by different cities; now that we're entering the post season, Emeril will show you how to make the dishes he serves at his own tailgates.

episodes.title: How New Orleans Tailgates
episodes.description: This week I'm throwing a Saints party at my restaurant Meril with superfan Whistle Monsta; together, we'll cheer on our home team while chowing down on Korean Short Ribs and Muffaletta Flatbread.

episodes.title: How Emeril Tailgates
episodes.description: All season we've been showing you can't-lose recipes inspired by the cuisine of different cities; this time, I'm going to show you my personal faves.

episodes.title: Emeril Tailgates Phoenix
episodes.description: Preparing for Cardinals super fans a Skirt Steak Taco Bar and Pork and Red Chile Pozole.

titles.title: Emeril's Table
titles.description: World-renowned chef and restaurateur Emeril Lagasse invites five guests to his chef's table as he prepares a meal for the quintet in each episode of this series. The chef provides a cooking lesson as only he can for the guests -- including newlyweds, busy mothers and firefighters -- and viewers in the intimate half-hour program. Lagasse inspires and engages his guests as he answers their culinary questions and helps with their food dilemmas. He also shares his fresh, fun recipes and provides tips and techniques people can employ in their own kitchens.

episodes.title: Homemade Pasta
episodes.description: Emeril shows how easy it is to make fresh pasta at home.

episodes.title: Wild Mushrooms: Types, Applications
episodes.description: One of a kind wild mushroom ragout creamy stone ground grits.

episodes.title: Coffee: Sneaky Flavor Enhancer in Savory Dishes
episodes.description: Short Ribs braised with coffee and ancho chiles served with creamy Parmesan polenta.

episodes.title: Vinaigrettes Aren't Just for Salad
episodes.description: A flavorful grilled shrimp with creamy avocado lime vinaigrette and a tomato vinaigrette that is perfect for fish.

episodes.title: Amazing Apples
episodes.description: Sweet and savory apple recipes.

episodes.title: One-Pot Wonders
episodes.description: Coq Au Vin Blanc and an appetizing leek and bacon quiche.

episodes.title: Gumbo 101
episodes.description: Chicken and smoked sausage gumbo, plus tips on how to make a roux.

episodes.title: Emeril's Restaurant Classics
episodes.description: One of the very first dishes Emeril created plus many more.

episodes.title: Real Mexican
episodes.description: Frozen Margaritas and chorizo, cheese and green chile enchiladas.

episodes.title: Taste of Spain
episodes.description: A salt crusted branzino seasoned with citrus; grilled calamari and seafood paella.

episodes.title: The Magic of Phyllo
episodes.description: Honey soaked and butter drenched baklava and a delightful appetizer, tuna tartare in phyllo cups.

episodes.title: Diner Classics
episodes.description: Old-fashioned soothing chicken noodle soup; hot and cheesy fries, crispy fries with gravy and kicked up tuna melts.

episodes.title: Italian Favorites
episodes.description: Lasagna bolognese; Big Boy Meatballs.

episodes.title: Cooking With Your Kids
episodes.description: Emeril shares three easy children's recipes for kids of all ages. Recipes include grilled almond butter sandwiches with bananas and chocolate, french bread pizza and mac and cheese.

episodes.title: Turn up the Heat
episodes.description: Emeril cooks for a group of firefighters. He prepares sizzling red-hot shrimp with rooster sauce over sticky rice, blazing hot braised and barbecued pork shanks with a spicy New Mexican barbecue sauce served with a side of cheddar jalapeño cornbread.

episodes.title: Sports Party
episodes.description: Emeril shares some sports party favorites: a juicy French dip sandwich; delicious tuna poke chips; the ultimate cheese dip: cheesy beer.

episodes.title: Halloween Treats for Kids
episodes.description: Elmo and some adorable trick-or-treaters join Emeril to make some treats including Emeril's grilled cheese sand-witch, spooky boo cupcakes and black cat cookies with a bittersweet ganache.

episodes.title: Halloween Isn't Just For Kids: Grown-Up Treats
episodes.description: Spiked cranberry/clementine punch; crispy pumpkin-shaped cheddar crackers; devil's flaming shrimp; crabmeat coffins.

episodes.title: Laid-Back Thanksgiving
episodes.description: A laid-back Thanksgiving menu.

episodes.title: Holiday Sides
episodes.description: Emeril's favorite holiday side dishes.

episodes.title: Kicked-Up Sandwiches
episodes.description: A pressed spicy eggplant sandwich.

episodes.title: Holiday Cooking for a Crowd
episodes.description: Crown roast of pork.

episodes.title: Celebrate in Style
episodes.description: Lobster thermidor; Baked Alaska.

episodes.title: Cocktails for Entertaining
episodes.description: Mixologists share their favorites.

episodes.title: Feast of the Seven Fishes
episodes.description: An Italian Christmas Eve dinner.

titles.title: Escaping the Madhouse: The Nellie Bly Story
titles.description: On a mission to expose the deplorable conditions and mistreatment of patients at the Women's Lunatic Asylum, investigative reporter Nellie Bly feigns mental illness to be institutionalized to report from the inside.

titles.title: Escaping the NXIVM Cult: A Mother's Fight to Save Her Daughter
titles.description: A mother will stop at nothing to save her daughter from a dangerous sex cult.

titles.title: Évocateur: The Morton Downey Jr. Movie
titles.description: In the late 1980s, controversial host Morton Downey Jr. rips apart the traditional talk-show format by turning civilized debate and discussion into aggressive and sometimes-violent confrontation.

titles.title: Fab Five: The Texas Cheerleader Scandal
titles.description: The new cheerleading coach at a high school is asked to resign by administrators after she tries to rein in five cheerleaders engaging in scandalous behavior.

titles.title: FeardotCom
titles.description: When four bodies are discovered among the industrial decay and urban grime of New York City, brash young detective Mike Reilly (Stephen Dorff) teams with ambitious Department of Health researcher Terry Huston (Natascha McElhone) to uncover the cause behind their violent and inexplicable deaths. The only common factor shared by the victims? Each died exactly 48 hours after logging on to feardot.com.

titles.title: Feral
titles.description: A wild animal attacks six grad students on a weekend hike in the woods. One by one, they become infected with an unknown virus that turns them into bloodthirsty creatures.

titles.title: Finding Vivian Maier
titles.description: The life and work of career nanny Vivian Maier and her amazing collection of 100,000 photographs.

titles.title: Flint
titles.description: A woman deals with the toxic water crisis in Flint, Mich., and its effect on her family.

titles.title: Flirting With Forty
titles.description: A divorcee (Heather Locklear) has a passionate affair with a much younger surfing instructor (Robert Buckley) in Hawaii.

titles.title: Flyboys
titles.description: Before the United States enters World War I, some American youths volunteer for the French military. Subsequently, they become the first U.S. fighter pilots and form a squadron known as the Lafayette Escadrille, whose exploits and heroism become the stuff of legend.

titles.title: Food, Inc.
titles.description: Documentary filmmaker Robert Kenner examines how mammoth corporations have taken over all aspects of the food chain in the United States, from the farms where our food is grown to the chain restaurants and supermarkets where it's sold. Narrated by author and activist Eric Schlosser, the film features interviews with average Americans about their dietary habits, commentary from food experts like Michael Pollan and unsettling footage shot inside large-scale animal processing plants.

titles.title: Four in a Bed
titles.description: Four pairs of Bed and Breakfast owners compete for the best establishment.

episodes.title: Robertsbrook Guesthouse
episodes.description: Robertsbrooke Guesthouse in Swanage is run by Claire Hilton, who feels she has got more than a sporting chance in the competition; however, her first guests Lynn Self and Ziggy Broome are dubious about the cleanliness of their bedroom.

episodes.title: Eden Lodge
episodes.description: Competitors James and Maria, the parents of Charlotte Church, object to the star rating of Ziggy's Eden Lodge in fabulous Falmouth.

episodes.title: Dexby Townhouse
episodes.description: Dexby Townhouse in Cardiff is run by Charlotte Church's parents, James and Maria, who lay on a day of white-water rafting in tight wetsuits and some magic tricks courtesy of Maria's young nephew Elliot.

episodes.title: Muddifords Court Country House
episodes.description: It is the last stay of the competition, and it is the turn of newlyweds Pip Easby and Nicky Lesser-Easby, who run Muddifords Court Country House in Devon.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: The group meet one last time to find out exactly how much they have been paid by their fellow hoteliers, and to air their grievances face to face.

episodes.title: Gorse Meadow
episodes.description: The first to host is Mrs. Tee of Gorse Meadow, a four star B&B in the New Forest; her eccentric personality charms the guests on arrival but not everyone's room is up to scratch.

episodes.title: Castle Hill Guesthouse
episodes.description: Alistair and Emma Mundell's four-star Castle Hill Guesthouse in sleepy Lynton, Nroth Devon only opened three months ago, and the B&B newbies are desperate to impress with their recently renovated rooms.

episodes.title: Vidella
episodes.description: The competition heads to Blackpool and the three-star Vidella, run by best friends and business partners John and Neil, where to pay back Alistair for being a self-confessed Blackpool-hater, the Vidella boys have rigged his room with practical jokes.

episodes.title: Urban Beach
episodes.description: For the final visit the group checks into the boutique B&B Urban Beach in Bournemouth, run by local entrepreneur Mark Crib.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: Another fearsome battle draws to a close as the proprietors reconvene to find out how much they have been paid, and Mrs Tee finds out who gave her one point for cleanliness.

episodes.title: Derwent House
episodes.description: The first to host are exuberant Jon Shorrock and his wife Julia, who run the four-star B&B Derwent House in West Sussex; whereas the guests take a quiet gander at their rooms, Andy and Julian have concerns over their carpeted bathroom.

episodes.title: Kirkby Park B&B
episodes.description: On arrival at Peter and Sharron Sorsky's Kirkby Park B&B in Liverpool, Annette is immediately on her guard after noting the CCTV on the outside of the house.

episodes.title: Plas Dinas Country House
episodes.description: Andy and Julian Banner-Price host the competition at their swanky Plas Dinas Country House in Snowdonia, where they've allocated their guests their priciest rooms.

episodes.title: Hazelwood Farm
episodes.description: The final B&B of the week, Hazelwood Farm in Crake, Yorkshire is run by Annette, a one-woman whirlwind as she cleans and cooks everything herself in her four-star silver B&B and also provides homemade biscuits in each room.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: It's crunch time for the hoteliers as they return to Hazelwood Farm to find out who has cracked the nut and taken the top prize, and how much they have been paid.

episodes.title: The Pit Stop
episodes.description: Melvyn and Sindy kick-start the latest competition with their Morgan sports-car-themed B&B, The Pitstop, in Hertfordshire.

episodes.title: The Victory at Mersea
episodes.description: Melvyn has a reason to pick holes in Gill and Peter's bed-and-breakfast when he discovers a fissure in a bedsheet.

episodes.title: Butterfly Paragliding B&B
episodes.description: At Butterfly Paragliding B&B, on the Isle of Wight, tension builds from the outset as Wayne and Deborah discover that they will be spending the night in one of Dave's tepees in the garden.

episodes.title: Braddon Hall
episodes.description: Deborah Morrison and Wayne Bingham host at their B&B, Braddon Hall in Torquay; Melvyn and Sindy are curious to know if the B&B's chandelier is sturdy enough to do some swinging from and find their four-poster bed a little squeaky.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: The B&B owners gather for one last time - to find out how much they've been paid and reveal the winner.

episodes.title: The Old Hall Country House
episodes.description: Simon White and friend and neighbor Shirley Boyle are first to host at The Old Hall Country House, a historic 16th century B&B, in the picturesque village of Madeley in Cheshire.

episodes.title: Thornley House
episodes.description: It's day two in the competition and the turn of cat-lover Eileen Finn to cater for her B&B competitors at the four-star Thornley House in Allendale, Northumbria.

episodes.title: Chy Conyn
episodes.description: Jessica and Adrian Rashleigh, third to host, hope that they will make up for the lack in size with stunning surroundings at their three-bedroom establishment Chy Conyn in St Ives, on the beautiful Cornish coast.

episodes.title: The Cavendish
episodes.description: The guests are initially impressed with the Cavendish in Bournemouth, the 16-bed 'pink palace' from final hosts Tim and Karen, but things go downhill when Simon and Shirley vigorously test their bed - and break it.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: The rivals reconvene for one last time to find out how much they've been paid by their fellow B&B owners, and to sort out their differences; Simon White of Old Hall Country House is stunned by a generous overpayment.

episodes.title: Godshill Park Farm House
episodes.description: Mark and Kathy start the competition at their Godshill Park Farmhouse on the Isle of Wight, and their hosting skills immediately come into question as Kathy asks Kalpana and Joseph from The Address to remove their shoes because of the cream carpets.

episodes.title: Butterfly Guest House
episodes.description: Some guests at the Butterfly Guest House get worked up when they find two hairs in the bathroom, while others rejoice at finding matching spoons.

episodes.title: The Address
episodes.description: The hoteliers descend on Blackpool to check out Kalpana and Joseph's four-star townhouse; a bothersome security light blackens the experience for Ruth.

episodes.title: Crake Trees Manor
episodes.description: The group head to the Cumbrian hillsides to stay at Ruth and Mike's Crake Trees Manor; Teresa looks forward to relaxing, but she and her husband Clive are in the Shepherds Hut - outdoor accommodation without water, toilet or electricity.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: Mark and Kathy suffer a blow in the form of an underpayment, and accusations of game-playing shatter group harmony.

episodes.title: Slimmeria
episodes.description: There's a fat chance of the weight-loss retreat Slimmeria impressing all the guests with its hefty price tag.

episodes.title: 38 St Giles
episodes.description: Jan and William Cheeseman have achieved a Five Star Gold rating at 38 St Giles in Norwich, but the pursuit of perfection has been known to take its toll on this volatile pair.

episodes.title: Bosvean House
episodes.description: In Bude, Cornwall, the owners of the four-star Bosvean House have the luxury label of their establishment challenged by guests.

episodes.title: Ombersley B&B
episodes.description: Gluten-free bread causes a ruckus between Galia and Ann at the Ombersley Bed & Breakfast; the conveniences are inconveniently located.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: It's payment day, and Diane and Max feel that their rivals have stabbed them in the back; the winners are revealed.

episodes.title: Silverwood Lodge
episodes.description: Husband and wife Paul and Flora, the only couple in competition, host from the Silverwood Lodge in Cambridgeshire.

episodes.title: Seashells Guesthouse
episodes.description: In Sue's dog-themed Great Yarmouth guesthouse, Nancy brings up the issue of man's best friend sleeping in the beds.

episodes.title: The Old Court Guesthouse
episodes.description: In Bath, forthright American ex-banker Nancy Hampson isn't everybody's favorite person, so there's trouble for her from the beginning at The Old Court Guesthouse.

episodes.title: The Dean
episodes.description: Jolly Caroline treats guests to a jig, complete with bagpipe accompaniment, at The Dean on the Firth of Forth.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: It's payment day for the latest batch of hoteliers where Nancy is free with her negative comments, and comes under fire from all sides.

episodes.title: Watersedge Guest House
episodes.description: Alan and Sylvie of Watersedge Guest House in Barton on Sea, Hampshire vie for the title of best value B&B.

episodes.title: Nearwater
episodes.description: Tim and Amelia host the rival B&B owners at their non-star-rated boutique accommodation at Nearwater in Cornwall.

episodes.title: Roundhouse Hotel
episodes.description: It's Austrian-born Eva Buschmann's turn to host in her cosmopolitan boutique B&B on the Weymouth seafront, the Roundhouse Hotel.

episodes.title: Homecliffe Hotel
episodes.description: Showmen Mike and Danny host their rival B&B owners on day four at their four-star rated guest house, Homecliffe Hotel, in Blackpool.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: Tensions rise as the hoteliers reconvene to find out how much cash they can expect to see; Alan and Sylvie want to know why Tim and Amelia were complaining about their room.

episodes.title: Centery Farm
episodes.description: Steve and Beverly Green from Centery Farm in North Devon greet their guests with a warm welcome before making their way around the farmhouse to examine their rooms.

episodes.title: Little Gloster
episodes.description: The second visit of the competition is to the Little Gloster on the Isle of Wight, owned and run by 27-year-old professional chef Ben Cooke and assisted by his 81-year-old Danish grandmother Lilian, who has over 50 years' experience in the trade.

episodes.title: Old Hall House
episodes.description: It's the third day of the week's competition and Stephen's turn to host; Stephen hasn't opened up to the group yet, much to the chagrin of some of the other guests, who seem to have taken a dislike to him.

episodes.title: House of Agnes
episodes.description: The final visit of the competition is to the House of Agnes in Canterbury, run by ex-hotel inspector Sandie De Rougemont.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: On the final day, all the B&B hosts gather for one last time to find out how much they've been paid.

episodes.title: The Pavilion
episodes.description: The Pavilion is a London fashion and rock 'n' roll hotel owned by former pop singer and Lamborghini lover Danny Karne; guests are wowed by the flashy sports car parked out front and impressed by the colorful decor in the themed rooms.

episodes.title: Fox and Duck
episodes.description: The Fox and Duck in Therfield, Hertfordshire, is a country inn owned by John Luce and partner Pat Sutton; guests take lessons at the local golf club.

episodes.title: The New Inn
episodes.description: The New Inn is in Newbridge-on-Wye and is run by Dave and Debbie Lang; as a keen pig breeder, Dave likes to get his guests in the mood for breakfast with pig ornaments.

episodes.title: Westleigh Farm
episodes.description: Upon inspecting the rooms at Robert Kerstin's establishment in Somerset, Danny finds dust, cobwebs and some wrong hangers.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: As the group meets for the last time, the payments are revealed and the winning B&B is announced, but old tensions surface and there are heated exchanges around the table.

episodes.title: Guest and the City
episodes.description: Dan and Mardi Leonard welcome the others to their Brighton B&B, Guest and the City, where the guests have mixed reactions to the contemporary décor and stained-glass windows.

episodes.title: The Farmer's Boy Inn
episodes.description: Phil Kiernan, entrepreneur and proud owner of the Farmer's Boy Inn in Gloucestershire, welcomes his guests and quickly introduces them to his latest business venture: pies.

episodes.title: Geanna Hotel Boat
episodes.description: Alan and Jane welcome their first guests to their brand-new hotel boat, the Geanna; guests enjoy the novelty factor, but Dan and Mardi think that space is too tight.

episodes.title: Sentry Mead
episodes.description: Connoisseurs Sarah Langford and Jean-Pierre Kujawa have been running Sentry Mead, their 11-bedroom, five-star B&B for the past six years.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: It's the final day and the B&B hosts gather for one last time to find out how much they've been paid; some of the hosts let their emotions get away from them.

titles.title: Frightmare
titles.description: College movie buffs (Luca Bercovici, Jennifer Starrett) steal a horror-film star's (Ferdinand Mayne) corpse, and a medium brings him back.

titles.title: Galentine's Day Nightmare
titles.description: A woman's life becomes a living nightmare when she becomes the prime suspect in her boss's murder.

titles.title: Game Time
titles.description: Vance teams with Jules to play in a basketball championship duel.

titles.title: Garfunkel and Oates
titles.description: The comic/folk duo Riki Lindhome and Kate Micucci hit prime time with their act in this scripted series for IFC. It follows hard-working underdogs trying to make their mark in comedy while muddling through messy dating scenarios, and doing so by performing one satirical (and often quite saucy) song after another. Nothing stops the ukulele- and guitar-wielding twosome from singing about life's unspoken truths, despite it leaving them detached from their peers. The series is titled after Lindhome and Micucci's band name, inspired by "two famous rock 'n' roll second bananas," Art Garfunkel and John Oates.

episodes.title: The Fadeaway
episodes.description: Riki dates a fellow comic; Kate tries to subtly end a relationship; Kate auditions for a movie role outside of her comfort zone.

episodes.title: Rule 34
episodes.description: Riki and Kate find out there is a porn star version of their musical act; Garfinger and Butts.

episodes.title: Speechless
episodes.description: Riki and Kate try an experiment by going on dates without talking to see if men are attracted to women who don't speak.

episodes.title: Road Warriors
episodes.description: Riki and Kate have to deal with a heckler and a calculator magician at their 1000th show.

episodes.title: Hair Swap
episodes.description: Riki and Kate want to see how the world is different for blondes and brunettes so they trade hair colors.

episodes.title: Third Member
episodes.description: A bitter ex-bandmate turned movie star visits Riki and Kate; a bandaversary celebration; getting weed cards.

episodes.title: Eggs
episodes.description: Riki attends a baby sprinkle and afterward gets examined by a fertility doctor; Kate finds out she has Peter Pan Syndrome.

episodes.title: Maturity
episodes.description: Riki's libido increases so she seeks out her ex-boyfriend.

titles.title: Geeking Out
titles.description: Kevin Smith ("Comic Book Men," "Clerks") and Greg Grunberg ("Heroes," "Star Wars: The Force Awakens") share their deep passion for all things pop culture by taking a timely look at the genre through a fanboy lens. The 30-minute show features discussions, clips, celebrity interviews and out-of-the-studio segments.

episodes.title: Comic-Con
episodes.description: Hosts Kevin Smith and Greg Grunberg kick the show off from Comic-Con as industry experts, fans and stars discuss all things geek.

episodes.title: Nathon Fillion; Alan Tudyk; J.J. Abrams
episodes.description: Greg and Kevin grill Nathan Fillion and Alan Tudyk on their current and past projects; they interview J.J. Abrams at Universal Studios.

episodes.title: Jeph Loeb; Charlie Cox
episodes.description: Jeph Loeb discusses overseeing Marvel's television properties; Kevin and Charlie Cox discuss "Daredevil."

episodes.title: Jim Lee; Rhett Reese; Paul Wernick
episodes.description: Kevin and Greg talk with the writers of "Deadpool"; Kevin interviews DC co-publisher Jim Lee about "Suicide Squad" and DC's "Rebirth."

episodes.title: Adam Savage; The Flash; Star Trek 50th
episodes.description: Greg builds a prop replica with Adam Savage; Greg and Kevin discuss the 50th anniversary of "Star Trek"; Kevin directs The Flash.

episodes.title: Antoine Fuqua; DC Toys; Blizzard Entertainment
episodes.description: Kevin takes a tour of DC Direct toys; Tiffany explores video games at Blizzard Entertainment; Greg and Kevin talk to Antoine Fuqua.

episodes.title: Bryan Cranston; Stranger Things; McFarlane Toys
episodes.description: Greg visits Bryan Cranston then joins Tiffany for a chat with the kids from "Stranger Things;" Tiffany takes a tour of McFarlane Toys.

episodes.title: Mike Colter; Simone Missick; Lucasfilm; Valiant Comics
episodes.description: Greg and Kevin interview Mike Colter and Simone Missick from "Luke Cage"; Tiffany visits the set of Valiant's new project while Kevin tours Lucasfilm.

episodes.title: Robert Kirkman; David Alpert; Greg Nicotero; Kim Dickens
episodes.description: Greg and Kevin talk to the creative minds behind "The Walking Dead;" Tiffany and Greg talk with Kim Dickens about "Fear the Walking Dead."

titles.title: Ghost Hunters
titles.description: After terrifying and captivating fans for 11 seasons, the series that introduced the world to the field of authentic paranormal investigation returns with a familiar face and a brand-new spook squad. Grant Wilson, one of the original team leaders of "Ghost Hunters," joins a handpicked group of professionals who uses its decades of field experience to help everyday people across the country who are struggling with supernatural phenomena. The team utilizes forensic experts, historical records and the most innovative technology available to follow the evidence wherever it may lead and discover the truth behind the unexplained hauntings.

episodes.title: School Spirit
episodes.description: Grant is contacted by the principal of a century-old high school in Pocatello, Idaho, that is rumored to be haunted; the school's security cameras capture an unexplained electrical disturbance, followed by what appears to be a ghostly apparition.

episodes.title: The Lady in the Window
episodes.description: The team travels to Albion, N.Y., to help a home renovator whose dream project has become a nightmare; a tale of warring wives and tragic death on the property has Grant and the team believing the home may be haunted by one of its former matriarchs.

episodes.title: Return to St. Augustine
episodes.description: The team comes to the aid of a woman in Hanover, Penn., who has been tortured for years by unexplained activity in her home; Grant returns to the St. Augustine Lighthouse to investigate a reported increase in paranormal activity around the landmark.

episodes.title: Beyond the Investigation
episodes.description: Grant Wilson gives viewers an exclusive inside look at how the squad goes above and beyond to search for paranormal activity while deliberately debunking claims with a logical explanation.

episodes.title: The Cursed Castle
episodes.description: Guests and staff of a stately hotel find themselves seeking escape from a variety of spirits; the team learns of a history of destructive fires on the property; a forensic sketch artist is enlisted to help identify a mysterious "woman in white."

episodes.title: There's Something in the Seminary
episodes.description: Grant and the team travel to the Madison Seminary in Madison, Ohio, to help an enterprising amateur ghost hunter who got more than he bargained for when he purchased the former women's psychiatric hospital.

episodes.title: Dancing With the Dead
episodes.description: The Ghost Hunters visit the Athenaeum, which is a cultural center that has stood in the heart of Indianapolis for over 100 years.

episodes.title: Suicide Hotel
episodes.description: The team journeys to the Original Springs Hotel in Okawville, Ill., after reports of specter sightings and unexplained activity, combined with the resort's remarkably morbid history, have the owner's son concerned for the safety of his mother.

episodes.title: Home for the Haunting
episodes.description: The team comes to the aid of a single mother and her young son who are afraid that spirits in their Victorian house in Willimantic, Conn., may be a threat to their safety; Kristen investigates claims of a child's voice in an upstairs bedroom.

episodes.title: You've Been Warned
episodes.description: The former owner of the Duff Green Mansion in Vicksburg, Miss., warns the new owner of the bed-and-breakfast about the strange paranormal activity he observed at the mansion for decades, but she simply does not believe in ghosts.

episodes.title: Blood on the Bayou
episodes.description: A Louisiana woman worries that her family plantation may be haunted by its troubled past; with countless deaths on the property over the plantation's 200-year history, the list of spirits that may be present at the large estate is seemingly endless.

episodes.title: Hospital Horror
episodes.description: Cousins Luke and Chelsea purchase a hospital that was abandoned for 44 years and want to turn it into a bed-and-breakfast; their plans come to a screeching halt as strange things begin to happen soon after starting renovations.

episodes.title: Terror Town Part 1
episodes.description: Since its founding in 1873, the remote mining town of Clifton, Ariz., has been trapped in a devastating cycle of violence, mayhem and natural disaster; along with the town's brutal past comes a long history of dark paranormal experiences.

episodes.title: Terror Town Part 2
episodes.description: On their second night in the remote mining town of Clifton, Ariz., the team revisits several hubs of paranormal activity as they try to get to the bottom of the aggressive phenomena; Grant, Brandon and Brian have a breakthrough in the Boarding House.

episodes.title: Proof of Afterlife
episodes.description: Fort Stanton in New Mexico is established in the 19th century as a military post, then converted into a tuberculosis hospital; reports of paranormal activity date back to the 1940s, but a recent uptick in claims causes concerns about staff safety.

episodes.title: Nightmare Camp
episodes.description: The Perry-Mansfield Performing Arts Camp deep in northern Colorado forestland is plagued by reports of unsettling paranormal encounters; in the first professional investigation of the site, Grant sends the team ahead to begin without him.

episodes.title: Alone in Alaska
episodes.description: The team treks to Haines, Alaska, where paranormal activity is reported at the Hotel Halsingland, a converted former military outpost in a region where many once lost their lives due to extreme weather conditions, starvation and bloody conflicts.

episodes.title: Haunted Hospital
episodes.description: Since the Galena Marine Hospital's recent purchase, distressing paranormal activity has been reported and the current owner calls upon the Ghost Hunters for help; the team hears claims of heavy footsteps, six-foot shadow figures and light anomalies.

episodes.title: The Last Mission
episodes.description: Paranormal activity at the Wendover Airfield in Utah causes the staff to fear for its safety; the team investigates reports from a full-bodied apparition of a World War II soldier to a mysterious blinding light.

episodes.title: The Glenn Family Curse
episodes.description: Disturbing paranormal activity at the Glenn House in the small town of Cape Girardeau, Mo., prompts the local historical association's president to reach out to Grant for help; as the investigation begins, the house quickly lives up to its claims.

episodes.title: Ghost Hunters Return to Waverly Hills
episodes.description: The new owners of Waverly Hills Sanatorium near Louisville, Ky., receive reports of unsettling paranormal claims, including blood-curdling screams and unexplained sounds, from visitors.

titles.title: Ghost Stories
titles.description: Professor Phillip Goodman devotes his life to exposing phony psychics and fraudulent supernatural shenanigans. His skepticism soon gets put to the test when he receives news of three chilling and inexplicable cases -- disturbing visions in an abandoned asylum, a car accident deep in the woods and the spirit of an unborn child. Even scarier -- each of the macabre stories seems to have a sinister connection to the professor's own life.

titles.title: Ghost Stories
titles.description: Exploring the subject and history of ghost stories.

titles.title: Gigi Does It
titles.description: David Krumholtz ("Numb3rs," "10 Things I Hate About You") stars as Gertrude "Gigi" Rotblum, whose life changes in unexpected ways after her beloved husband dies. A secret bank account is discovered in the will, granting the 76-year-old widow with a heart of gold and a razor-sharp tongue a new lease on life. With her assistant, Ricky, tagging along, Gigi sets out to experience everything she deprived herself of in her younger years. She travels to concert festivals, tries new technologies like online dating, and generally lives life to its fullest and fastest while ignoring doctors' orders and turning the stigma of aging on its head.

episodes.title: Glock Schlock
episodes.description: Gigi Rotblum inherits her late husband's secret fortune; Gigi hires an assistant; Gigi decides to purchase a gun for protection.

episodes.title: Call Your Grandma
episodes.description: Fed up with her grandson not returning her calls, Gigi decides to write a children's book about kids who don't respect their grandmother.

episodes.title: Wart-a-Colors
episodes.description: Gigi attends a local art class to pose nude for a portrait after being tired of her lifelong body issues.

episodes.title: A Regular Kristy Yamatushy
episodes.description: Gigi quit ice skating after her late husband was injured but in her new-found freedom, decides to give it another try.

episodes.title: Eat Something
episodes.description: Gigi tries to learn how to cook a meal that will win the heart of the newest bachelor at the retirement home.

episodes.title: Let's Get Schvitzical
episodes.description: Gigi visits a sex therapist and is surprised to learn how much has changed so she enrolls in a gymnastics class to improve her flexibility.

episodes.title: Whine
episodes.description: After Gigi's frenemy, Tretchy is rude to her, Gigi decides to beat Tretchy at her own game at a charity event.

episodes.title: Love Thyself
episodes.description: Gigi decides she is ready to re-enter the Boca dating scene so she and Ricky attend a speed dating event.

titles.title: God's Pocket
titles.description: A boozy lowlife (Philip Seymour Hoffman) tries to bury the truth about his crazy stepson's suspicious death, but a nosy newspaper columnist (Richard Jenkins) and the young man's mother complicate matters.

titles.title: Graduation
titles.description: Four teenage friends plan to rob a bank to help one's family member.

titles.title: Graduation Day
titles.description: A coach (Christopher George) wearing black gloves and a stopwatch is suspected of killing high-school track stars.

titles.title: Gridlocked
titles.description: A former S.W.A.T leader and the arrogant movie star shadowing him must organize the surviving members of a training facility against a team of mercenaries who have seized the compound.

titles.title: Grotesque
titles.description: A young woman's (Linda Blair) plastic-surgeon uncle (Tab Hunter) avenges their family's massacre by punks.

titles.title: Growing Up Hip Hop
titles.description: Growing up with a famous parent isn't easy, as the children often have to work hard to emerge from their parents' shadows and gain independence -- especially if they want entertainment careers of their own. "Growing Up Hip Hop" documents the lives of a tight-knit group of friends, most of whom have at least one parent who is famous. Angela Simmons, the daughter of Run-D.M.C.'s Rev Run, is a model and fashion designer; Romeo Miller has followed in the footsteps of his father, Master P, in becoming a musician; entrepreneur Damon "Boogie" Dash is the son of former record executive Damon Dash; singer Kristinia DeBarge, the daughter of James DeBarge, struggles to choose between family and fame; TJ Mizell, a DJ whose father was Run-D.M.C. member Jam Master Jay, views Angela as family since both of their dads were in Run-D.M.C.; and aspiring singer Egypt Criss gets her talent from both mom and dad -- Pepa from Salt-N-Pepa and Treach from Naughty by Nature.

episodes.title: The Master Plan
episodes.description: Master P puts Romeo on notice to take over his music empire; a stalker threatens Angela; Kristina is blind sided.

episodes.title: The Struggle Is Real
episodes.description: A stalker strikes fear into Angela during her fashion debut; Kristinia looks for her father; a phone call rocks Romeo's world.

episodes.title: Run to Miami
episodes.description: Angela flees to Miami to dodge stalker; Kristinia's search for her father; Egypt clashes with Pepa in the studio; Romeo goes to Bulgaria.

episodes.title: O Romeo, Romeo
episodes.description: Angela gets a frightening proposal from her stalker; Pepa crashes Egypt's first photo shoot; Boogie's father runs from the law.

episodes.title: Master Player
episodes.description: Angela goes on a jealous rampage; Pepa is shocked; Kristinia gets close with Romeo; Angela becomes suspicious.

episodes.title: Master of My Fate
episodes.description: Romeo awaits Master P's approval to take over No Limit; Kristinia reunites with her father; Angela runs for her life.

episodes.title: Blinged Up, Throne Down
episodes.description: A lawsuit from Romeo's mother could destroy No Limit; Angela's sudden engagement to a mystery man shocks everyone, especially Romeo; Egypt's music career is threatened when Pepa insists she go to college.

episodes.title: Boogie Down
episodes.description: Rumors about Angela's fiancé and possible pregnancy stun Romeo; Kristinia is blindsided when a scandal resurfaces; Pepa puts Egypt's music career on hold.

episodes.title: Run in the Oven
episodes.description: Angela drops the bomb that she is pregnant; Boogie suffers the wrath of his dad when he's arrested for a DUI; Romeo's sister faces Master P about her drug addiction.

episodes.title: Immaculate Deception
episodes.description: Romeo confronts Angela for cutting him off; Angela faces scrutiny about her pregnancy; Romeo attends a family funeral and worries about his sister's addiction.

episodes.title: Only God and Janet Would Know
episodes.description: Kristinia rushes to her dad in urgent care and pushes for the truth; Boogie could face jail time; TJ visits father Jam Master Jay's grave; Kristinia gets a shocking call.

episodes.title: Busta Crime
episodes.description: Boogie gets alarming news about his DUI charges; Egypt drops a bomb on his mom, Pepa; Romeo's sisters go missing.

episodes.title: Straight Trippin'
episodes.description: Boogies gets shocking news about his DUI case; Kristinia gets a lead from the P.I.; Egypt defies Pepa's college plans; Romeo's new artist is a threat; Andre's big secret.

episodes.title: Denial Ain't Just a River in Egypt
episodes.description: Pepa catches Egypt in a lie; Kristinia gets devastating news about her dad; Kristinia and TJ bust Andre; Romeo's new artist takes partying too far; Briana's life is at risk.

episodes.title: Lie to Fly
episodes.description: Egypt's hit with an ultimatum from her rapper dad, Treach; Kristinia gets shocking news about her alleged half-sister; Angela's surprise baby shower; Briana suffers a panic attack; she faces Iman in therapy.

episodes.title: Empire State of Mind
episodes.description: No Limit is in jeopardy when Romeo is forced to choose between two empires; Andre struggles with a secret; Egypt faces a moment of truth with mom, Pepa; Angela confronts Romeo.

titles.title: Growing Up Hip Hop Atlanta
titles.description: Atlanta has become a hotbed for hip-hop music, and it is the setting for this reality series that explores what life is like for a tight-knit crew of friends, many of whom have family members who are well-known in the hip-hop community. But like any family, Atlanta's next generation of hip-hop stars do not always get along. Growing up together in the shadow of their legendary parents has established tight bonds and bitter rivalries, as they all fight for their chance to push their way into the spotlight. The well-connected Atlanta crew features, among others, Bow Wow, Da Brat, Waka Flocka Flame, Tammy Rivera, and Andrea "Drea" Kelly, the ex-wife of R. Kelly.

episodes.title: Lil' Trouble in The A
episodes.description: Danger strikes when Bow Wow returns to the dirty "A" to drop a mixtape; Jermaine Dupri gives Bow an ultimatum to build his legacy; Lil Wayne's Black Lives Matter controversy blows up; battle lines are drawn.

episodes.title: You Don't Work with Rihanna
episodes.description: Bow Wow struggles with the big decision to return to Atlanta while he faces baby mama drama; Lil Wayne's controversy escalates when Brandon and Reginae nearly come to blows at Zonnique's photo shoot.

episodes.title: Bow Down to Your Mother
episodes.description: Bow Wow returns to Atlanta to establish his legacy, but his bad boy behavior gets him in trouble with Snoop and Jermaine Dupri; after the photo shoot disaster, rivalries ensue when the mothers get involved.

episodes.title: U Don't Know Me
episodes.description: Bow Wow is blindsided when his estranged father blasts him online; Reginae clashes with Toya over her 18th birthday party; Brandon tests Ayana's relationship; Zonnique breaks down and fires Tiny.

episodes.title: Watch Me Flip, Watch Me Nae Nae
episodes.description: Bow's excuses get him into trouble with Da Brat; Deb secretly plans a reunion with Bow and his estranged dad; a fight breaks out when Brandon crashes Reginae's 18th birthday dinner and disrespects Wayne, again.

episodes.title: 99 Problems and Sound is One
episodes.description: Reginae's birthday brawl spirals out of control; Toya pops off on Brandon; Bow Wow seeks advice from Snoop Dogg when slammed by a hip-hop DJ; Brandon's first big showcase leads to disaster.

episodes.title: Pop's Locked...And Drops It
episodes.description: Deb goes against Bow's wishes and contacts his estranged father; Brandon is livid at Deb for stealing his spotlight and lashes out during auditions for Zonnique; Bow gets an unwanted visitor from his father.

episodes.title: A-Town Goin' Down
episodes.description: Bow and his estranged father face off; Deb's secret meeting sends Brandon over the edge; drama ignites at Zonnique's listening party; Bow finds danger when an anonymous text threat leads to a studio rumble.

episodes.title: Money Ain't a Thing
episodes.description: Bow Wow hops off a jet and finds himself at odds with JD; the ongoing rivalry between Brandon and Reginae over the Lil Wayne controversy becomes deadly.

episodes.title: Secrets in the A
episodes.description: Bonds are tested as Shaniah and Bow Wow struggle to keep their secrets from Jermaine Dupri; Ayana confides in her father about her health issues but receives no support; Brandon and Zonnique have a sit-down.

episodes.title: Rack It Up
episodes.description: Ayana faces a surgical scare and goes shopping for new breasts at the strip club; when Deb catches her artist, Jhonni Blaze, on the pole, all hell breaks loose; Bow faces off with Shaniah's secret man.

episodes.title: Making Moves Like Whoa
episodes.description: Unbeknownst to JD, Bow Wow drops a new song and risks it all; Ayana faces a surgical crisis while she struggles to launch her online boutique.

episodes.title: Bow Caught in Jhonni's Blaze
episodes.description: Jhonni Blaze pops up and pops off on Bow Wow in the studio; Zonnique's absence from Ayana's photo shoot triggers a war; an interview puts all the heirs on full blast.

episodes.title: The Young and the Wreckless
episodes.description: Jhonni and Bow's throw-down in the studio reaches an explosive conclusion; Ms. Deb and Bow face off; an interview with Brandon is released and raises hell among the rest of the cast members; Deb is pushed to her limit.

episodes.title: Guess Who's Back
episodes.description: Reginae and Zonnique's housewarming party is interrupted by a bang on the door, as an unwanted guest arrives to stir up trouble; Brandon's shocking interview sparks a firestorm; JD returns to Atlanta.

episodes.title: Straight Outta Time
episodes.description: JD, the Godfather of Hip Hop, returns to Atlanta and goes after Bow; Ayana goes under the knife; Brandon breaks down when Deb drops a major bomb.

episodes.title: Can't Bow Out of This One
episodes.description: Bow enters dangerous territory when he seeks out other labels behind JD and Brat's backs; Deb becomes furious when Bow is a no-show at her charity event; Brandon delivers a shock.

episodes.title: Drop the Mic
episodes.description: JD shuts things down and turns the tables on Bow Wow; Deb puts Bow on full blast for ditching her charity event; a recovered Ayana confronts Brandon about the interview and storms out.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Wild Side
