episodes.description: Bow Wow introduces his sexy new boo, Kiyomi, but everyone thinks they're moving too fast; JD questions if Bow should be a part of his So So Def 25th Anniversary Tour; Deb throws a big party, but Jhonni ruins the night with an explosive blow-up.

episodes.title: Ex and the City
episodes.description: JD is awarded a huge honor; Lil Mama hits the scene and Kiyomi's jealousy ignites; Shaniah and Ayana sense trouble in paradise; Bow Wow's old flame, Masika, returns to Atlanta with a vengeance; it's time to settle unfinished business.

episodes.title: Wild 'n Out
episodes.description: The drama between Brat and Bow comes to a head; Bow's daughter, Shai, visits; Jhonni meets with someone from Deb's past; Bow and Kiyomi take over Wild 'n Out; Bow's relationship is tested when he meets with old flame Masika for a secret rendezvous.

episodes.title: Too Lit to Quit
episodes.description: Bow causes major drama with Kiyomi when a boys' night spirals out of control; Brat warns Deb to stay away from Jhonni; Lil Mama returns to her ATL roots to make the ultimate comeback, but gets a dose of tough love from the legendary MC Lyte.

episodes.title: In My Feelings
episodes.description: After a wild night out, Bow and Kiyomi's relationship bursts into flames; Lil Mama faces scrutiny from Da Brat; Masika's vendetta against Jhonni shocks Deb; Bow goes back to his playboy lifestyle, leaving the door open for Masika to make a move.

episodes.title: Broken Heart
episodes.description: After a shocking breakup, Bow and Kiyomi struggle to move on; things run amok at Ayana's fashion show; Lil Mama enlists the help of R&B singer Kelly Price to overcome her fears in the studio; Jhonni goes ballistic in Jamaica and Deb storms off.

episodes.title: Trouble in Paradise
episodes.description: Passion and anger ignite in Jamaica; a rivalry brews when Deb cuts Jhonni loose and makes Masika an offer she can't refuse; Bow and Kiyomi's breakup becomes too much to bear; Bow reaches his boiling point; Lil Mama makes her move on a mystery man.

episodes.title: Relationship Goals
episodes.description: Brat is blind-sided when Bow puts her in the middle of his relationship; Kiyomi is shaken by Teresa's warning to stay away from Bow; drama ignites at Deb's barbecue; Lil Mama and Ms. Deb go head-to-head; Jhonni pops up; Masika is ready for a war.

episodes.title: Hour of Chaos
episodes.description: A bomb drops on Lil Mama's budding romance; Jhonni and Masika come to blows; Bow and Kiyomi's music video takes a turn; Brat throws an off-probation party during which Bow flies off into a destructive rage.

episodes.title: No Ma'am, No Ham, No Turkey
episodes.description: Bow's violent breakdown shakes Atlanta; Bow suffers blowback; Brat unleashes on Bow, and JD must step in; Teresa runs to save her son; Deb confronts unresolved issues with Brandon; Soulja Boy gives Bow advice; a blast from the past comforts Bow.

titles.title: Guerrilla: The Taking of Patty Hearst
titles.description: Director Robert Stone chronicles the bizarre story of Patty Hearst, granddaughter of newspaper magnate William Randolph Hearst. In 1974, Hearst was kidnapped by a fringe domestic terrorist group known as the Symbionese Liberation Army while attending the University of California at Berkeley. She then joined the group, taking the pseudonym "Tania." Hearst would eventually be convicted for helping the group with a bank robbery, and become a poster child for Stockholm Syndrome.

titles.title: Gypsy Rose: Life After Lock Up
titles.description: Gypsy Rose Blanchard experiences life as a free woman, including reconnecting with family and finally living with her husband Ryan Anderson for the first time.

episodes.title: Pregnant on Parole
episodes.description: Gypsy Rose Blanchard is expecting just six months after her release from prison; due to parole restrictions, a pregnant Gypsy will have to navigate two households, one in New Orleans with boyfriend Ken and one with Rod and Kristy, down the Bayou.

episodes.title: Your House or Mine?
episodes.description: With her divorce from Ryan ongoing, prepping for the baby, and Ken's upcoming move to a bigger house, Gypsy tries to manage her stress and keep her relationship with Ken on an even keel.

episodes.title: My Life is a Circus
episodes.description: As Gypsy continues to struggle with the daily online hate she faces, she decides to brave hundreds of people in real life at a public speaking engagement; she's reminded that she may never escape the reason that she's in the spotlight, her crime.

episodes.title: Who's the Daddy?
episodes.description: Online haters continue to haunt Gypsy; Gypsy faces another challenging situation as her lawyers inform her that, due to Louisiana law, the baby will have Ryan's name on the birth certificate until a court ordered paternity test is done.

episodes.title: And the Father Is...
episodes.description: As Gypsy and Ken wait for the results of their paternity test, the internet weighs in; to get a break from the scrutiny, Gypsy plans a "Babymoon" with the hope that she and Ken can inject a little passion back into their relationship.

episodes.title: Baby Shower or Breakup
episodes.description: After getting off to a rocky start with Gypsy's father, Ken tries to put his best foot forward; as Gypsy begins the final stretch of her pregnancy, Ken's mom and brother fly into town for Gypsy's baby shower.

episodes.title: I'll See You in Divorce Court
episodes.description: As divorce day nears, Ryan messages Gypsy that he misses her; rather than reply, she and Bri share the messages publicly in the hopes it will quiet some of the online hate directed at Gypsy; the negative public reaction is swift.

episodes.title: The Bumpy Road Ahead.
episodes.description: Gypsy realizes that in order to gain the ultimate independence that motherhood will require, it's time to face her fears and learn to drive; Gypsy has never so much as sat behind the wheel of a car.

episodes.title: A Baby for Christmas?
episodes.description: As Gypsy and her boyfriend Ken countdown the final weeks until their baby Aurora's due date, Ken decides to prepare a huge holiday feast for the Blanchard family to show his commitment to building a new vision of family for Gypsy.

episodes.title: I'm Not a Monster.
episodes.description: Gypsy and Ken are thrilled to welcome baby Aurora into the world!; Her early arrival bolsters Ryan's hopes that perhaps he is the father.

episodes.title: The Ultimatum
episodes.description: When Ken learns of Gypsy's plan to meet Ryan, with baby Aurora in tow, he puts his foot down and gives her an ultimatum.

titles.title: H.R. Pufnstuf
titles.description: Mayor H.R. Pufnstuf and the other residents of Living Island try to help young Jimmy, shipwrecked and led to their island, escape the evil clutches of Witchiepoo, a zany witch who wants to steal Jimmy's talking flute for her collection of magical objects. But even as Jimmy tries to keep his talking flute out of Witchiepoo's evil grasp, he is also trying to find his way back home.

episodes.title: Magic Path
episodes.description: Jimmy and his magic flute are captured by Witchiepoo, who destroys the magic path to get off Living Island.

episodes.title: The Wheeley Bird
episodes.description: Jimmy and Pufnstuf rescue Freddie from Witchiepoo's castle.

episodes.title: The Mechanical Boy
episodes.description: Witchiepoo turns Jimmy into a mechanical boy after she catches him trying to steal her boat.

episodes.title: Show Biz Witch
episodes.description: Jimmy and Pufnstuf put on a talent show to raise money to buy a supersonic pogo stick.

episodes.title: Box Kite Kaper
episodes.description: Pufnstuf builds a kite to carry Jimmy and Freddie off the island.

episodes.title: The Golden Key
episodes.description: Pufnstuf and Jimmy search for a key that opens a magic golden escape door.

episodes.title: Birthday Party
episodes.description: Witchiepoo crashes Jimmy's surprise birthday party and steals Freddie.

episodes.title: Horse With the Golden Throat
episodes.description: A horse accidentally swallows Freddie.

episodes.title: The Stand-In
episodes.description: Witchiepoo auditions for a part in a movie, while Jimmy plans to steal Broom-Broom.

episodes.title: Book, Flute and Candle
episodes.description: Jimmy goes to the castle to find an anti-mushroom spell for Freddie.

episodes.title: Dinner for Two Please Orson
episodes.description: Jimmy is turned into an old man when a time machine malfunctions.

episodes.title: You Can't Have Your Cake

titles.description: It's the early 1980s, and the spirit of innovation in personal computing is about to catch fire. Hot on the trail is a renegade trio -- a visionary, an engineer and a prodigy -- who risk everything to realize their vision of building a computer that can change the future. Not long after IBM corners the market with its flagship PC, a flaw is discovered in its operation, opening the door for competition. In steps Joe MacMillan, a former IBM executive who now works for Cardiff Electric. MacMillan plans to reverse-engineer IBM's technology, putting Cardiff in the thick of the personal computer race. He enlists the help of engineer Gordon Clark, who dreams of creating a revolutionary computer, and Cameron Howe, a volatile prodigy who puts her future on the line to join MacMillan's rogue project.

titles.title: Heartland
titles.description: This sprawling family saga takes place where an unfortunate tragedy has glued a family together to pull them through life's thick and thin moments. Follow young Amy Fleming as she slowly discovers she possesses her now-deceased mother's ability to aid injured horses as well as maintaining good relationships with those who are trying to get by one day at a time. The family pursues forgotten dreams and challenges as their strength is tested against personal struggles.

episodes.title: Greater Expectations

episodes.title: Baby on Board
episodes.description: Ty struggles with control issues when his mom stops by for an unexpected visit, in hopes of bonding with her granddaughter.

episodes.title: Highs and Lows
episodes.description: The family supports Georgie as she decides whether to face a ghost from her past.

episodes.title: Decision Time

episodes.description: Amy and Ty care for a wild mare and her foal, which provides a solution to their parenting problems.

episodes.description: Ty is asked to mentor a troubled kid, but finding common ground proves harder than he expected.

episodes.description: While on Lyndy's first camping trip, Amy and Ty find an injured animal.

episodes.description: Amy and Ty disagree about how to treat a horse when the Fairfield manager has a concern.

episodes.description: The treatment of a drugged racehorse proves a challenge for Ty and Amy, who look to an unexpected source for help; Jack and Tim are at odds.

episodes.title: Fairytale
episodes.description: Amy and Ty worry about the impact a surprise visitor will have on Luke.

episodes.description: Georgie's graduation has finally arrived but so has a mysterious figure from her past.

episodes.description: Amy is asked to spend time at an art retreat to work with an artist's allegedly traumatized horse.

episodes.description: Tim is organizing an important rodeo when an old flame blows back into Hudson asking for his help.

episodes.title: Fight or Flight
episodes.description: Amy and Ty get some unexpected news about Luke just as Amy has to face an upsetting truth about Spartan.

episodes.title: The Passing of the Torch
episodes.description: When fears of holding on or letting go grip the family, they look to each other for support through dangerous challenges.

episodes.title: Keep Me In Your Heart
episodes.description: The past year has brought unexpected change to the Heartland family; Amy deals with a major upheaval in her life; Lou copes with the reality of being the mayor of Hudson; Georgie revisits her dream of the Olympics.

episodes.title: The Last Goodbye
episodes.description: Amy must face a difficult truth when her efforts to help a young girl form a connection with her new horse takes an unexpected turn; Lou faces harsh criticism as mayor; a cattle drive brings up difficult memories for Jack.

episodes.title: Making Amends
episodes.description: Amy grudgingly helps Ty's mother, Lily, with a traumatized racehorse; Lou gets into even more hot water when she tries to sell Hudson as a "must see" tourist destination.

episodes.description: Disaster strikes Hudson when a train derails and causes an explosion that threatens the town; a wildfire quickly spreads toward the rodeo grounds and Amy rushes to save the abandoned horses there.

episodes.title: Outsiders
episodes.description: The wild, black stallion that Amy rehomed from Will's ranch is brutally forced out of the herd by the new leader; leaving Amy to track down the injured horse and nurse him back to health.

episodes.title: The New Normal
episodes.description: A group of wild horses need new homes; Amy must get back to her Miracle Girl roots and host her first horse clinic in over a year.

episodes.title: Courage
episodes.description: Tim seeks out help from an unlikely person when he finds himself competing in a polo match; Amy is concerned her daughter isn't adjusting well to her new reality; she makes a decision that worries Jack.

episodes.title: Changing Gears
episodes.description: Caleb finds a memento from the past that he thinks will have special meaning for Amy; surprisingly, it's Jack who has some mixed emotions stirred up by the gift.

episodes.title: Find Me in the Dark
episodes.description: Quinn's wealthy father arrives at Heartland with a life-changing proposition for both Amy and his son.

episodes.title: Staying the Course
episodes.description: Amy works with a challenging horse to help a friend of Clint's; she also revives a dream to rebuild the jumping course that she and Spartan practiced on so many years ago.

episodes.title: Moving Toward the Light
episodes.description: Amy must help a skeptical performer, and her pair of matched liberty horses work together again; Jack unexpectedly buys Mitch's herd of cattle; Tim returns from his trip with a surprise for everyone.

episodes.title: Runaway
episodes.description: A wild stallion escapes from Sam's ranch during a burglary and Amy will stop at nothing to find him; Lisa's latest business investment is at risk; Tim and Jessica adjust to life back at Heartland.

episodes.title: Bad Moon Rising
episodes.description: Amy discovers a teen with a gift for horses at Cooper's therapy center; Lou is pressured to shut the center down over recent break-ins; Lisa has Jack install a security system with Parker's help.

episodes.title: Sins of a Father
episodes.description: After a break-in at Heartland, unwelcome memories of his father flood Jack; Amy and Logan work with a wild horse; Tim and Parker form an unlikely duo to find the stolen goods.

episodes.title: Blood and Water
episodes.description: Amy and Shadow find themselves in jeopardy on a cattle drive; Lou feels overlooked when the issue of Heartland Beef's succession plan is raised; Parker and Katie babysit Lyndy and things go awry.

episodes.title: Happy Ever After
episodes.description: Tim and Jessica's attempt to throw a "small party" snowballs out of control; Lou struggles to hide a revived past relationship from the family; Amy and Logan continue to work with the wild horse.

episodes.title: Bluebird
episodes.description: The man who shot Ty returns to Hudson and Amy and the rest of the family grapple with how to react; Jessica enlists Katie and Parker's help to deal with a demanding Dude Ranch guest while Lou is away.

episodes.title: Brand New Day
episodes.description: Hudson hosts a lumberjack competition, and Amy must retrain a Clydesdale and his owner to compete in the draft horse race; Tim throws his hat in the ring; Lou tries to avoid a date with Fred Garland.

episodes.title: The Long Game
episodes.description: Amy enters Spartan into an endurance race after realizing he's not ready to retire; Jack is set on gentling an unbroke horse despite the danger; Lou and Katie reveal hidden feelings while camping.

episodes.title: Leaving a Legacy
episodes.description: Amy debates what to do when she receives money from an unexpected source; Lisa's racing plans are in jeopardy after an accident; Tim worries when Jessica is hiding something; Lou makes a big decision.

titles.title: Heel
titles.description: A dysfunctional couple kidnap a 19-year-old criminal, chain him up in their basement and subject him to a violent and twisted rehabilitation process. As he complies with their relentless mind games, he frantically searches for a way to escape.

titles.title: Hell of the Living Dead
titles.description: Soldiers and an Italian newswoman (Frank Garfield) meet natives turned into zombies by leaked green smoke.

titles.title: Hell on Wheels
titles.description: The Civil War is in the past, but former Confederate soldier Cullen Bohannon can't put it behind him. Fresh are the horrific memories of the death of his wife, killed at the hands of the Union soldiers, an act that sets Bohannon on a course of revenge. This contemporary Western tells the story of his journey, a story that rides on Union Pacific's construction of the first transcontinental railroad. Bohannon's westward travels take him to a lawless melting pot of a town called "Hell on Wheels," which moves with the construction of the railroad.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: A former confederate soldier journeys to the transcontinental railroad to seek vengeance.

episodes.title: Immoral Mathematics
episodes.description: Cullen fights for his life as he answers for his actions; Lily struggles to survive in the wilderness; Durant attempts to spin tragedy for political gain.

episodes.title: A New Birth of Freedom
episodes.description: Cullen is diverted in the search of the sergeant; Durant organizes a search party to find Lily Bell.

episodes.title: Jamais Je Ne T'oublierai
episodes.description: Cullen closes in on the sergeant; Durant has a hidden agenda while helping Lily recuperate.

episodes.title: Bread and Circuses
episodes.description: Durant's answer to the railroad's financial problems spurs a brawl between Cullen and Elam.

episodes.title: Pride, Pomp and Circumstance
episodes.description: Durant attempts to end ongoing negotiations with Cheyenne; Cullen and Elam scramble to prevent bloodshed in town.

episodes.title: Revelations
episodes.description: Cullen must decide how much he is willing to risk; Durant faces financial ruin; Lily confronts the family of her late husband.

episodes.title: Derailed
episodes.description: Cullen and Elam are on a mission of vengeance; Lily struggles to find her place.

episodes.title: Timshel
episodes.description: Cullen and Lily work to meet the railroad's deadline; Elam and Joseph deal with the consequences of their violent mission.

episodes.title: God of Chaos
episodes.description: Cullen must choose between to dwell on the past or look forward to the future.

titles.title: Hello Horror
titles.description: Join Vanessa Decker for a horror variety show filled with spooky guests, red carpet events, haunted houses, creepy cocktails and more.

episodes.title: Baby Seal for Hire
episodes.description: Vanessa and guest Sammi Doll attempt lip-reading and put together a terrifying lunch with a few drawbacks.

episodes.title: Dudes Cutting Rug
episodes.description: Visiting Los Angeles' Haunted Hayride, and the Icons of Darkness exhibit in Hollywood.

episodes.title: Don't Get Out of the Car
episodes.description: A horror variety show filled with spooky guests, red carpet events, haunted houses, creepy cocktails, and more.

titles.title: Hellraiser: Revelations
titles.description: Two friends in Mexico discover the Lament Configuration and unleash Pinhead, but one decides to try to survive by swapping himself with someone else. Once they go missing, family members go in search of them, but find Pinhead instead.

titles.title: Heretic
titles.description: A modern-day psychic using occult practices to communicate with the dead experiences an evil beyond human comprehension.

titles.title: Hickok
titles.description: Legendary gunslinger Wild Bill Hickok looks to leave the past behind him by settling in the small town of Abilene, Kan., and becoming the marshal. His unparalleled skills are soon put to the test when he finds himself in a showdown with a gang of outlaws and the powerful saloon owner who put a bounty on his head.

titles.title: Highlander
titles.description: When the mystical Russell Nash (Christopher Lambert) kills a man in a sword fight in a New York City parking lot, he leaves a sliver of an ancient weapon lodged in a car in the process. After brilliant forensics specialist Brenda Wyatt (Roxanne Hart) recovers evidence of the mysterious weapon, she and her partner, Lt. Frank Moran (Alan North), embark on an investigation Of Nash that will land them in the middle of a dangerous, centuries-old feud between powerful immortals.

titles.title: Highlander
titles.description: Duncan MacLeod cannot die -- well, unless you cut off his head. He is a 400-year-old immortal, who has seen his share of humanity's bad side. Still, he risks his life to save people from harm.

episodes.title: The Gathering
episodes.description: Immortal Duncan MacLeod (Adrian Paul) leaves tranquility when kinsman Connor (Christopher Lambert) asks him to battle evil Slan Quince (Richard Moll).

episodes.title: Family Tree
episodes.description: When his protégé, Richie Ryan, seeks his birth parents, Duncan relives painful memories of his own family ties.

episodes.title: The Road Not Taken
episodes.description: A once-good Immortal obsessed with dominating humankind matches wits with Duncan, who wants to prevent him from hurting more people.

episodes.title: Innocent Man
episodes.description: A homeless veteran (Vincent Schiavelli) is wrongly charged with the grisly murder of one of Duncan's Immortal friends. With Adrian Paul, Alexandra Vandernoot.

episodes.title: Free Fall
episodes.description: When a wily Immortal falls to her "death," Richie comes to her rescue and a cautious Duncan becomes her mentor.

episodes.title: A Bad Day in Building A
episodes.description: MacLeod, Tessa and Richie are among the courthouse hostages when a convicted felon and his elite mercenary team orchestrate an escape.

episodes.title: Mountain Men
episodes.description: A rugged Pacific Northwest mountain man falls in love with Tessa after she is kidnapped by his band of survivalists.

episodes.title: Deadly Medicine
episodes.description: After seeing Duncan's miraculous recovery from what should have been a fatal accident, a doctor kidnaps the Highlander to study his recuperative powers.

episodes.title: The Sea Witch
episodes.description: Memories of smuggling refugees out of Stalinist Russia haunt Duncan as he tries to save Tessa, Richie and himself from a vicious drug lord.

episodes.title: Revenge Is Sweet
episodes.description: An Immortal (Christophe Ort) uses his lover (Vanity) in an attempt to draw Duncan (Adrian Paul) into a final confrontation. Also stars Tim Reid.

episodes.title: See No Evil
episodes.description: Duncan relives the past as he tries to get to the bottom of a series of killings identical to those committed by an Immortal decades ago.

episodes.title: Eyewitness
episodes.description: MacLeod suspects an Immortal may be involved when Tessa claims to have witnessed the murder of a painter and no one believes her.

episodes.title: Band of Brothers
episodes.description: Darius, a 2,000-year-old friend of MacLeod's, asks him to protect a protégé being stalked by a ruthless Immortal.

episodes.title: For Evil's Sake
episodes.description: Duncan (Adrian Paul) hunts down an evil Immortal (Peter Howitt) who has acted successfully as an assassin throughout history. With Alexandra Vandernoot.

episodes.title: For Tomorrow We Die
episodes.description: Duncan must prevent further slaughter by a hedonistic Immortal who has lived by ruthlessly robbing and killing people throughout the ages.

episodes.title: The Beast Below
episodes.description: A simple-minded Immortal who Duncan last saw at the door of a medieval monastery now haunts the underground tunnels of a Parisian opera house.

episodes.title: Saving Grace
episodes.description: A good Immortal seeks Duncan's help in fending off an obsessive Immortal who killed her lover and is trying to pin the murder on her.

episodes.title: Lady and the Tiger
episodes.description: Immortal Amanda plans a high-stakes burglary, but a former partner has escaped prison and wants her head.

episodes.title: Eye of the Beholder
episodes.description: A model leads Richie into danger when he runs afoul of a world-class fashion designer who is a deadly Immortal.

episodes.title: Avenging Angel
episodes.description: A delusional Immortal vigilante, who is determined to eradicate perversion, encounters the Highlander in his crusade against corruption.

episodes.title: Nowhere to Run
episodes.description: Duncan is caught in the middle when the son of one of Tessa's friends rapes the stepdaughter of a vengeful Immortal.

episodes.title: The Hunters
episodes.description: In agony over the death of their friend Darius, Duncan and another Immortal go in search of a group of mortals bent on their destruction.

titles.title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren
titles.description: Explore the impact of machines on history, including the printing press, the Model T and early personal computers.

episodes.title: Aerial Attackers
episodes.description: Feel the thunderous might of the Cold War's atomic cannon, soar with the B-17 bomber that helped win WWII, and witness the cutting-edge technology of today's F-35 stealth fighter jet; guided by Dolph Lundgren, explore the sky-high innovations that gave armies the unbeatable edge in the air.

episodes.title: Mission Critical
episodes.description: When the mission looks impossible, you call in special ops - and Dolph Lundgren. Join him as he takes you behind enemy lines to reveal the elite machines behind history's boldest operations, from the stealth helicopter that hunted Bin Laden, the silent WWII carbine that made British commandos ghosts, and an insect-sized recon drone giving troops eyes inside enemy strongholds; it's next-level tech for next-level, previously impossible missions.

titles.title: History's Mystery Files
titles.description: Revisiting history's unforgettable cases, from sacred discoveries and bizarre weapons to unsolved disappearances and high strangeness.

episodes.title: Hidden Treasures
episodes.description: The search for treasure doesn't always lead to ancient ruins; sometimes, priceless history is concealed inside a home, buried among unwanted possessions, or waiting unnoticed at a garage sale.

episodes.title: Puzzling Places
episodes.description: Across the globe, certain locations seem to resist explanation; from Japan's infamous "suicide forest" and enigmatic Knights Templar tunnels, to a top-secret wartime compound in Virginia; each holds clues to mysteries that have endured for generations.

titles.title: Hoarders SOS
titles.description: Across the UK thousands of us live our lives surrounded by too much stuff.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: In Newcastle, Curtis Dowling needs to persuade a passionate collector to part with more than a thousand toy cars; in London, Joanna Riley has to sort through a mountain of shoes and clothes that have overtaken a woman's home.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: The team helps a man who can't say no to his family's unwanted stuff; a potter and self-proclaimed hoarder needs to be persuaded to part with hundreds of her pots to free up space.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: Declutter expert Joanna Riley can't even get into the garage, where clutter includes 16 vacuum cleaners.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: Curtis Dowling and Joanna Riley help a Birmingham couple sell their huge toy and film memorabilia collections.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: An artist has filled his house with mementos from his travels; a couple's collections of toys and costumes have taken over their home.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: Curtis, Joanna and Marianne are in Blackpool with a theatrical costume maker and his actor partner, trying to persuade them to part with a mountain of clothes and antiques.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: Collectibles experts help a woman sell stuff she bought in New York in the 1960s.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: A woman in Lincolnshire makes a Hoarder SOS to clear the clutter taking over her home; she desperately wants space on the sofa to have a cuddle with her husband.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: The team help two households whose clutter is so catastrophic it is taking over their homes; Marianne helps an HR consultant tackle a mountain of clothes, including her designer wedding dress.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: A costume maker from Chester makes a hoarder SOS because her house is crammed with enough fabric to open her own shop.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: Antiques expert Curtis Dowling, housekeeper Marianne Cammack, and cleaning company owner Joanna Riley are in Wales helping a former cabaret singer let go of a mountain of clothes and jewelry.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: The experts try to persuade a Cambridgeshire woman to part with her piles of perfume bottles and clothes; a couple in Sheffield clear out decades' worth of record collections and household clutter for a very special cause close to their hearts.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: Collectibles expert Curtis Dowling and queens of clean Joanna Riley and Marianne Cammack help two households de-clutter their homes and make some cash.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: Two friends who have house shared for seven years in Lancashire make a Hoarder SOS call to help them rid their home of an eclectic mix of clutter, from fantasy board games to a valuable vintage leather jacket.

episodes.title: Hoarders SOS
episodes.description: A woman who used to sell vintage things but kept lots for herself asks for help to clear a clutter mountain.

titles.title: Hollow Gate
titles.description: Four teenagers go to a Halloween party hosted by a dog owner with mayhem on his mind.

titles.title: Hollywood Dreams & Nightmares: The Robert Englund Story
titles.description: Since first donning a tattered fedora and a glove of eviscerating blades in 1984, Robert Englund has become a beloved horror icon. His portrayal of Freddy Krueger is without doubt a moment as visceral to the horror genre as Chaney's werewolf or Karloff's groundbreaking realization of Frankenstein's monster. However, few realize the depths of Englund's true power as a character actor away from the latex mask and iconic red and green jumper.

titles.title: Homeless to Harvard: The Liz Murray Story
titles.description: Living on the streets, a teenager (Thora Birch) returns to high school, earns her diploma and gets a college scholarship.

titles.title: Horns
titles.description: Blamed for the murder of his girlfriend, a man (Daniel Radcliffe) awakes one morning to find he has grown a pair of horns. Armed, now, with supernatural powers, he sets out to find the killer.

titles.title: Hostel
titles.description: Best friends Josh (Derek Richardson) and Paxton (Jay Hernandez) decide to spend the summer after college graduation on an all-out backpacking trip across Europe. While stopping in Amsterdam to indulge their tastes for drugs and sex, they meet Oli (Eythor Gudjonsson), a like-minded traveler from Iceland. When the three bachelors set off to investigate enticing rumors of a Slovakian hostel in a city populated by lusty women, they find themselves drawn unwittingly into a deadly game.

titles.title: Hostel Part II
titles.description: Beth (Lauren German), Lorna (Heather Matarazzo) and Whitney (Bijou Phillips), three young American women traveling abroad in Rome, decide to take a weekend excursion. Lured from their intended destination by a beautiful acquaintance (Vera Jordanova), the women anticipate a stay at a luxurious spa. Instead, they become pawns in a grisly game designed to entertain wealthy deviants from around the world.

titles.title: House of Curves
titles.description: Kenyatta Jones, an Atlanta-based fashion designer who specializes in designing clothes for plus-size women, is the CEO of clothing boutique Bella René, named after her mother and main investor. Jones and her team, which includes her two close friends from college and an assistant with attitude, go to great lengths to expand the brand, but mishaps and in-house bickering hinder the dream. The ultimate test comes when the team competes for recognition in one of the world's top cities for fashion: New York.

episodes.title: Full Fashion Frenzy
episodes.description: Kenyatta and her team prepare for Belle Rene's Spring Fashion Show.

episodes.title: Who's the B in the Skinny Jeans
episodes.description: Egos flare when Kenyatta hires a new Bella Rene team member; Kendra and Kelli rumble at the spring lookbook photo shoot and Kenyatta reveals her high-fashion line.

episodes.title: Chubby Chasers
episodes.description: Team Bella Rene recruits plus-size models; Kenyatta and the girls stake out Phil at a nightclub.

episodes.title: Junk in the Trunk Show
episodes.description: Mama Rene puts a stop on spending; Sherlynda finds ways to rock the high-fashion fall line.

episodes.title: Drama at the Big Show
episodes.description: Kenyatta debuts Bella Rene's high-fashion fall line; Sherlynda takes aim at Kendra's job.

episodes.title: Fat Chance in New York
episodes.description: Kenyatta looks to impress NYC's plus-size fashion world; Kendra is demoted.

titles.title: Housebound
titles.description: A would-be thief (Morgana O'Reilly) is remanded to the custody of her estranged mother (Rima Te Wiata), who turns out to be correct in her assertion that evil spirits are afoot in their family domicile.

titles.title: How to Survive a Plague
titles.description: In the late 1980s, members of Act-Up and other AIDS activists battle indifference and hostility to bring attention to the disease and play a huge role in reducing the number of AIDS-related fatalities in the U.S.

titles.title: Howling III
titles.description: An Australian scientist (Barry Otto) finds marsupial werewolves, one of whom (Imogen Annesley) finds work in a horror movie.

titles.title: Humanoids From the Deep
titles.description: A fisherman (Doug McClure) and a scientist (Ann Turkel) fight back when mossy sea monsters assault women.

titles.title: Humpday
titles.description: Two college buddies reunite after a decade apart. Ben (Mark Duplass) is married and planning to start a family; Andrew (Joshua Leonard), a free spirit, has spent the last 10 years traveling the globe. Reigniting the rivalries of their college years, the friends agree to enter a movie in an upcoming amateur porn festival. Ben and Andrew's constant need to one-up each other results in a daring proposition: The staunchly heterosexual friends must star together in a gay adult film.

titles.title: Hunger
titles.description: Focusing on the 1981 hunger strikes by Republican prisoners in Northern Ireland. Bobby Sands is one of a group of prisoners who first "took to the blanket" with a "dirty protest" in pursuit of their claims for recognition as political prisoners. Sands then became the first one of the group to embark on a hunger strike that was to end in his death.

titles.title: Hungry Hearts
titles.description: A new mother's increasingly unstable behavior threatens her relationship with her husband (Adam Driver) and the life of her infant.

titles.title: I Am Love
titles.description: At a dinner -- during which her husband, Tancredi (Pippo Delbono), learns that he and his son Edoardo Recchi Jr. (Flavio Parenti) are about to assume control of the Edoardo Recchi Sr.'s (Gabriele Ferzetti) lucrative business -- Emma (Tilda Swinton) meets a chef named Antonio (Edoardo Gabbriellini). Antonio and Emma soon find themselves in bed together. With the family already divided over the elder Recchi's unusual plans, Emma's affair is the wild card that might divide the family for good.

titles.title: I Am Not Your Negro
titles.description: In 1979, James Baldwin wrote a letter to his literary agent describing his next project, "Remember This House." The book was to be a revolutionary, personal account of the lives and assassinations of three of his close friends: Medgar Evers, Malcolm X and Martin Luther King, Jr. At the time of Baldwin's death in 1987, he left behind only 30 completed pages of this manuscript. Filmmaker Raoul Peck envisions the book James Baldwin never finished.

titles.title: I Saw the Devil
titles.description: On a dark road, taxi driver Kyung-chul comes across a scared female motorist stranded in a broken-down vehicle. He pulls over -- but not to help her. When the woman's head is discovered in a local river, her devastated fiancé, Kim Soo-hyeon, a trained secret agent, becomes obsessed with hunting down her killer. Once he finds Kyung-chul, things get twisted. After brutally beating the murderer, Kim lets him go free, and a demented game of cat and mouse begins.

titles.title: I Want My Name Back
titles.description: The rise, fall and rise again of original members of The Sugarhill Gang.

titles.title: I Wish
titles.description: Forced to live apart due to their parents' separation, a sixth-grader (Koki Maeda) and his younger brother (Ohshiro Maeda) hatch a complicated plan to reunite their family.

titles.title: Immortal Demon Slayer
titles.description: Five hundred years before the Monkey King wreaks havoc on the heavenly kingdom, Wukong refuses to bow down to his destiny when he sets out to rebel against the gods.

titles.title: In Order of Disappearance
titles.description: A mild-mannered snowplow driver (Stellan Skarsgard) ignites an underworld gang war when he seeks revenge for the murder of his son.

titles.title: In the Fade
titles.description: Katja's life falls apart in the blink of an eye when two neo-Nazis kill her husband and 6-year-old son in a bomb attack. Her quest for justice soon pushes her to the edge as the two suspects stand trial for murder.

titles.title: In the Fire of War
titles.description: A young Māori girl guides her people into a brutal battle against colonial British forces during the New Zealand Wars in 1864.

titles.title: In the Loop
titles.description: During an interview, British Cabinet Minister Simon Foster (Tom Hollander) delivers an off-the-cuff remark that war in the Middle East is unforeseeable. Profane political spin doctor Malcolm Tucker (Peter Capaldi) tries to cover up Foster's faux pas, but the ill-conceived comment is picked up by a warmongering American official. Foster is invited to Washington, D.C., where a war of words brews as politicians maneuver, manipulate and deceive each other before a U.N. vote on military action.

titles.title: Incarnation
titles.description: Young couple Brad and Jess move to Los Angeles in search of a better life. When they stumble upon a hidden real estate gem, the pair are elated. However, their ideal home hides a secret far more sinister than they ever could have imagined.

titles.title: Inferno
titles.description: A young man (Leigh McCloskey) returns from Rome to his sister's (Irene Miracle) satanic New York apartment house.

titles.title: Interrogation Raw
titles.description: Telling the stories of dramatic murders and other serious crimes through the interrogation of the accused, intercut with interviews with key players along with relevant news footage and archival material, including trial footage.

episodes.title: War of the Wilders
episodes.description: A young mother is found murdered in her home, leading detectives to question whether her fiancé or ex-husband could be responsible for her death.

episodes.title: Evil, Hateful and Lowdown
episodes.description: After a house fire that took the life of a bedridden man is deemed intentional, evidence leads detectives to a close family member who lit the match.

episodes.title: Houseguest Horror
episodes.description: An elderly man is found shot to death in his backyard; the investigation leads to a young woman he welcomed into his home; as evidence pours in, her web of lies begins to unravel and detectives suspect the houseguest knows more than she's letting on.

episodes.title: Concrete Evidence
episodes.description: After a Florida man is reported missing, detectives zero in on his roommate, the last person to see him, before receiving a tip that breaks the case wide open.

episodes.title: Ordered to Kill
episodes.description: When a young Missouri couple is found shot to death on their porch, detectives uncover a sinister murder plot masterminded by someone within their inner circle.

episodes.title: The Bad Review
episodes.description: After a Missouri man is brutally stabbed to death in his own bed, detectives discover a sex worker who may have wanted him silenced.

episodes.title: Killed for Convenience
episodes.description: Detectives hope a woman can identify her attacker as she fights for her life after being shot in the face, and investigators race to get a confession after a man is gunned down in a motel parking lot.

episodes.title: Friends Who Kill
episodes.description: After a young father is strangled to death and abandoned on a remote country road, authorities must track down and interrogate a group of friends who each have something to hide.

episodes.title: Twisted Mind of a Killer
episodes.description: When a young woman is found murdered and an elderly couple is reported missing, investigators cross state lines to track down a man they believe is responsible.

episodes.title: Twisted Sisterhood
episodes.description: When a beloved father is shot to death in his own home, detectives unravel an unexpected plot devised by his inner circle.

episodes.title: Vanished Into the Night
episodes.description: In Northern California, a young woman goes missing after a night out on the town; detectives interview several people who saw her that evening, including one whose memory of the night does not add up.

episodes.title: Murder On A Haunted Road
episodes.description: When an aspiring musician goes missing in South Carolina, police turn their attention to his roommates and a trip they took to a local "haunted" road.

episodes.title: Justice for a War Hero
episodes.description: Neighbors find an elderly veteran injured claiming he was kidnapped and beaten; as the 91-year-old's health rapidly declines, pressure mounts for detectives to obtain a confession from the perpetrators and get justice for the decorated war hero.

episodes.title: A Hitman for the Heartbroken
episodes.description: When a beloved pediatric dentist is shot dead in a parking garage, what appears to be a random homicide turns into an international manhunt; detectives uncover a sinister stalking plan executed by a hired hitman.

episodes.title: Stabbed in the Heart
episodes.description: Investigators search for answers from a teenager they suspect brutally stabbed his two high school friends; Detectives push for a confession from a jealous boyfriend after his rival is callously stabbed to death.

titles.title: Into the Badlands
titles.description: AMC's goal for "Into the Badlands" was twofold: produce a compelling character drama, and introduce the highest caliber of martial arts filmmaking to a weekly, ongoing series. Left in the hands of creators Alfred Gough and Miles Millar ("Shanghai Noon," "Smallville"), the series stars Daniel Wu as ruthless, prodigiously skilled warrior Sunny, who mentors teenage boy M.K. during a spiritual journey across a feudal civilization known as the Badlands. With the help of trained assassins like Sunny, the area is ruled by rival barons, and for decades Quinn has consistently outflanked and outmaneuvered his fellow barons to keep the upper hand. His invincibility, however, begins to fade in light of brazen attacks by the newest baron, The Widow, who believes M.K. is the key to her success. As the battle for control of the Badlands heats up, the destinies of the stoic assassin and the impetuous teenager become intertwined.

episodes.title: The Fort
episodes.description: The Badlands' deadliest Clipper rescues a mysterious boy with a dark secret, but who may know the way out.

episodes.title: Fist Like a Bullet
episodes.description: M.K. finds refuge in a dangerous place; Quinn tries to force Sunny to commit an unspeakable act, thereby testing Sunny's loyalties.

episodes.title: White Stork Spreads Wings
episodes.description: Sunny begins training M.K.; Quinn seeks retribution against The Widow.

episodes.title: Two Tigers Subdue Dragons
episodes.description: Sunny and M.K. try to figure out how to control the boy's power; Quinn sets a dangerous parlay with a rival Baron to help fight The Widow.

episodes.title: Snake Creeps Down
episodes.description: Sunny secures his escape from the Fort, and Quinn grows suspicious; the Widow's decisions set her on a collision course with Sunny and M.K.

episodes.title: Hand of Five Poisons
episodes.description: Sunny and M.K. fight to escape Quinn's grip once and for all; the Baron's enemies conspire to take him down and change the Badlands forever.

titles.title: Ip Man: Kung Fu Master
titles.description: Framed for the murder of a ruthless but honorable mobster, Ip Man becomes targeted for vengeance by his dangerous daughter. Forced to resign as police captain, Ip must also contend with the arrival of the Japanese army in Guangzhou, China.

titles.title: Janis: Little Girl Blue
titles.description: Archival footage and interviews highlight the life and career of singer-songwriter Janis Joplin, from her musical rise in the 1960s to her battle with alcohol and heroin addiction.

titles.title: Jenny's Wedding
titles.description: When Jenny (Katherine Heigl) decides to marry a woman (Alexis Bledel), her conventional family must accept who she is or risk losing her forever.

titles.title: Jesus Camp
titles.description: Filmmakers Heidi Ewing and Rachel Grady visit an evangelical Christian summer camp called Kids on Fire, where children take part in programs designed to strengthen and intensify their beliefs. The camp's founder, Becky Fischer, discusses her mission to indoctrinate youths in the word of God, while young campers play certain combat video games and talk about their love for Jesus.

titles.title: Jiro Dreams of Sushi
titles.description: Revered sushi chef Jiro Ono strives for perfection in his work, while his eldest son, Yoshikazu, has trouble living up to his father's legacy.

titles.title: John Edward Cross Country
titles.description: Self-proclaimed psychic John Edward travels the highways and byways of America to offer intimate and detailed individual readings for clients who are seeking answers and reassurances about their dearly departed.

episodes.title: Soul Survivor
episodes.description: The medium uses his psychic abilities to try to connect people with loved ones who have died.

episodes.title: Mother Forever, Friends for Life
episodes.description: In Phoenix, John connects Angie with her daughter, Amber, who leads John to another woman named Jenny Lee, setting in motion a mysterious coincidence for Angie.

episodes.title: Soul Mates
episodes.description: John meets Diane who remains distraught because, following the death of her husband, military benefits were denied at his funeral.

episodes.title: Mothers and Sons
episodes.description: Molly and Patrick are desperately missing their son, Jack, following his demise in a tragic car accident, prompting John to work his special brand of magic.

episodes.title: Healing Journeys
episodes.description: Globally renowned psychic John Edward takes his show across America, reconnecting families with their deceased loved ones.

episodes.title: To Each His Own
episodes.description: Globally renowned psychic John Edward takes his show across America, reconnecting families with their deceased loved ones.

episodes.title: Little Teaching Soul
episodes.description: Tracey feels the presence of her late father.

episodes.title: The Wedding Blessing
episodes.description: John meets Elissa, who wants to find out if her grandfather can walk her down the aisle at her wedding.

episodes.title: From Heartbreak to Healing
episodes.description: John Edward gets messages for Eva and Pat.

episodes.title: Maternal Words
episodes.description: John connects a grieving mother with her daughter who passed tragically in an automobile accident; a mother on the other side comes through with a warning for her daughter; actress Lorraine Bracco holds a seance.

episodes.title: The Ties That Bind
episodes.description: John Edward meets family members who have come to support a young widow.

episodes.title: Father's Day
episodes.description: A father tells his son that he loves him.

episodes.title: Cherished Friends
episodes.description: Sheri, Kate, Suzi and Gabi get messages from friends who have passed on.

episodes.title: Siblings
episodes.description: John attempts to comfort three sisters whose younger sibling has passed away; a message to a mother from her deceased son.

episodes.title: Students and Teachers
episodes.description: A widow talks to her departed husband.

episodes.title: Sons and Stars
episodes.description: John has comforting words for a woman whose son passed away; a family reconnects with a loved one who was the life of the party.

episodes.title: Brothers and Sisters
episodes.description: A man seeks a reunion with a brother who died in a motorcycle accident; three women want to speak to their deceased sister; Vanessa and Chris Williams attempt to speak with their father.

episodes.title: No Coincidences
episodes.description: One of the show's cameramen gets a reading; Broadway lyrics bring hope to a grieving family; actress Eileen Davidson wants to reconnect with her deceased father.

episodes.title: Pieces of the Puzzle
episodes.description: Answers are sought in the death of a young father at the hands of a SWAT team; parents want to talk to their deceased teenage daughter; television personality Catherine Oxenberg gets a reading.

episodes.title: Living Legacies
episodes.description: A family keeps their dead relative's legacy alive through his recipes; a man seeks to speak with his recently passed wife; technical difficulties occur during a reading.

episodes.title: A Mother's Love
episodes.description: A mother receives a message from her daughter who passed mysteriously; a son comes through to his mother with more than just words of love.

episodes.title: Hearing the Message
episodes.description: Bill and his daughter Tiffany come to the studio hoping to hear from Tiffany's mother; Crystal needs to hear a particular message from her dad; predictions for Sheryl Lee Ralph.

episodes.title: Always Blessings, Never Losses
episodes.description: A son has a message for his mother who is not in studio; Mary's father offers words of encouragement from the other side; touring the set of "Ghost Whisperer."

episodes.title: Bonds Restored
episodes.description: Actor Ronn Moss ("The Bold and the Beautiful").

episodes.title: Evolving
episodes.description: A woman has a chance to connect with her son and brother; a mother in the hereafter has a message that she hopes will help her daughter; Char Margolis does a reading.

episodes.title: Soul Print
episodes.description: A husband on the other side comes through with validations for the family; a brother comes through for a woman who has carried decades of anger; John sits with television personality Leeza Gibbons.

episodes.title: Guidance From the Other Side
episodes.description: A young man comes to the studio with his two aunts and hears from his mother; a mother on the other side has lessons for her son and his father; actress Shanna Moakler sits with John in Los Angeles.

titles.title: Judge Mom
titles.description: Bringing a mother's tough love and common sense to resolving real world disputes with cheating spouses, sneaky roommates, creepy landlords, disappointing friends, greedy siblings and scheming coworkers.

episodes.title: Alienated Whistleblower
episodes.description: Jennifer Lozada is suing her husband and his mistress for alienation of affection.

episodes.title: Psychic promises
episodes.description: Mario is suing the neighborhood psychic Lydia after promising to remove his curse for a fee.

episodes.title: Daddy Dearest
episodes.description: Giselle is suing her father for $145,000 for the cost of canceling her wedding and for emotional distress.

episodes.title: Franken-dress
episodes.description: Guadalupe is suing Thomas, the owner of a Quinceañera dress shop, for pain, suffering and the dress.

episodes.title: Will-fully Repugnant
episodes.description: Wilbur and his wife are suing his sister, Jennifer, after their son was left out of their grandmother's will.

episodes.title: Tickets to lies
episodes.description: Miguel is suing his ex-girlfriend for the $5 million that she won on a scratch-off ticket.

episodes.title: Baby Blues
episodes.description: Ariana Garcia, 19, sues her parents for refusal to acknowledge and respect her privacy and boundaries.

episodes.title: Anniversary Blowout
episodes.description: Gabriella is suing her former employer for $600,000 for mental anguish and wrongful termination.

episodes.title: Piglet Parade
episodes.description: Michelle is suing Michael and Nuri for negligence and business loss after her high-end spa was damaged.

episodes.title: For Love or Money
episodes.description: Evelyn sues Dexter for $500,000, saying he tricked her into leaving her marriage, causing financial ruin and distress; Dexter denies, saying she pursued him as a gold digger.

episodes.title: Battle Royale
episodes.description: Jonah sues ex-friend Elliot for defamation and IP theft, aiming to disband The Wizarding Warband.

episodes.title: Car Service Scandals
episodes.description: Damien sues Sal for $35 million, alleging car service ruined his marriage; Sal pleads not guilty.

episodes.title: Ink is Best Served Cold
episodes.description: Michael Brown sues Victor Hernandez, the Savage Skin tattoo shop owner, for $50,000; he alleges Victor maliciously altered his tattoo design due to a grudge over dating Victor's ex, causing an embarrassing tattoo.

episodes.title: Tornado Tassel
episodes.description: Barbara sues Emilio's strip club for $30,000, alleging negligence and emotional distress; she blames a collapsing chair among other things; Emilio denies responsibility, citing Barbara's drinking and disregard for safety.

episodes.title: Caught in the Act
episodes.description: Guillermo Logan sues Nancy Grant for $5 million, alleging false imprisonment and mental anguish after getting trapped by her security system during a burglary; Nancy defends her system and questions Guillermo's criminal history.

episodes.title: Shadows of Doubt
episodes.description: Samantha sues Elizabeth and P.I. Ricardo for $40,000 over false accusations; Samantha claims harassment and defamation after Elizabeth hired Ricardo, and he wrongly accused Samantha.

episodes.title: Nuptial Nemesis
episodes.description: Annie sues ex-best friend Olivia for $150,000, claiming emotional distress; Olivia, the former maid of honor, hijacked Annie's wedding plans, changing the venue and dresses; Olivia claims she improved the wedding.

episodes.title: Little League, Big Problems
episodes.description: The Wilsons sue Sean Moore, Ballpark Bandits sponsor, for $10,000 after their son got fired mid-season; Sean blames Kevin's erratic behavior and Laurie for fostering negativity.

episodes.title: Waisting Away
episodes.description: Erica Green is suing her ex-trainer Susan White for emotional distress and fraud, seeking $15,000; Erica gained 25lbs in Susan's Waist Away program instead of losing weight; Susan blames Erica's non-commitment and countersues for defamation.

episodes.title: Rascal Roy & HOA Nightmare
episodes.description: Mindy Santez sues Roy Franklin for $2 million, claiming Roy's drunken scooter incident ruined Timmy's Olympic career; Mindy claims Roy's ongoing violations led to harassment and Roy claims he'd been repeatedly targeted.

episodes.title: Conception, Deception
episodes.description: Maddy sues Vanessa for theft and emotional distress, seeking $300,000; their IVF journey soured due to suspicions of cheating and missing money; Maddy discovered an affair with Tyler, a mutual friend.

episodes.title: The Hero-Con
episodes.description: Daniel sues Jeremy for $800,000, alleging copyright infringement over a Nightshade Ninja costume that he alleges is a copy of his Shadow Shogun; Jeremy denies this, claiming his was original.

episodes.title: Deflated Love
episodes.description: Chris sues ex-wife Lisa for $10,000, citing emotional distress and property damage; he says Lisa punctured his emotional support doll, Dolly; Lisa denies it, blaming Chris's objectophilia and claiming Dolly deflated when he sat on it.

titles.title: June
titles.description: An orphan who has left a trail of damaged foster homes in her wake finally settles in with Lily and Dave Anderson. When she becomes the vessel of a malicious spirit, the family will have to discover her true identity.

titles.title: Just Wright
titles.description: Physical therapist Leslie Wright (Queen Latifah) lands the dream job of working with basketball superstar Scott McKnight (Common). All goes well until Leslie finds that she is falling in love with him. Scott, however, is oblivious to Leslie's romantic overtures and focuses his attention on Morgan (Paula Patton), Leslie's gorgeous friend, who would love to be the basketball player's trophy wife.

titles.title: Karamo
titles.description: Karamo is a true fan of the talk-show genre who brings that passion, a unique skill set and life experiences to guide his guests through life's dramatic crossroads and build a lasting connection with the daytime audience.

episodes.title: Unlocking My Phone ... but You Have a Mistress
episodes.description: A woman says her man is cheating; a devastating car accident sends a family into a tailspin.

episodes.title: Plus Size Model Confronts Her Online Troll
episodes.description: Shawntel is fed up with ex-friend Christian, who fat-shamed her on social media; Karla doesn't believe she was ever accepted by sister-in-law Shaylee because of issues with her weight, among other things; the Lizzo dancers.

episodes.title: I'll Unlock My Phone to Prove My Innocence
episodes.description: Brianna's boyfriend, Taylor, cheats on her, but she wants to try to make things work for the sake of their children; Reanna wants to salvage her marriage, but Everett isn't certain he wants to stay married to her.

episodes.title: Mom and Daughter in Distress
episodes.description: A woman believes that her daughter's reckless behavior is tearing her family asunder; a woman wants to repair her relationship with her father.

episodes.title: My Child's Father Won't Accept My Transition
episodes.description: Karamo explores the joys and challenges that come with being a member of the LGBTQ community; the Queen of Bounce, Big Freedia, joins the set to discuss his personal journey growing up in New Orleans.

episodes.title: Teens in Trouble
episodes.description: Ronesha says her daughter, Janaira, has been nothing but trouble ever since the pandemic; Heather needs help talking to her 16-year-old daughter, Lela, who is having sex and desires to become a mother.

episodes.title: Internet Rejects Our Open Adoption
episodes.description: Ashley and Steven have chronicled their emotional journey of starting a family on social media and want to adopt another child, but Ashley's mother, Dixie, wants her to try and carry a child to term herself.

episodes.title: Show Me the Proof!
episodes.description: Diamond says she is caught up in the middle of her parents' arguments over everything; Ricky says he has proof that Rhonda has been cheating on him, while she says his accusations are all lies.

episodes.title: Confronting My Bully ... My Mom
episodes.description: Brandon confronts a childhood bully whom he hasn't seen in seven years: his own mother; Victoria, who transitioned to a woman, wants to make cosmetic changes to her face; Aubree and Ava are a mother/daughter dancing duo who lit up social media.

episodes.title: Unlock the Phone
episodes.description: Jesse says Ashley struggles with communication, while she wants him to accept that he too is to blame for the conditions in their relationship; Teonnia's wild nights out are becoming too much for Jaylen to bear.

episodes.title: Families Reunited
episodes.description: Jelli and her sister Aaliyah hope to get at the root cause of what's truly dividing them; Leighton is a desperate father trying to get his family back together, while his daughter says that he doesn't acknowledge her as a woman after her transition.

episodes.title: I'm 17, Are You My Daddy?
episodes.description: Keyonna was just 15 when she had her daughter Keyarra; the man Keyarra thinks is her dad, Rashard, has denied being her father repeatedly, and she pines to uncover the DNA truth.

episodes.title: Too Many People in This Relationship
episodes.description: Ta'Laiya and De'Asia have been friends since seventh grade but have stopped speaking because of a wig; Jerome wanted his girlfriend, Carla, and friend LaNiki to become the best of friends, but now he thinks that LaNiki is trying to seduce Carla.

episodes.title: Unlock the Phone
episodes.description: Jeremiah and Nancy are at war over accusations of cheating, and he questions whether their children are really his; seven years on, Theresa fears that her relationship with Charles has been a farce.

episodes.title: My Cheating Husband Went Viral
episodes.description: Shamika's video went viral after she caught her husband, Ifeanyi, at a hotel with another woman on their anniversary; Carlos posts his encounters with wild animals on social media, but his girlfriend, Karina, is unhappy about his overzealous ways.

episodes.title: Unlock the Phone Has Shocking Surprise
episodes.description: Kenny and Nichole find themselves bickering over everything; Tony, who quickly moved in with a woman he met online, believes that she is cheating and lying to him.

episodes.title: 5 Year Relationship ... We've Never Met
episodes.description: Brietta discovered Kurtis was cheating on her, and she doesn't know if she can ever trust him again; Jenna and Angela believe that family member Tameeka's online boyfriend is taking advantage of her.

episodes.title: Our Love Went Viral
episodes.description: Trevor says DeLessa has taken her content creation on social media too far and doesn't prioritize their family and relationship; Rachel's and her much-younger boyfriend Alex's online video quickly drew the attention of her family and co-workers.

episodes.title: Unlock the Phone: Is She Still Talking to Her One-Night Stand?
episodes.description: After rumors of cheating, pregnancy and drug use, a couple unlock each other's phones to prove their innocence; Grace and Kentrell need to rekindle passion in their relationship.

episodes.title: DNA: Are You My Brother & Sister?
episodes.description: Victoria believes Queecha and Vincent are her long-lost brother and sister, but the two aren't convinced that Victoria is part of their family; Candi lost her salon to a fire and blames her former friend, Patsy, for the blaze.

episodes.title: Unlock the Phone; To Prove You're Not Cheating
episodes.description: Ariana and fiancé Richard's future was paused when her friend uncovered a variety of dating apps on his phone; DeAndre and Koko have three children, but he's questioning her fidelity after discovering that she's had an affair with one of his friends.

episodes.title: Karamo and His Son Share Their Story of Addiction
episodes.description: Karamo's son Jason recounts a string of events that led him to a near-death experience with drugs; Karrie says that her son Cole's overindulgence in drugs has gotten so bad that she had to call the cops on him.

episodes.title: Mom Used Me for Her Sexy Business
episodes.description: Lashoun got daughter Jelisha involved in a lingerie basketball league, but this isn't the path Jelisha wants to pursue; Roselee has been cashing in on her fame on social media but says Jeremiah is having a hard time accepting she's the breadwinner.

episodes.title: My Niece Is 16 and Pregnant ... I Need Help
episodes.description: John and Shay share their struggles of having a blended family; Barbara does the best she can in raising her 16-year-old niece, Ayonna, who is making bad choices.

episodes.title: Your Sister Says You Cheat ... Unlock Your Phone
episodes.description: Dontez's sister, Nae, wants Kela to ditch him, but Kela needs irrefragable proof before she decides; Desire stopped talking to sister Daejah when Daejah allowed someone to punch her dog.

episodes.title: If You're Not Cheating ... Unlock Your Phone!
episodes.description: Darius' girlfriend, Yemima, isn't convinced that his old ways are a thing of the past; Kena is battling an illness and wants CJ to own up to his responsibilities as a father and a man; sisters Tranae and Briunanna's relationship is at a crossroads.

episodes.title: Unlock My Husband's Phone ... Is He Cheating?
episodes.description: Courtney says her husband, Jeff, constantly tears her down and threatens to end their marriage; Martina's "friend" Raymond resists reimbursing her the money she lent him for a trip they took to Tampa, Fla.

episodes.title: Don't Leave Me ... Save Our Family
episodes.description: Raekwon says he's a changed man since Quanesha gave birth to their son, but she still heaps accusations of infidelity upon him; Natalie says her relationship with Kevin was built on lies.

episodes.title: Will a DNA Test Reveal My True Identity?; Will This Friendship Survive?
episodes.description: Tyawana grew up believing that Roger was her father, but also heard rumors that a man named Gerald could be her father; Jayshana is at odds with her ex-manager, Lanae, over a business deal gone awry.

titles.title: Kevin Can F... Himself
titles.description: "Kevin Can F... Himself" is a dark comedy that alternates between traditional multi-camera sitcom and single-camera drama. Set in Worcester, Mass., the series follows the journey of Allison McRoberts, a stereotypically smart and beautiful sitcom wife, who is married to Kevin, a husky, self-centered man-child who is clearly punching above his weight. After making a dark discovery, Allison teams up with neighbor Patty O'Connor as she attempts to escape the confines of her life and take control of her fate.

episodes.title: Living the Dream
episodes.description: Kevin throws his annual "Anniversa-rager" party with help from Patty, Neil and Pete; after Patty reveals the truth about her bank accounts, Allison goes on a bender and makes a decision to take back control of her life.

episodes.title: New Tricks
episodes.description: Allison witnesses an overdose and has an idea; it's Belichick hoodie day and Kevin feuds with the neighbors over a stolen package; following a mysterious business card, Allison is led to Patty's Salon in town.

episodes.title: We're Selling Washing Machines
episodes.description: Allison discovers the truth about Patty's Salon; after a fight, Kevin and Neil compete in a chili cook-off; Allison's revenge inadvertently dries up the towns pill supply; Patty almost gets busted in a local pharmacy raid and confides in Allison.

episodes.title: Live Free or Die
episodes.description: A detective questions Patty about the pharmacy bust; Allison and Patty go on a road trip; Kevin comes up with a new moneymaking scheme in the basement of the McRoberts home; after multiple setbacks, Allison admits the truth about her plan to Patty.

episodes.title: New Patty
episodes.description: Allison pushes the limits to see what she is capable of; Kevin, Neil and Pete attempt to replace Patty after kicking her out of the group; an ominous Nick shows up at Patty's salon; a new job opportunity opens up for Allison at Bev's Diner.

episodes.title: The Grand Victorian
episodes.description: Allison and Patty make a deal with Nick; Kevin celebrates his birthday with two dinners; to Patty's surprise, she goes on a date with Tammy at the Vic House; Allison confronts Nick about going through with the plan her way.

episodes.title: Broken
episodes.description: Nick's timeline shifts as Allison and Patty prepare for the big night; Kevin, Neil and Pete start a band, but Neil gets paranoid that Kevin has other plans when he finds a fertility clinic brochure in the trash; Tammy and Patty get closer.

episodes.title: Fixed
episodes.description: Detectives question Allison about the night before; after the trauma of the break in, Kevin searches for meaning by running for city council; Kurt plants a seed of doubt, while Allison and Patty deal with the repercussions of their actions.

titles.title: Kickboxer
titles.description: Eric Sloane (Dennis Alexio) is an American kickboxing pro, helped by his brother, Kurt (Jean-Claude Van Damme), in his quest for glory. But when the two go to Thailand to take on legendary Tong Po (Michel Qissi), the opponent viciously beats Eric and leaves him paralyzed. Swearing vengeance, Kurt tracks down master Xian Chow (Dennis Chan) and begins learning the sport himself while also getting caught up in criminal intrigue involving thuggish crime boss Freddy Li (Ka Ting Lee).

titles.title: Kickboxer: Vengeance
titles.description: Kurt Sloane (Alain Moussi) has always been there for his brother, Eric (Darren Shahlavi), who's known in the martial arts world as a modern-day warrior. But when the ruthless and undefeated fighter Tong Po (Dave Bautista) brutally ends Eric's life in a no-holds-barred match in Thailand, Kurt devotes himself to training with a master in a quest for redemption and revenge.

titles.title: Kill Order
titles.description: Uncanny abilities awaken within a troubled high school student when a fully-armed tactical team attempts to abduct him from his classroom.

titles.title: Killer Investigations
titles.description: Detectives chase down leads, prosecutors go head-to-head with defense attorneys and juries wrestle with life-or-death decisions.
categories: Upgrade to Watch the Latest Season

episodes.title: The Lady in the Woods
episodes.description: When Stephanie Pavlons vanished, the truth was hidden in the woods and within her own relationship; as investigators unraveled the mystery, suspicion turned to the man closest to her, Matthew Pahl, revealing a chilling story of control, secrets and murder.

titles.title: Killer Profiles
titles.description: A journey through the complicated criminal mind with the help of the former head of forensic psychology at SAPS, Gerard Labuschagne, Criminal Psychologist Bronwynn Stollars, and other Canadian experts.

episodes.title: Quarry Killer
episodes.description: 33-year-old Jumaisi Khalusha confessed to killing 42 women, including his wife. The prime suspect arrested over the discovery of muClated female bodies in a Nairobi rubbish dump had confessed to killing 42 women.

episodes.title: Stuart "Boetie Boer" Wilkin
episodes.description: Stewart 'Boetie Boer' Wilken is regarded as a highly unusual serial killer, having killed individuals from two distinct victim types: female prostitutes and young boys.

episodes.title: The Griekwastad Murders
episodes.description: On Good Friday, April 6, 2012, in Griekwastad, South Africa, farmer Deon Steenkamp, his wife Christelle, and their daughter Marthella were murdered. Their sole survivor, 15-year-old Don Steenkamp...

episodes.title: Joseph Ntshongwana: The Axe Murderer
episodes.description: Ntshongwana was arrested in 2011 for hacking four men to death and wounding two others with an axe to avenge the gang-rape and subsequent HIV-infection of his daughter earlier in 2011.

episodes.title: The Murder of Michael Van Eck
episodes.description: In April 2011, Michael van Eck was murdered in a Welkom graveyard by Chane van Heerden and Maartens van der Merwe. The murder was labelled Satanic by Danie Krügel, a former police officer and founding member of Auksano.

episodes.title: The Prostitute Killer
episodes.description: Riaan Stander (born 1972) is a South African serial killer who murdered two prostitutes in Port Elizabeth in August 2007. His modus operandi consisted of picking up prostitutes in the evening.

episodes.title: The norwood serial killer
episodes.description: Kobus Geldenhuys, the Norwood Serial Killer, committed house robberies, rapes and murders in the early 1990s in Johannesburg. A policeman, he raped two victims and murdered five.

episodes.title: The oscar pistorius case
episodes.description: The trial of Oscar Pistorius for the murder of Reeva Steenkamp. Steenkamp, a model, had been Pistorius's girlfriend for three months. In the early morning of Thursday, 14 February 2013, Steenkamp was shot and killed by Pistorius at his Pretoria home.

episodes.title: The krugersdorp sword killer
episodes.description: In 2008 student Morné Harmse attacked four people with a samurai sword.

episodes.title: The rosebank saps murders
episodes.description: The Rosebank Murders likely refers to the 2020 murders of two elderly people, Rosalie Bloch (84) and Aubrey Jackson (95), in the Rosebank area of South Africa, for which a R100 000 reward was offered.

episodes.title: Robin cloete - springbok serial killer
episodes.description: A journey through the complicated criminal mind with the help of the former head of forensic psychology at SAPS, Gerard Labuschagne, Criminal Psychologist Bronwynn Stollars, and other Canadian experts.

episodes.title: The sunday rapist
episodes.description: A journey through the complicated criminal mind with the help of the former head of forensic psychology at SAPS, Gerard Labuschagne, Criminal Psychologist Bronwynn Stollars, and other Canadian experts.

episodes.title: The murder of leigh matthews
episodes.description: Leigh Matthews was a South African university student who was kidnapped and murdered. Her disappearance and murder sparked a media frenzy, with the ensuing investigation and court case being one of the most closely followed in South African history.

episodes.title: Caesarian kidnapper
episodes.description: Police accused her of fraudulently claiming to be the girl's mother since snatching her from a hospital in Cape Town. 16 years later, the 51-year-old woman was arrested last year after suspicions were raised when there was a similar-looking girl.

episodes.title: The etwatwa family murder
episodes.description: The grandfather of the 14-year-old boy butchered his mother, grandmother and two younger siblings with an axe.

episodes.title: Mine dump - child killers
episodes.description: A journey through the complicated criminal mind with the help of the former head of forensic psychology at SAPS, Gerard Labuschagne, Criminal Psychologist Bronwynn Stollars, and other Canadian experts.

episodes.title: The muldersdrift rapist
episodes.description: A journey through the complicated criminal mind with the help of the former head of forensic psychology at SAPS, Gerard Labuschagne, Criminal Psychologist Bronwynn Stollars, and other Canadian experts.

episodes.title: Brian the stalker harvey
episodes.description: We travel back to 2010 and discuss the case of Brian Harvey who stalked over 40 women. He was later accused of dousing two women with gasoline, and setting them on fire in Florida.

episodes.title: Krugersdorp cult killers
episodes.description: In 2016 a spate of brutal and mysterious killings grips the town of Krugersdorp. Is a serial killer behind these vicious attacks, and who will die next if the police don't catch them?..

episodes.title: Springs house of horrors
episodes.description: The plight of an 11- year-old boy and his four siblings who had suffered severe abuse and neglect at the hands of their parents, only became known after the boy had managed to escape from their house one evening in May 2014.

episodes.title: The state vs. mariska du plessis case
episodes.description: A journey through the complicated criminal mind with the help of the former head of forensic psychology at SAPS, Gerard Labuschagne, Criminal Psychologist Bronwynn Stollars, and other Canadian experts.

titles.title: Killer Vacation
titles.description: Jake takes his pregnant girlfriend, Lindsey, to an upscale resort. When they arrive, Lindsey discovers that Jake's soon-to-be-ex is there. Soon, it becomes apparent that someone is determined to make sure that Lindsey never uses her return ticket.

titles.title: Killing Eve
titles.description: Eve's life as a spy is not adding up to what she had hoped it would be when she started. She is a bored, very smart, MI5 security officer who is very desk-bound. Villanelle is a very talented killer, mercurial in mood, who clings to the luxuries of her job. Eve and Villanelle go head to head in a fierce game of cat and mouse, each woman equally obsessed with the other as Eve is tasked with hunting down the psychopathic assassin. Sarah Barnett, BBCA president, says, "'Killing Eve' stands out in a sea of scripted stories as refreshingly entertaining and great fun."

episodes.title: Inside Killing Eve Season 4
episodes.description: The cast and show creators take fans behind the scenes of the making of "Killing Eve," Season 4.

titles.title: Kiltro
titles.description: The leader (Marko Zaror) of a Chilean gang uses martial arts to protect a girl (Caterina Jadresic) from a vengeful thug.

titles.title: Kin Eats
titles.description: Home cooks from the Kin Community demonstrate easy meals that will please the whole family

episodes.title: Sausage & Egg Breakfast Casserole
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): There's nothing like waking up on Christmas morning ... to a warm, scrumptious breakfast! And this casserole recipe is the perfect dish. It's easy to whip together, feeds a ton of people, and has all your major food groups represented: eggs, potatoes, sausage, veggies and bread. So, there's no need for any additional sides nor the clean up that goes with it.

episodes.title: Holiday Decorated Sugar Cookies
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Eat them. Gift them. Make them into ornaments. You'll definitely get a bang for your buck with these delicious and versatile sugar cookies. . What are you waiting for? Get the little ones in the kitchen and get baking! Happy holidays!

episodes.title: Caramel Corn with Toasted Hazelnuts
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com) says: The perfect gift to make for family and friends around the holidays, because it's fairly inexpensive and can be dressed up with pretty packaging. And who doesn't love a homemade gift? (Especially one that tastes this good!) Happy holidays!

episodes.title: Spicy Shrimp Scampi with Crostini Recipe
episodes.description: Having dinner guests this weekend? Try this quick and easy shrimp scampi recipe and wow your guests. It's the perfect communal dish served with crostini. Watch as Jenny Park of http://spoonforkbacon.com demonstrates. Mangia!
