episodes.title: Garlic Steamed Mussels Recipe
episodes.description: Have you ever tried to make mussels at home? We strongly suggest you try it. This delectable dish from Whitney Webster is one of the easiest recipes you could ever attempt and it's sure to impress your guests! Don't forget to soak up that garlic and wine broth with your crusty bread...it's the best part!

episodes.title: Star Anise & Cinnamon Infused Eggnog
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Tis the season for friends, family, and a delicious glass of egg nog! Don't make the mistake of serving a store-bought variety. This festive holiday cocktail is actually quite easy to prepare, and you'll love this recipe which adds a little spice with the addition of star anise and cinnamon. Bottoms up! Cheers!

episodes.title: Pomegranate Champagne Cocktail Recipe
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Looking for a way to jazz up the bubbly this new year's eve? Try this refreshing take on a champagne cocktail that incorporates pomegranate seeds and brandy. This cocktail is easy to make and tasty, too! It's the perfect way to ring in the new year. 3...2...1... Cheers!

episodes.title: Roasted Eggplant Roulade
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): For my non-meat eating friends, this is a dish I like to serve that makes them feel special. It looks like something that took a lot of time, but with a few short-cuts and a simple rolling technique, you'll have a welcoming dish that everyone will enjoy.

episodes.title: Cherry Tomato Tart Appetizer
episodes.description: Need a quick and beautiful appetizer for your next cocktail party? or maybe a hearty finger food to serve with a bowl of soup? This simple tomato tart is a colorful, delicious treat...give it a try!

episodes.title: Chocolate Coconut Macaroons
episodes.description: Jenny Park of http://spoonforkbacon.com says: I find the tendency during the holidays is to spend a lot of money on fancy desserts when entertaining. But these cookie can be made for just under $10 and the recipe makes 20! So, grab a friend and spend a lazy afternoon in the kitchen baking.

episodes.title: Roast Chicken with Root Vegetables Recipe
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Roasting a whole chicken may seem intimidating to a home cook, but it really couldn't be easier. It's just a few easy steps to prep the bird and into the oven it goes. Not to mention, the leftovers can be used for lunches and dinners in the subsequent days. It's a meal that just keeps on giving!

episodes.title: Spinach Artichoke Dip Recipe
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Who can deny the popularity and tastiness of a piping hot spinach and artichoke dip? It's a snap to prepare and rich in flavor so it's not surprise that it's a party staple. Our tip: ditch the carbs and serve it alongside fresh cut veggies.

episodes.title: Homemade Chocolate Truffles
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Chocolate truffles are perfect for holiday parties and make great gifts because they are so versatile. Once you've made the chocolate ball, you can coat them in just about any topping -- shredded coconut, chopped nuts, cocoa powder. Just be sure to save some for yourself because they'll go fast! Happy holidays!

episodes.title: Turkey Panini Sandwich Recipe
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): A lazy weekday dinner doesn't have to mean deciding between cheap take-out or microwaving a packaged dinner tray. You'll be surprised how fast you can whip up this delicious turkey panini. All the ingredients can be purchased at your supermarket and it only takes a few minutes to build your sandwich. Buon appetito!

episodes.title: Snickerdoodle Cookies Recipe
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Next time your kids are begging you for homemade cookies, try these. Snickerdoodles are a classic cookie. I like them because they are not too sweet. Just the right amount of sugar and cinnamon to please any sweet tooth. And the best part is they can help. Have them roll the dough into balls and then roll in the sugar mixture. It's the perfect job for little hands.

episodes.title: Beef Bourguignon Recipe
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Beef Bourguignon may seem like an intimidating dish. Perhaps one that you would have at a fancy French bistro with a glass of red wine or one that only Julia Child could tackle ... but it's actually quite simple to prepare and best of all it can be done in one pot! C'est magnifique!

episodes.title: Herb Deviled Eggs Recipe
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): I know, deviled eggs are pretty retro, but IMO they deserve a second chance. I give them a modern spin by brightening them up with fresh herbs and spices. They're also fun for the holidays because they look so fancy. And strangely they're the first to go at parties. I guess they have staying power for a reason. Enjoy!

episodes.title: Bourbon Spiked Mulled Apple Cider
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com) says: Mulled apple cider is a classic holiday drink. But we say, skip the pre-packaged sachets and make your own. It's quick, easy and so very festive!

episodes.title: Spinach Linguini with Sun Dried Tomatoes Recipe
episodes.description: Here's a great pasta recipe that has all the flair of a restaurant dish, but is easy to make at home. The spinach, goat cheese, and sun dried tomatoes pack this dish full of flavor but are friendly to the waistline. It's perfect for a weeknight meal.

episodes.title: The Perfect Omelette with Arugula
episodes.description: Beth Le Manach shares her tips on making a perfect omelette. Of course, you can enjoy the omelette for breakfast or brunch, but don't count it out when it comes to lunch or dinner, especially if you're looking to whip something up quickly. Enjoy!

episodes.title: Brie Pecan Fig Jam Crostini Recipe
episodes.description: Beth Le Manach ( http://www.youtube.com/KinCommunity ): The idea for this dish began with a humble jar of fig jam. I added a few culinary complements and voila! A crowd-pleasing appetizer was born. It's so simple and elegant that you'll make this your go-to entertaining dish!

episodes.title: Beth's Herb Roasted Pork Loin Recipe
episodes.description: Beth Le Manach: This is a great Sunday night dinner. It's a hearty one-pot meal and, best of all, there's usually enough for leftovers! That means you cook once, but eat twice. Now, that's smart cooking. Hope you enjoy the recipe!

episodes.title: Spinach Tortellini, Pesto & Peas Recipe
episodes.description: Some times a lazy night dinner made from frozen foods and pantry staples can be a delicious treat. Just like this super simple and super delicious tortellini dish by Beth Le Manach. It's easy to whip up and is a family pleaser! Yum!

episodes.title: Smoked Salmon on Toast Points
episodes.description: Beth Le Manach: I didn't always love smoked salmon. In fact, it took a Christmas dinner with my in-laws (in France!) for me to discover how much I love it. Now, I find that it's the perfect dish for festive occasions and also a simple and delicious solution to lazy night dinners. Just toast a few slices of bread, whip up an easy crème fraîche, and voila! Dinner is served.

episodes.title: Mommy's Mac and Cheese
episodes.description: Let's face it, if we gave our kids the option, they'd probably eat mac and cheese for every meal.  This recipe uses real ingredients like milk, peas, brown rice pasta and REAL cheese -- not the bright orange powder that comes in a packet. The best part it is it doesn't take much longer to prepare than the boxed varieties. Now that's what you call a win-win!

episodes.title: Antipasto Platter Appetizer
episodes.description: Beth Le Manach says: For me, the most stressful part of entertaining is that moment when guests arrive. They end up gathering in the kitchen while I'm trying to get the dinner ready. And if you have an open kitchen, it's even worse. So, I've devised this handy little appetizer platter that keeps guests busy and in their seats! :) (Trust me, it works!)

episodes.title: Olive Stuffed Cheese Puffs
episodes.description: Dana Joy Altma says: When I had my first grown-up party, this is the appetizer I served. It comes from my mom, who served these when I was growing up. It reminds me of her glamorous cocktail parties of the 70’s. It's the perfect little bit to serve with a glass of chilled wine.

episodes.title: Middle Eastern Chicken Wraps
episodes.description: This lazy dinner idea from Dana Joy Altman is such a winner. Just roll up some rotisserie chicken and veggies in a pita, slather on some lemon tahini sauce (the magic ingredient) and enjoy! We don't know about you, but we're sold!

episodes.title: Chocolate Dessert Board: Party Platter
episodes.description: Dana Joy Altman: Tis the season for entertaining ... which means you're probably tired of preparing elaborate appetizers, entrees and desserts, right? Well, this chocolate board is just thing you need for your next party. It's a no-cook, easy to prep dessert platter that is also unique and delicious.

episodes.title: Red Lentil & Rice Soup Vegan Recipe
episodes.description: Dana Joy Altma: This is a great one-pot comfort meal. It's a flavorful and seemingly exotic lentil and rice soup that can be garnished to please any diner's palette. Also, it's a vegetarian (vegan, even) dish that is both filling and tasty. So, your omnivore friends won't miss the meat. It's okay if you don't want to share. The leftovers are just as delicious! Enjoy.

episodes.title: Healthy Apple Banana Smoothie
episodes.description: Dana Joy Altman: Sugar here. Sugar there. Sugar is everywhere these days ... and your kid is happily eating it. Maybe even craving it. Here is a great smoothie recipe that tastes as sweet as their favorite sugary treat but has none of that refined stuff. They'll never what they're missing and you'll be happy knowing that they're eating -- or rather drinking -- healthy!

episodes.title: Roasted Vegetable Salad
episodes.description: Salads are generally not hearty enough for dinner. I think we can agree on that, right? At least not the healthy ones -- you know, the ones without the fried chicken pieces and the ranch dressing and the bleu cheese crumbles. Well, Pace Webb of http://tasteofpace.blogspot.com provides the exception with this recipe. By roasting seasonal vegetables and combining them with chick peas and shaved parmesan, this salad is in fact warm, filling and quite hearty. It's also perfect for those lazy nights when you just don't feel like cooking up a big meal.

episodes.title: Gourmet Mac N Cheese
episodes.description: If you ask any kid what their favorite dish is, chances are they'll say mac 'n cheese. I wanted to make a version that had a little more nutrition to it, but also add some sophisticated flavors for the parents. I think this is a winning combination that everyone in the family can enjoy. Let me know what you think!

episodes.title: Lamb Stew
episodes.description: Lamb may not be the first choice of meat for most people, but it's quite tasty if you give it a chance. This stew is a perfect introduction to lamb. It's a delicious comfort dish, and braising the lamb in red wine helps get rid of the gamey taste that turn people off of it. Also, it's basically a one pot meal which means it's fairly easy to cook and a breeze to clean up!

episodes.title: Veggie Frittata with Goat Cheese
episodes.description: Pace Webb: This is my favorite Christmas morning breakfast because I can make it the day ahead. It's filling, but light enough so I can enjoy a big family meal later in the day. The dish can be served slightly warmed or at room temperature so you can take your time opening gifts in the morning! Happy Holidays!

episodes.title: Acai Champagne Cocktail
episodes.description: This is a refreshing and bright take on a champagne cocktail. It's simple to prepare. You make it right in the glass so no messy shakers. Best of all, it only uses three ingredients: champagne, acai juice which adds a nice berry flavor (and is also good for you!), and fresh squeezed lime which balances the sweetness. It's the perfect cocktail for a party or even a lazy Sunday brunch. Cheers!

episodes.title: Grilled Vegetable Pizza
episodes.description: Sienna DeGovia (http://siennacake.com): My husband loves pizza, but pizza delivery gets pretty expensive ... not to mention all the added calories! So, I created this healthy alternative using simple ingredients and store-bought dough. This recipe is the perfect weeknight meal. It's quick and easy to make and a great alternative to delivery. Your kids - and picky eater hubbies - will love it!

episodes.title: Kahlua Peppermint Coffee Cups
episodes.description: Sienna DeGovia (http://siennacake.com) says: With all the hustle and bustle of the holiday season, I love to serve festive drinks that can double as a pick-me-up. This drink is kind of like an adult hot cocoa. The coffee in it will perk you up, and with a good dose of Kahlua, it will settle your holiday nerves. Bottoms up!

episodes.title: White Chocolate Ginger Mice Truffles
episodes.description: Sienna DeGovia (http://siennacake.com): This is a fun twist on homemade truffles. It uses a basic recipe, but instead of shaping the truffle into a standard sphere, they become cute, playful mice. It's the perfect treat to prepare with friends or family, especially little ones, and they make a great gift!

episodes.title: Pulled Pork Sliders
episodes.description: Sienna DeGovia (http://siennacake.com) says: I nicknamed this dish 'ZZ Top Pulled Pork' -- mostly because it's a dish that is inspired by my Texas-born husband. He likes his southern pork, rock 'n roll, and good times. Rock on…

episodes.title: Corn Chowder In Mini Bread Bowls
episodes.description: Not every recipe has to break the bank. In fact, some can give you a bang for your buck. Sienna DeGovia's ( http://siennacake.com ) corn chowder is the perfect example. You can make an entire pot of warm, hearty soup for a big family dinner or a single meal with leftovers. It's a one-pot meal that keeps on giving. Yum!

episodes.title: Broccoli and Cheese Casserole
episodes.description: Shauna Sever (http://shaunasever.com): As with any great casserole, this broccoli and cheese bread pudding is a delicious, family-friendly dish that uses simple ingredients but makes for a satisfying and hearty dish. It's perfect for a weeknight meal or for a casual dinner party.

episodes.title: ChocoloEveryday Cookie
episodes.description: This is a great everyday cookie recipe in that you can make it any ole day of the week ... and it's also okay to enjoy them every day of the week! The recipe calls for oat flour and eliminates the butter and eggs. You can easily make this cookie gluten-free and vegan as well. Give them a try.

episodes.title: Vanilla Roasted Fruit
episodes.description: Shauna Sever (http://shaunasever.com): This is a sweet treat that's actually friendly to your waistline. The trick here is fresh vanilla bean. Vanilla is a great low calorie, rich tasting ingredient that will leaving you feeling like you've enjoyed a decadent creamy treat but without the need to hit the treadmill afterwards.

episodes.title: Sheet Pan Chicken
episodes.description: Shauna Sever (http://shaunasever.com): Sheet pan chicken is one of those lazy -- and super affordable -- recipes that is easy to prepare and is quite delicious to eat. Basically, it's the crown jewel in your weeknight culinary oeuvre. The secret is in the chicken thighs. Remember: “the chicken thigh never dies.” Happy cooking!

episodes.title: Triple Berry Danish Cheesecake
episodes.description: This dessert tastes like the best part of a cheese danish. You know, the ooey gooey center part that's both creamy and cake-y. Basically, it's heaven on a plate. Mmmm....

episodes.title: Baked Bacon Candy
episodes.description: Kelly Bryon Pearce: This is a super simple recipe. It only calls for two ingredients -- bacon and sugar. The two best ingredients in any food, right? You'll be amazed how delicious this sweet and savory treat is. It's truly a crowd-pleaser and perfect for your game day party! Goooo team!

episodes.title: Banana French Toast
episodes.description: Kelly Bryson Pearce: Saturday mornings are the best! Our family gets to sleep in, spend quality time together ... in our pajamas, and, best of all, we get to make and enjoy a delicious, hearty breakfast. Our favorite go-to meal is French toast with bananas and whipped cream. Mmm... Here's to the weekend!

episodes.title: Skinny Margarita Cocktail
episodes.description: Just a few fresh ingredients and a quality tequila is all that is needed for some great margaritas. Try Kelly’s Skinny margarita cocktail.  Cheers!

episodes.title: Couscous Recipe with Sausage and Feta Cheese
episodes.description: Couscous is generally seen in many side dishes, but did you know that it can make a hearty and delicious entree as well? Kelly Bryson Pearce shares her recipe for a filling couscous dish that is prepared with sausage, onion and feta! Brilliant!

episodes.title: Kelly's Red Berry Trifle No Bake Dessert Recipe
episodes.description: Kelly Bryson Pearce: Baking can seem like a daunting task. Between the exact ingredients and precise measurements, it sometimes starts to feel more like a science project than a fun afternoon of cooking. On those days, this no-bake trifle is the perfect solution. It uses store bought angel food cake and a few other ingredients to create a sophisticated looking dessert that is absolutely delicious!

episodes.title: Homemade Chex Mix
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Homemade Chex Mix is one of those foods that is so easy to throw together, and something everyone always seems to love. It's no wonder why it's been a party staple for generations! Try making a batch for your next get together.

episodes.title: Lobster Ravioli with Tarragon Cream Sauce Recipe
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): This is one of my favorite recipes to throw together when I don't have a lot of time to cook dinner. It's quick, easy and delicious, plus it's a great crowd pleaser for small get togethers.

episodes.title: Pound Cake Topped with Toffee Sauce & Pecans
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Move over, Sandra Lee! We have a semi-homemade treat that is dressed to impress ... dressed with a layer of ooey gooey toffee sauce, that is. Try this dessert for your next dinner party and your guests won't even notice you didn't plan a tablescape. Yum!

episodes.title: Mushroom and Roasted Pepper Quesadilla
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Sometimes after a long day of work you just want to cook and eat something that's low maintenance, but satisfying. We've all been there, right? Well, this recipe is exactly the go-to recipe you need when you're in that kind of mood. You're welcome ,)

episodes.title: Ham & Cheese Crescent Rolls
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): Ham and cheese crescent rolls are a fun recipe that parents can make with their little ones. They look cute and taste delicious, which makes them a great snack for kids ... and adults love them, too! They also make a great finger food for parties. Just be sure to make enough because they'll go fast!

episodes.title: Vegetarian Chili Recipe
episodes.description: Jenny Park (http://spoonforkbacon.com): This is a recipe I dedicate to my sister, the vegetarian of the family. I think this is a great recipe to satisfy both meat lovers and vegetarians alike. It's a hearty chili, filled with vegetables, spices and three different kinds of beans. Enjoy!

episodes.title: Mexican Quinoa Salad
episodes.description: This easy and healthy recipe by Jenny Park is one you can feel good about. It's high in protein, filled with vegetables, and packed with flavor! Happy eating!

episodes.title: Banana Nut Pancakes Recipe
episodes.description: Pancakes for breakfast may seem like a weekend luxury -- and they definitely should be -- but we think you should be able to enjoy them during the week as well! Liesl Maggiore shares a great pancake recipe that's both delicious and healthy. Her best tip: make a big batch on the weekends and refrigerate the rest for a weekday breakfast. Just pop them in the toaster oven or microwave and voila!

episodes.title: Linguine with Prosciutto and Brown Butter Sauce
episodes.description: Liesl Maggiore shares this easy and scrumptious recipe that is chock full of ingredients that both kids and adults LOVE -- pasta, butter and cheese! The secret is in the butter which you brown (not burn). You'll love the rich, nutty flavor it adds to the dish. Enjoy!

episodes.title: Liesl's Homemade Chicken Fingers Recipe
episodes.description: Liesl Maggiore: This is one of my favorite dishes of all time. Its clean flavors and textures are classic and simple: good quality chicken, crunchy panko coating with flavorful aged parmesan, tart lemon and peppery arugula.

episodes.title: Blood Orange Almond Rice Pilaf
episodes.description: Liesl Maggiore: I am a huge fan of adding seasonal ingredients to spice up otherwise kind bland foods like rice, couscous, or quinoa. Right now blood oranges are just amazing, and I love to use them when they are in season. In this recipe, I added them to a basic rice pilaf with some crunchy toasted almonds for texture ... you can serve this as a side dish with just about anything!

episodes.title: Farro Veggie Risotto Recipe
episodes.description: Jess Dang (http://www.cooksmarts.com): This recipe is incredibly versatile and the zucchini can be swapped with a whole range of vegetables, such as chopped up broccolini, eggplant, asparagus, beans, etc. The protein can also be substituted for other vegetarian proteins like diced tofu or meat proteins such as grilled chicken breast.

episodes.title: Tortellini with Smoked Salmon, Crème Fraîche Recipe
episodes.description: We called for your favorite recipes and you all responded with such yummy dishes! Here is a tasty one from Sabrina -- http://www.youtube.com/Nemien09 -- who hails from Norway! She created this dish using left-over smoked salmon from Christmas. And we're so glad she did because it looks amazing! Takk, Sabrina!

episodes.title: Easy Lasagna Recipe
episodes.description: Subscriber sweetfactory20 asked for our take on a weeknight lasagna and we think this will definitely please. Layers of store bought sauce, no boil lasagna sheets, and a delicious cheese mix make this casserole a hearty dish that is easy to prepare and a quick family favorite.

episodes.title: White Bean & Butternut Squash Soup Recipe
episodes.description: A simple but hearty white bean and butternut squash soup. It's the perfect one-pot meal for a lazy night and so delicious!

episodes.title: Easy Osso Bucco with Gremolata
episodes.description: An Osso Bucco recipe that does not take as much effort as you think, It’ a grand meal and hearty. Yum

episodes.title: Spicy Crab and Artichoke Dip Recipe
episodes.description: The big game is quickly approaching. What will you be making to feed your favorite football fans? Subscriber Samantha from Alaska ( http://www.youtube.com/dianau333 ) shares a great recipe that's perfect for parties. Forget your standard ho-hum artichoke dip and follow Samantha's lead. Add fresh crab and spice it up with a little sriracha! Now, that's a touchdown!

episodes.title: Chocolate Ganache Cake with Strawberry Frosting
episodes.description: Will you be our valentine? No, seriously. Since we launched Kin Community a few months ago, we've been overwhelmed by your inspiring comments and your enthusiasm for our videos. We are moved by your devotion and we want you to know that we love you, too! So, here's a tasty treat from the bottom of our hearts. Thank you for watching and stay tuned for more! Happy Valentine's Day! xoxo

episodes.title: Pot of Gold St. Patrick's Day Dessert
episodes.description: There are so many other ways we can celebrate this festive Irish holiday that don't involve green food coloring. For example, take Sienna's delicious pot de chocolat recipe which can be turned into a cheeky pot of gold. Now that's cute AND delicious. So, step away that bottle of edible dye and give this tasty treat a try! Happy St. Patty's Day!

episodes.title: Homemade Marshmallow Bunnies
episodes.description: No treat says "Easter" quite like those little sugar coated marshmallow bunnies. This homemade version is much healthier than the store bought kind...and what an adorable, fun project! Try them out!

episodes.title: Grandma's Cheesecake
episodes.description: We love this rich, decadent cheesecake recipe from Sienna. It's got that traditional graham cracker crust and all the creamy flavors you want in a cheesecake...and it's topped with her grandmother's secret weapon! Beautiful and delicious!

episodes.title: Strawberry Shortcake with Homemade Biscuits Recipe
episodes.description: Sweet, tangy strawberries...smooth, creamy whipped cream...and light, fluffy biscuits...simply irresistible! Sienna shows us the secret to perfect homemade biscuits. Thanks Sienna!

episodes.title: Chocolate Cream Pie
episodes.description: Here's another delicious recipe inspired by this year's Academy Awards. If you've seen Best Picture nominee "The Help" then you'll know there is a very special pie in the film. Don't worry, this version eliminates Minny's 'special ingredient'. Instead, you'll love the added crunch of the Heath bar. Mmmm...

episodes.title: Fried Mac 'n Cheese "Moneyballs"
episodes.description: We asked for recipes inspired by this year's Academy Award nominees and subscriber saltcatering (http://www.youtube.com/saltcatering ) answered with a cheeky recipe for fried mac and cheese nuggets called ... Moneyballs. Get it!? Well, we love it! It's macaroni and cheese. It's fried. It's coated in panko crumbs. It really doesn't get much better! Fry up some of these babies for your Oscar party and you'll be awarded Best Host!

episodes.title: Cucumber Mint Absinthe Cocktail
episodes.description: This cool and refreshing cocktail is inspired by Best Picture nominee "Midnight in Paris". Woody Allen brought the sights and sounds of 1920's Paris to life in this darling film, and now we're giving you a taste of it! Try serving this easy-to-make cocktail at your Oscars party. Cheers!

episodes.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
episodes.description: This hearty pasta recipe is great for a family dinner because both the kids and the adults will love this comfort dish. Let us know what you think!

episodes.title: Grilled Cheese Skewer Recipe
episodes.description: Skewers are always a fun finger food... and really, who doesn't love grilled cheese? This recipe combines both! Try these colorful skewers when you need a quick and easy appetizer to serve at a BBQ, a cocktail party or really, any night of the week!

episodes.title: Chocolate Banana Bourbon Crepes
episodes.description: Adrianna Adarme (http://acozykitchen.com) thinks crepes are the perfect culinary homage to Best Picture nominee "Hugo". However, her twist on the crepe introduces bananas sautéed in brown sugar and bourbon. YUM!

episodes.title: Banana Bread with Blueberry and Oats
episodes.description: Adrianna Adarme (http://acozykitchen.com) shares a delicious recipe for banana bread. Her twist includes blueberries and oats which makes this loaf a powerhouse for nutrition. Bake one this weekend and you'll be looking forward to your breakfast every day next week!

episodes.title: Arroz Con Pollo: Chicken with Rice Recipe
episodes.description: Adrianna Adarme of (http://acozykitchen.com) shares a family heirloom recipe for Arroz Con Pollo. This one-pot meal is a true comfort food that is easy to make and quite tasty. Spice up your next chicken dinner with Adrianna's recipe!

episodes.title: Eggs In Spicy Tomato Sauce
episodes.description: Eggs aren't just for breakfast, they're also the ultimate “fast food” when you need to whip up a quick meal. So go ahead.. add a little spice to your week nights with this go-to egg recipe from Adrianna Adarme. It's a great one to add to the rotation!

episodes.title: Cinnamon Bun Pancakes
episodes.description: This recipe has some serious WOW factor! If you like to start your day with over-the-top, sweet, ooey-gooey JOY...this is the dish for you! It combines all the flavors of a cinnamon bun with the light, fluffy texture of pancakes. But lets face it, that GLAZE is the real star of the show! We dare you not to try this one :)

episodes.title: Easy Matzo Ball Soup
episodes.description: Passover is coming up and many people will be serving delicious, traditional Matzo Ball soup. So get in on the action! This recipe gives you a few short cuts to create that warm, comforting broth and those light fluffy matzo balls in a fraction of the time! It doesn't have to be Passover to enjoy this dish...who doesn't love chicken soup? Give it a shot.

episodes.title: Cheddar Apple Pies
episodes.description: This warm, cozy, comforting recipe is a whimsical take on all American apple pie. Why not skip some steps and bake it right IN the apple!? Plus, this one has some yummy southern flare with the addition of sharp cheddar cheese. It's one part baked apple...one part apple pie...all parts delicious! Give it a try and tell us what you think.

episodes.title: Easter Basket Salad Cups
episodes.description: Looking for the perfect recipe to serve this Easter? You've got to try these edible Easter Baskets! This is NOT your basic side salad.These beautiful “baskets” are filled with healthy Spring veggies, slathered with a scrumptious vinaigrette and they even have cute little handles! Come on...you have to admit these are pretty adorable!

episodes.title: Honey Glazed Carrots with Orange and Thyme
episodes.description: When you need a bright, beautiful side dish with sweet, bold flavors...look no further than these honey glazed carrots. They are such a breeze to whip up and couldn't be more delicious. This recipe really says 'Spring'...we love it!

episodes.title: Asian Chicken Meatballs
episodes.description: Asian chicken meatballs - the perfect appetizer for your next event!

episodes.title: Spring Veggie Orzo
episodes.description: Spring is such a great time to incorporate fresh, flavorful veggies into as many dishes as you can. This orzo recipe is filled with bright green vegetables, creamy feta and crunchy almonds. Serve it as a delicious vegetarian entree or it makes the perfect side dish for any meat. Enjoy!

episodes.title: Baked Scallops with Spanish Ham
episodes.description: These elegant baked scallops from Louise Leonard of thelusherie.com are are a beautiful, impressive dish to serve for any nice occasion. Seafood and Spanish Ham is a match made in heaven. Enjoy!

episodes.title: Bathtub Gin Cocktail
episodes.description: Looking to get creative with your cocktails? Try this lavender infused gin recipe...it's light, refreshing and it smells amazing! Why stick with beer and wine when you can offer your friends a specialty drink with some serious flare!

episodes.title: Ricotta Cheese Recipe
episodes.description: Cheese is one of those fridge staples that we all pick up at the store, but you might be shocked to see how easy it is to make from scratch! Whitney Webster shows us her simple recipe for light, fluffy creamy ricotta cheese right in your own kitchen! Spoon it on top of grilled peaches with balsamic glaze...mmmmm, a summertime delight!

episodes.title: Potato Cakes with Goat Cheese & Thyme
episodes.description: As far as easy, impressive appetizers go...this is a MUST MAKE! It's sophisticated, stunning and simply delicious. The cute little stacks of purple potatoes are perfectly complimented by the creamy goat cheese and a sprig if thyme. Serve this earthy dish to your guests at your next party and watch them delight in every last drop!

episodes.title: Lamb Chops with Cilantro, Mint & Honey Sauce
episodes.description: Want to impress someone? How about trying this lamb dish.

episodes.title: Roasted Tomato & Basil Soup Recipe
episodes.description: There's nothing more comforting than a classic roasted tomato soup, especially as the weather turns and there's a chill in the air. This recipe is easy and delicious, and definitely a dish worth making from scratch. Enjoy!

episodes.title: Spicy Mama Cocktail Recipe
episodes.description: Whitney Webster says ditch the beer and wine and serve your guests a specialty cocktail. This one is sweet and sour with some serious KICK and it's beautiful too! Add some flare to your next party with this spicy mama!

episodes.title: Brie w/ Brown Sugar, Maple Syrup & Pecans Recipe
episodes.description: Kelly Bryson Pearce: The next time you entertain, you HAVE to try this amazing appetizer. There isn't even any cooking involved, it's just an easy to assemble party platter of pure JOY! It's Warm, Ooey, gooey cheese covered in sweet syrup and crunchy pecans...serve it up with fresh fruit and a sliced baguette and watch your guests go nuts for it!

episodes.title: How To Make Homemade Whipped Cream
episodes.description: Yes, it's easy to pick up whipped cream at the store...but this is seriously one of the fastest things you could ever make from scratch and the fresh kind is really SO much better!

episodes.title: How to Cook Artichokes
episodes.description: Artichokes are delicious! But if you've never worked with them before...they can sharp, tough and a little daunting! Louise Leonard is back to show you how to properly prep and cook this green, leafy vegetable.

episodes.title: 2 Ways To Cut A Mango
episodes.description: Mangos are sweet, beautiful and delicious! But the flesh tends to cling to the pit and can be difficult to get off. Whether you prefer nice thin slices or perfect little cubes...Louise Leonard shows you two fail proof ways to cut this tropical fruit.

episodes.title: How To Cook Eggs
episodes.description: There are many ways to cook an egg! It's not hard at all, but there's a definite technique to the different styles...eggs over easy, sunny side up, poached, etc. Louise Leonard gives a quick tutorial on how to cook your eggs perfectly every time. Thanks Louise for more great tips!

episodes.title: Braised Chicken Thighs
episodes.description: Who doesn't love a creamy, inexpensive one pot wonder? This one from Louise Leonard will have your mouth watering! The braised chicken with yellow raisins, pearl onions with a touch of cream is such a satisfying flavor combination. Simply Divine!

episodes.title: Strawberry Rhubarb Fool Recipe
episodes.description: Looking for a unique dessert that's bursting with bright flavors? Louise Leonard shares this creamy, delicious recipe that pairs fresh rhubarb and sweet strawberries with homemade whipped cream. Is it a parfait?...is it a sundae? You decide!

episodes.title: Bloody Mary with Dark Lager Malt Beer Recipe
episodes.description: The classic bloody Mary is a “go to cocktail” for weekend mornings. This pumped up version from Louise Leonard has so many good ingredients in it...it's like a meal in itself! Try it out at your next brunch or any time you want a fun cocktail!

episodes.title: Chocolate Stout Float With Homemade Peanut Butter Ice Cream
episodes.description: Move over root beer float...there's a new float in town! Louise shares her amazing recipe for a chocolate stout float with homemade peanut butter ice cream and chocolate dipped pretzels. WOW! It's rich, creamy, decadent and definitely a whole new way to enjoy a float!

episodes.title: Beer Brats Perfect BBQ Dish Recipe
episodes.description: As if beer brats on a warm roll with spicy mustard weren't already scrumptious enough...Louise Leonard kicks them up a notch by soaking them in beer! Check out her hometown recipe with pickled onions....it's the perfect BBQ dish!

episodes.title: Scandinavian Gravlax - Salmon Recipe
episodes.description: Gravlax is a Scandinavian dish usually served as an appetizer or it's perfect for brunch! It's a beautiful piece of Salmon cured with salt, sugar and herbs...then thinly sliced and paired with bagels, dill, capers, etc. This is something most people buy at the store, but Louise Leonard says it's worth it to make it at home! Curing the fish is not as hard as you might think and the amazing flavors make it well worth the effort.

episodes.title: How To Cut an Apple
episodes.description: Whether you're slicing or dicing... Louise Leonard is back to show you two easy ways to cut an apple properly.

episodes.title: How to Cut A Pepper
episodes.description: Peppers are colorful, delicious and can be used in a wide range of recipes. Louise Leonard shows you how to properly clean and dice this versatile veggie!

episodes.title: Recipe For A Magical Mother's Day Morning
episodes.description: Want to make Mother's Day as special as possible for the mom in your life? You don't need to get fancy, It's the simple things that truly mean the most. A basic breakfast made with love...hand made cards and plenty of snuggles. Nothing can beat that.

episodes.title: Greek Style 7 Layer Dip Recipe
episodes.description: If you love Mexican 7 layer dip with tortilla chips...this is the Greek version served with Pita chips! It's layer upon layer of delicious Greek spreads topped with fresh veggies and zesty herbs. This appetizer could not be easier to put together and it's something really unique to serve to your guests. Try it out!

episodes.title: How To Make Lime Sorbet Margaritas
episodes.description: This sweet, refreshing recipe is part cocktail, part dessert....and totally delicious! You can use Tequila if you're making them for adults only or sub in some lime soda if kids will be joining you. Either way, you can't go wrong! Try these out the next time you need an elegant summer treat to serve your guests.

episodes.title: Apple Nachos
episodes.description: This dish is a really fun take on classic nachos. Instead of tortilla chips and cheese, you use green apples and top them with all sorts of sweet, gooey treats! Yes, they're completely decadent...but hey, at least you're starting with fresh fruit, right? This is a good one for both kids and parents, you really can't go wrong.

episodes.title: Avocado Bruschetta
episodes.description: Kelly shares her easy to make and assemble Avocado Bruschetta. It is light and delicious and you should give it a try!

episodes.title: Creamy Sausage Gravy Recipe
episodes.description: This hearty, comforting dish is basically a modern twist on classic biscuits and gravy. It's super simple to make and couldn't be more satisfying...give it a try!

episodes.title: How To Make Miso Salmon
episodes.description: This mouthwatering recipe from Louise Leonard is much more than your basic fish and veggies. The unique flavors and creative preparation really make this dish something special...give it a try!

episodes.title: Mint Julep Cocktail Bourbon Classic Recipe
episodes.description: There's only one cocktail you should enjoy on Derby weekend...and that's the classic mint julep! Louise Leonard shows you how to whip up this sweet, minty southern specialty. Get ready to get your Bourbon on!

episodes.title: How To make Cardamom Rice Pudding
episodes.description: Louise Leonard gives us a delicious twist on classic rice pudding by adding cardamom, raisins and mango. This creamy dessert has plenty of sweet and a hint of spice...it's sure to please!

episodes.title: How To Make Baked Curry Fries
episodes.description: If you love fries (and really, who doesn't??) you won't want to miss this recipe from Louise Leonard. These zesty, curry fries are baked instead of fried, so they're a bit healthier...but the spicy orange ketchup makes them burst with flavor. YUM!

episodes.title: How To Make An Avocado Milkshake
episodes.description: Louise Leonard shares her recipe for a smooth, creamy milkshake with an unexpected ingredient...avocado! Try this one out, it's healthy and delicious!

episodes.title: Watermelon Margarita
episodes.description: If you're a fan of margaritas, you'll really love this fun twist on the classic cocktail that includes fresh watermelon. It's light, refreshing and the perfect way to celebrate on a beautiful spring or summer day. Cheers!

episodes.title: Blueberry Cream Cheese Puff Pastry
episodes.description: If you love tangy blueberries, luscious cream cheese and warm, flaky puff pastry...you won't want to miss this yummy dessert recipe from Louise Leonard. It would even make a good breakfast if you're feeling the need to indulge!

episodes.title: Ultimate Breakfast Sandwich
episodes.description: This warm, cheesy egg sandwich is a "go to" weekend breakfast for Liesl and her family. It's got salty meat, fresh arugula and a dash of hot sauce at the end for some kick. Try this one out for breakfast or dinner, it's a winner!

episodes.title: How To Make Chicken Paillards
episodes.description: Everybody needs a few great recipes that only require five ingredients and 15 minutes or less to prepare. Life is busy and shortcuts like that are a must! This one from Liesl Maggiore is really fast, but packed with fresh ingredients and bright flavors. Add it to your week night mix and save the extra time for something else!

episodes.title: How To Make Homemade Buttermilk Ranch Dressing
episodes.description: Liesl Maggiore shows you how to make fresh, tangy, homemade buttermilk ranch. This super simple dressing is much healthier than the store bought kind...and it's perfect for salads or dipping. She pairs it with an amazing BBQ chicken salad that you won't want to miss. Put this one on your summer menu!

episodes.title: How To Make Fresh Berry Frozen Yogurt Pops
episodes.description: Summer's here and what better treat to give your kids (or enjoy yourself!) on a hot day than a perfectly delicious Popsicle? These healthy pops from Liesl Maggiore are made with fresh berries and yogurt...they're cold, creamy and delicious!

episodes.title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Skewers
episodes.description: The perfect party appetizer! Liesl Maggiore shares her delicious recipe for Grilled Shrimp Skewers. Marinated in lemon, garlic and olive oil, it couldn't be easier!

episodes.title: Whiskey Spiked Arnold Palmer
episodes.description: The classic Arnold Palmer is a sweet, refreshing drink that everyone loves! That delicious ice-tea and lemonade combo gets a grown up twist in this cocktail recipe from Jess Dang. Try it at your next summer BBQ!

episodes.title: How To Make Red Curry Shrimp
episodes.description: Cooking is such a creative process and it's always fun to branch out and try new ingredients. If you're not too familiar with coconut milk and curry...you should be! This recipe from Jess Dang really is a must try! It's sweet and spicy...warm and comforting...and it couldn't be easier to make. Enjoy!

episodes.title: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
episodes.description: These delicious lettuce cups from Jess Dang are filled with chicken in a scrumptious sauce and topped with fresh mint. They make the perfect appetizer or a really nice, light dinner as well. They're especially great for anyone trying to watch their carbs!

episodes.title: How To Make Ice Cream Sandwiches
episodes.description: Who doesn't love a good old fashioned ice-cream sandwich? The sky's the limit when it comes to different cookie, ice cream and topping combos you could experiment with...and as Jess Dang says, they bring you right back to your childhood! This simple dessert really is the perfect treat for your whole family or a fun way to end a dinner party. So what are you waiting for?

episodes.title: How To Make Homemade Berry Vinaigrette Dressing
episodes.description: Why buy salad dressing at the market when it's SO easy to make at home!? This sweet, berry vinaigrette from Jess Dang is the perfect dressing to keep in your fridge all week. It's light and tangy...the perfect topping for a summer salad. Enjoy! Berry Vinaigrette

episodes.title: BBQ Baby Back Ribs Ultimate Grill Recipe
episodes.description: It's time to hit the grill! Bob Guiney (@bobguiney) shares the secret recipe for his famous baby back ribs...special requested by all his friends at every BBQ/pool party. These mouth watering ribs are packed with flavor and literally falling off the bone tender. You HAVE to try this recipe...it's sure to be a huge hit!

episodes.title: How to Make Grilled Parmesan Asparagus
episodes.description: This scrumptious recipe from Bob Guiney takes your basic asparagus to a whole new level of delicious!! These aren't your mom's boiled asparagus...they're grilled, crunchy and smothered in parmesan! The perfect summer side dish.

episodes.title: Guiney Lily Summer Cocktail Recipe
episodes.description: This refreshing summer cocktail is inspired by one of Bob Guiney's favorite drinks from the Kentucky Derby. It's colorful and delicious...try it at your next cocktail party or summer BBQ.

episodes.title: How to Make the Perfect Panini
episodes.description: When it comes to sandwiches... stuffed, grilled, perfectly pressed paninis are KING! This one from Bob Guiney is filled with mozzarella cheese, fresh tomatoes and creamy avocado...then topped with crispy bacon! What could be better than that?

episodes.title: Caramel Coconut Sundae Recipe
episodes.description: This sweet treat from Bob Guiney is a nice change from the classic hot fudge sundae! It's got melted caramel and crunchy, toasted coconut...but let's be honest, you still need your chocolate fix, so there's chips in there as well! Give it a try!

episodes.title: BBQ Hot Wing Burger
episodes.description: Celebrating the 4th of July is synonymous with enjoying a great burger! Enjou

episodes.title: How to Make Easy Cake Pops
episodes.description: This recipe goes out to @tiffasaurusrex83, who wanted to know how to make a cake pop. Hope this helps

episodes.title: Easy Creme Brulee Recipe
episodes.description: This recipe goes out to @unicornkimchi, who wanted to know how to make creme brulee. Hope this helps!

episodes.title: How to Make Homemade Hummus
episodes.description: This recipe goes out to @tiffasaurusrex83 who wanted to know how to make homemade hummus

episodes.title: How to Cut An Avocado
episodes.description: Sienna DeGovia shows you how to properly pit and slice a rich, creamy avocado.

episodes.title: How to Slice Garlic
episodes.description: Sienna DeGovia shows you how to properly slice garlic.

episodes.title: Red, White and Blue Sundae
episodes.description: We love this colorful, patriotic recipe from Sienna! It's rich, creamy coconut ice cream smothered in blueberry sauce and fresh strawberries. Try it out this 4th of July!

episodes.title: Curried Quinoa Salad
episodes.description: Quinoa is one of those things everyone should cook with more often. It's really healthy and SO versatile....you can do so many delicious things with it! This recipe from Adrianna Adarme (http://www.acozykitchen.com) makes a delactable side dish or vegetarian entree. It's got curry, veggies, sweet raisins and salty feta. MMMMM.......

episodes.title: Watermelon Mint Sangria
episodes.description: Sangria is a great summertime cocktail. It's cool, refreshing, and a great way to entertain friends. For more great recipes from Adriana, check out her blog http://www.acozykitchen.com

episodes.title: What's for Dinner Monday: Slow Cooker Chicken
episodes.description: If you don't have a slow cooker that's OK, you can also roast the chicken in the oven as well. Enjoy!

episodes.title: What's for Dinner Wednesday: Veggie Tacos
episodes.description: These vegetarian tacos are a great mid-week dish that's loaded with veggies and comes together quickly! Enjoy!

episodes.title: What's for Dinner Tuesday: Chicken Summer Rolls
episodes.description: When it's hot outside and you don't feel like cooking, these Chicken Summer Rolls are a great go-to dish. It's also a great way to use up any leftover chicken you may have in the fridge. Enjoy! "

episodes.title: What's for Dinner Friday: Stir Fried Rice
episodes.description: The idea behind this recipe is that you will use all the leftovers from your week of cooking to make one killer stir fry. If all that cooking has pooped you out, I recommend stopping by one of your local Chinese take-outs and grabbing the rice a few days before you plan on making this dish. You will be thankful you did!

episodes.title: How to Seed a Pomegranate
episodes.description: If you're like most of us...trying to get the seeds out of a pomegranate is not only difficult, but also MESSY! Whitney Webster shows you a simple trick to remove the seeds without staining everything around you.

episodes.title: How to Make Guacamole
episodes.description: This recipe goes out to @jieunmpark who wanted to know how to make the perfect guacamole. Hope this helps....grab some chips and enjoy!

episodes.title: Skillet Veggie Burgers Recipe
episodes.description: This video goes out to @seanpereira013 who wanted to know how to make a delicious veggie burger.

episodes.title: How to Shuck An Oyster
episodes.description: Whitney webster shows you the fail proof way to shuck an oyster. Enjoy!

episodes.title: How to Cut a Pineapple
episodes.description: Do you ever struggle with this sharp, tropical fruit? Whitney Webster shows you 2 ways to cut a pineapple

episodes.title: Spicy Citrus Splash Cocktail
episodes.description: When spicy meets sweet...it's a festival of flavors that can't be beat! Try this specialty cocktail from Whitney Webster...it's a good one!

episodes.title: The Perfect Cheese Platter
episodes.description: Creating the perfect cheese platter is a skill that every home cook should have. Whitney Webster shows you all the elements you need to pull off a cheese platter that's sure to impress!

episodes.title: Surf & Turf BBQ Grilled Recipe
episodes.description: Looking for a summertime treat on the BBQ? Consider a surf & turf dinner! A sure crowd pleaser for any get together!

episodes.title: Warm Spinach Salad, Bacon and Fried Egg
episodes.description: A delicious low-carb dinner that's inexpensive, and packed with nutrients! Consider the warm spinach salad with crispy bacon and a fried egg. Yum!

episodes.title: Cantaloupe Agua Fresca Drink Recipe
episodes.description: This sweet, refreshing recipe is a home run...give it a try!

episodes.title: Mexican Fruit Salad Recipe
episodes.description: Summer is in full swing, and if the heat is getting you down, try this! A refreshing Mexican Fruit Salad, with a chili powder kick! A great combo, anytime of day!

episodes.title: Coconut Chai Iced Tea Recipe
episodes.description: This summer instead of the same old "ice tea" switch things up with a "Chai Iced Tea".  Delicious, exotic and easy to do!

episodes.title: Veracruz Style Grilled Whole Fish
episodes.description: We say the best way to enjoy fresh fish is to grill it whole. It stays moist and won't dry out. It's also easier than you think. Especially if you have your fish monger gut and filet the fish first. Here's an easy recipe to get started. Enjoy!

episodes.title: Fried Green Tomatoes with Garlic Aioli
episodes.description: If your garden tomatoes are taking their sweet time to ripen, consider eating them green! Here's an easy recipe for this Southern classic. Enjoy!

episodes.title: BLT Crostini
episodes.description: When it comes to easy, delicious appetizers...crostinis are a great way to go!  This one from Whitney Webster is a fun twist on a classic BLT. Enjoy!

episodes.title: Seared Ahi Tuna With Warm Veggie Salad
episodes.description: This healthy and delicious dish from Whitney has 5 ingredients and takes 15 minutes or less to prepare. It's perfect for a quick meal any night of the week...or try it out at your next dinner party!

episodes.title: Poached Apricots With Greek Yogurt
episodes.description: This bright, colorful dessert from Whitney Webster is a unique and simple dish that's sure to wow the crowd!

episodes.title: Rosemary Vodka Lemonade
episodes.description: We love this light, refreshing cocktail from Whitney. Make a beautiful batch at your next party!

episodes.title: Baked Egg Cups in Prosciutto
episodes.description: These beautiful baked egg cups from Whitney make the perfect brunch dish. They're so impressive and could not possibly be any easier to make. Give them a try!

episodes.title: Grilled Flatbread With Plums And Burrata
episodes.description: This beautiful appetizer from Liesl (http://www.lieslicious.com) is a sweet and savory delight...and it only takes 15 minutes to prepare!

episodes.title: Grilled Halibut With Nectarine Salsa Recipe
episodes.description: Fruit and fish are such a healthy, delicious combo. Try this quick and easy recipe from Liesl (http://www.lieslicious.com)... it's sure to impress!

episodes.title: Roasted Strawberries With Pound Cake
episodes.description: Summertime strawberries are so amazing on their own, but this dessert takes them to a completely decadent level.  Lightly toasting store-bought pound cake on a grill pan (or in a skillet) with these delicious berries is a great time-saving way to make an impressive & indulgent dessert in minutes.

episodes.title: Blackberry Crush Cocktail
episodes.description: Specialty cocktails are such a great way to impress your guests. One of our favorite food bloggers, Liesl (http://www.lieslicious.com) shares this recipe for a muddled blackberry Crush.

episodes.title: How to Make Gingerbreadman Cookie Recipe
episodes.description: Feeling the panic of holiday gift giving? Not to worry, help is on the way!

episodes.title: Baked French Toast with Cherry Compote
episodes.description: Beth is sharing one of her favourite breakfast treat, it is baked Almond French Toast with Cherry Compote. I love the recipe because I can make this all the night before.

episodes.title: Beth's Eggnog Cupcakes
episodes.description: Beth: Merry Christmas! If you are looking for last minute desert idea for Christmas dinner I have fun one for you.

episodes.title: Beth's Salmon Blinis
episodes.description: Happy New Year! Give this quick appetizer a try!

episodes.title: Beth's Power Breakfast
episodes.description: Take a break from all the sugar and try this healthy sugar-free, gluten-free muffins and power breakfast. A great way to start the day!

episodes.title: Liesl's Peanut Butter Hot Chocolate with Heart Shaped Marshmallows
episodes.description: Holy moly, this is good! It's like a creamy, frothy, hot & melty peanut butter chocolate cup in a mug! It's decadent & comforting and oh-so-simple. What incredibly delicious and easy way to say "i love you"...perfect for a Valentine's breakfast treat, an after school surprise for the kiddos, or to finish a romantic dinner.

episodes.title: Liesl's Easy Asparagus Pasta
episodes.description: This pasta recipe is unique in that you actually make a smooth sauce by pureeing the asparagus.  The result is bright, creamy and the most beautiful green color!  This pasta is great as a side dish or as a vegetarian main course.

episodes.title: Liesl's Perfect Turkey Burger
episodes.description: Turkey burgers are a great low-fat alternative to beef, but they definitely need a little extra love to give them some flavor. On it's own, turkey can be totally bland and easily dry out, but a few simple additions to the meat and careful timing will make them an incredibly juicy, delicious & nutritious option for any bbq!

episodes.title: Kelly's Rosemary Lamb Chops and Easy Couscous
episodes.description: An easy to make lamb dish any meat lover will enjoy and the whole process will take no more than 25 minutes.

episodes.title: Kelly's Avocado, Corn, Black Bean, Tomato Salad
episodes.description: A simple and easy to put together recipe, yet delicious. Go ahead and try this Avocado, Corn, Black Bean and Tomato Salad!

episodes.title: Kelly's Seared Scallop Pasta
episodes.description: Scallops are so easy to cook, mix up your everyday recipes and try something new!! You don't know what you're missing till you try it!

episodes.title: Louise's Shamwreck Shake
episodes.description: Enjoy St Patrick's Day with Louise's “shamwreck” shake. A nice minty shake with a little kick that adults will enjoy.

episodes.title: Louise's Fried Plantains with Mojo Sauce
episodes.description: A fun and easy recipe. Serve as an appetizer or side dish, enjoy!

episodes.title: Louise's Eggs and Grits
episodes.description: Louise's take on southern style breakfast inspired by her mother. Give these eggs and grits a try.

episodes.title: Liesl's Turkey Roulade
episodes.description: This Thanksgiving give Liesl's Turkey Roulade a try! It's a great alternative to your traditional Turkey dish.

episodes.title: Johnny Cakes
episodes.description: Love pancakes? How about some beautiful crispy, fluffy corn meal style pancakes. Serve with fresh grapes and maple syrup and start off your morning right.

episodes.title: Jalapeno Poppers
episodes.description: Grilled Bacon-Wrapped Jalapeno Poppers by Louise Leonard. Enjoy these great appetizers on game day with a nice cold beer!

episodes.title: Hobo Packs Miso Sweet Potato
episodes.description: Camping or grilling this summer? Make sure to try these miso sweet potatoes hobo packs,  they are easy to make and taste amazing.

episodes.title: Bourguignon Meatloaf
episodes.description: Louise's bourguignon meatloaf, a twist to the all american classic meatloaf recipe.

episodes.title: Seared Salmon
episodes.description: Liesl shares one of her favorite fish dishes. Seared Salmon with lemon yogurt sauce. Perfect dish for a family weeknight dinner or fancy dinner with friends.

episodes.title: Coffee Granita
episodes.description: The perfect way to cool off  this summer and get a burst of energy! Check out this coffee granita recipe from Liesl!

episodes.title: Cranberry Almond Chicken Salad
episodes.description: A little twist on the classic chicken salad. Prepare ahead of time and be ready to entertain when guests arrive. Easy to prepare and your guest will love it!

episodes.title: Lemon Sorbet with Raspberry Puree
episodes.description: Enjoy this lemon sorbet with fresh raspberry sauce dessert.

episodes.title: Sausage and Pepper Subs
episodes.description: Sausage and Pepper Subs brought to you by Kelly Bryson-Pearce

episodes.title: Orzo with Beets and Arugula
episodes.description: Orzo with beets and arugula, an easy to make orzo side dish. It is full of bright flavors and color.

episodes.title: Strawberry Spinach Salad
episodes.description: Kelly shares her strawberry spinach salad recipe. An easy to put together side dish. It is sweet, crunchy and full of beautiful colors and flavors.

episodes.title: Lunchbox Veggie Fried Rice
episodes.description: Quick and easy to make lunch that kids will love and you'll feel good knowing they're eating their veggies!

episodes.title: Caramel Apple Sundae
episodes.description: All the flavors of a caramel apple thrown into a sweet and delicious sundae. Give it a try!

episodes.description: The Marshalls and the Pakuni struggle to rescue Dopey from a deadly swamp.

episodes.description: While exploring the mist marsh, Rick and Will discover a strange ship and the being who runs it.

episodes.description: The Sleestak sabotage the clock Pylon, plunging the Land of the Lost into endless night.

episodes.description: Holly, Will and Cha-Ka band together in the wake of devastating losses.

episodes.description: A runaway canoe sends Holly careening into the clutches of a mysterious young woman.

episodes.description: Jack and Holly must rid the valley of a fire-breathing dinosaur in order to save Will's life.

episodes.description: The Marshals try to bring sworn enemies together.

titles.title: Land of the Lost
titles.description: Tom and his two teen children, Kevin and younger sister Annie, find themselves trapped in a parallel universe when their jeep falls into the time portal while exploring the countryside; together, they must learn to survive.

episodes.title: Tasha
episodes.description: The members of the Porter family find themselves trapped in a prehistoric world; they face a Tyrannosaurus rex and find a dinosaur egg that hatches.

episodes.title: Something's Watching
episodes.description: Tom is bitten and poisoned by a lizard while searching for a mystery woman Kevin caught on film; the mystery woman, named Christa, helps Kevin look for an antidote.

episodes.title: Shung The Terrible
episodes.description: Tom and Kevin go to rescue Tasha after she is kidnapped by lizard people called Sleestaks.

episodes.title: Jungle Girl
episodes.description: A lunar eclipse causes the animals and dinosaurs of the land to act strangely; Tom desperately tries to find Christa again.

episodes.title: The Crystal
episodes.description: Annie is turned evil by the power of a crystal that the Sleestaks lost.

episodes.title: Wild Thing
episodes.description: Tom decides to send Tasha back into the wild after she causes too much trouble.

episodes.title: Day For Knight
episodes.description: A knight named Sir Balen arrives in a portal similar to the one the Porters arrived in.

episodes.title: Kevin vs. The Volcano
episodes.description: Kevin falls into an underground cave and gets stuck there by Scarface while trying to help his family stop an erupting volcano from destroying their home.

episodes.title: Mind Games
episodes.description: Shung uses a magic crystal to control Christa's mind.

episodes.title: Flight To Freedom
episodes.description: The family discovers weird noise and static coming from Kevin's TV after an earthquake; Tom thinks the TV can be used to track down a portal to get them home.

episodes.title: Heat Wave
episodes.description: Tom and Kevin go to find water while Stink and Tasha look for fruit during a heat wave.

episodes.title: The Thief
episodes.description: Kevin accuses Stink of ransacking the house.

episodes.title: Power Play
episodes.description: Tom sets out to take crystals from the Sleestaks to see if they can power the electrical items when all their batteries die.

episodes.title: The Sorceress
episodes.description: Annie befriends a sorceress named Keela after she is banished to the land by a king.

episodes.title: Dreammaker
episodes.description: The Porters mistakenly think they have found their way back home while searching for the source of a mysterious TV signal from Earth.

episodes.title: Opah
episodes.description: Stink's grandfather comes to visit.

episodes.title: The Gladiators
episodes.description: Tom and Kevin are forced by Shung to fight each other for their lives.

episodes.title: Life's A Beach
episodes.description: Christa experiences haunting memories of her past during a day at the beach.

episodes.title: Future Boy
episodes.description: A boy from the future unknowingly brings a dangerous and intelligent enemy with him.

episodes.title: Siren's Song
episodes.description: An image of Tom's late wife lures the Porters to a hidden grotto.

episodes.title: In Dinos We Trust
episodes.description: Kevin is forced to rely on Tasha to lead him and his family to safety after he is blinded by a spitting viper.

episodes.title: Annie In Charge
episodes.description: When Tom and Kevin lose their memories in one of Cy's defensive traps, Annie must take over.

episodes.title: Make My Day
episodes.description: Kevin plans to use the power of an ancient Sleestak weapon to even the odds with Shung.

episodes.title: Cheers
episodes.description: Kevin winds up in trouble with Christa, his family, and even the Sleestaks after becoming intoxicated from fermented fruit.

episodes.title: Sorceress's Apprentice
episodes.description: Annie is entrusted with Keela's spell book while she is away for a few days and can't resist trying out a little magic.

episodes.title: Misery Loves Company
episodes.description: Stink enjoys all the extra attention he gets after injuring his leg while helping the Porters.

titles.title: Landfill
titles.description: A little girl finds a necklace at a landfill, then begins to see the ghost of a girl her age. She sets out to help the ghost discover the mystery behind her death.

titles.title: Leaning Into the Wind: Andy Goldsworthy
titles.description: British sculptor and environmentalist Andy Goldsworthy uses his natural surroundings to create works of art in San Francisco, St. Louis, New England, Brazil, Scotland and France.

titles.title: Legend of the Tsunami Warrior
titles.description: A young man (Sorapong Chatree) uses magic powers against the pirate (Jarunee Suksawat) who killed his father.

titles.title: Leprechaun
titles.description: Dan O'Grady (Shay Duffin) steals 100 gold coins from a leprechaun (Warwick Davis) while on vacation in Ireland. The leprechaun follows him home, but Dan locks the murderous midget in a crate, held at bay by a four-leaf clover. Ten years later, J.D. Redding (John Sanderford) and his daughter, Tory (Jennifer Aniston), rent O'Grady's property for the summer. When their new neighbors accidentally release the leprechaun, he goes on a murderous rampage to reclaim his gold.

titles.title: Leprechaun 2
titles.description: A leprechaun (Warwick Davis) surfaces in Los Angeles to claim a bride, as his previous object of affection was denied to him a thousand years before in Ireland. He kidnaps teenager Bridget (Shevonne Durkin), grotesquely murdering anyone who gets in his way. It falls to Bridget's boyfriend, Cody (Charlie Heath), to rescue her. Cody enlists the aid of his perpetually tipsy uncle, Morty (Sandy Baron), who decides to go after the homicidal leprechaun's pot of gold.

titles.title: Leprechaun 3
titles.description: One night in Las Vegas, a pawn shop owner purchases a statue of a leprechaun from a mysterious stranger. He ignores the stranger's warning to never remove the statue's golden medallion and takes it for himself. Instantly the statue transforms into the murderous Leprechaun, who vows to kill anyone who takes his gold. Scott McCoy, who unwittingly took a gold coin from the pawn shop, and Tammy, Scott's new friend, are first on the list.

titles.title: Leprechaun 4 in Space
titles.description: Resurfacing on an alien planet, the Leprechaun (Warwick Davis) abducts a member of the world's royalty, Princess Zarina (Rebekah Carlton), in an attempt to wed her and become the supreme ruler. Unfortunately for the diminutive schemer, well-armed soldiers arrive to foil his plans. Not easily defeated, however, the feisty Leprechaun continues to battle the warriors while also contending with the warped scientist known as Dr. Mittenhand (Guy Siner).

titles.title: Leprechaun 5: In the Hood
titles.description: When aspiring hip-hop performers Butch (Red Grant), Postmaster P. (Anthony Montgomery) and Stray Bullet (Rashaan Nall) cross record producer Mack Daddy (Ice-T), their grudge against him leads to their own peril. After they break into Mack Daddy's home and swipe an ancient medallion from a grotesque statue, the evil Leprechaun (Warwick Davis) is freed from his magical prison. Soon the sinister little man is on the trail of Butch, Postmaster P. and Stray Bullet, along with Mack Daddy himself.

titles.title: Leprechaun: Back 2 tha Hood
titles.description: City hairdresser Emily Woodrow (Tangi Miller) finds the answer to her financial problems when she stumbles upon a chest brimming with gold. Although she and her friends quickly go from rags to riches, they discover that the gold belongs to someone else: an evil leprechaun (Warwick Davis) who has returned from hell to claim his treasure. Speaking in riddles and rhymes, the demon stalks his victims with ruthless determination -- and scores some excellent pot along the way.

titles.title: Let the Right One In
titles.description: When Oskar (Kåre Hedebrant), a sensitive, bullied 12-year-old boy living with his mother in suburban Sweden, meets his new neighbor, the mysterious and moody Eli (Lina Leandersson), they strike up a friendship. Initially reserved with each other, Oskar and Eli slowly form a close bond, but it soon becomes apparent that she is no ordinary young girl. Eventually, Eli shares her dark, macabre secret with Oskar, revealing her connection to a string of bloody local murders.

titles.title: Letters to God
titles.description: A troubled mailman (Jeffrey S.S. Johnson) befriends the family of a boy (Tanner Maguire) who copes with cancer by writing daily notes to God.

titles.title: Life in Motion
titles.description: Derek Hough is sharing healthy tips, learning new skills, and catching up with friends on Life In Motion! Explore how to maintain a healthy mind and body on this energizing journey.

episodes.title: Derek Hough's Life Update Vlog
episodes.description: Derek Hough introduces his new show, Life in Motion with a "where I am now" update on his life, the house he's building, being a judge on a competitive dance show, and what values he's embracing moving forward.

episodes.title: What I Eat In A Day
episodes.description: Derek Hough takes you through a full day of eating, including healthy recipes for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks in between!

episodes.title: Derek Hough On Touring & Dancing
episodes.description: Derek Hough talks about his upcoming solo tour, and what it is like behind the scenes on the road!

episodes.title: Derek Hough on Staying Hydrated
episodes.description: Derek Hough outlines just what it takes to stay hydrated! Learn how much water to drink and how hydration is beneficial for your health and energy!

episodes.title: Derek Hough's Post Workout Routine
episodes.description: Derek Hough explains his post workout routine. From food to stretching he walks you through how to recover from a workout.

episodes.title: Amy Purdy on Taking Action
episodes.description: Amy Purdy and Derek Hough talk about taking action and overcoming obstacles in your life in this interview!

episodes.title: Courage | Spoken Word by Derek Hough
episodes.description: Spoken word performance by Derek Hough on the topic of courage.

episodes.title: Derek Hough’s Nastia Liukin Interview
episodes.description: Derek Hough interviews Nastia Liukin about her journey to win a gold medal for USA gymnastics in 2008!

episodes.title: Derek Hough's Gymnastics with Nastia Liukin
episodes.description: Derek Hough learns gymnastics from Olympic Gold Medalist and former Dancing with the Stars partner, Nastia Liukin!

episodes.title: Derek Hough Tries Muay Thai
episodes.description: Derek Hough is no stranger to athletic training, but these Muay Thai boxing basics are harder than they look!

titles.title: Life Itself
titles.description: Filmmaker Steve James chronicles the life of film critic Roger Ebert, especially his career highlights, his battle with alcohol, and his sometimes ruthless rivalry with fellow critic Gene Siskel.

titles.title: Like Father, Like Son
titles.description: Ryota learns that his biological son was switched at birth with the boy he has raised, and he must make a life-impacting decision between his two sons.

titles.title: Lila & Eve
titles.description: After the senseless murder of her son (Aml Ameen), a grief-stricken mother (Viola Davis) joins forces with another woman (Jennifer Lopez) for vigilante justice.

titles.title: Little Girl Lost: The Delimar Vera Story
titles.description: While Luz and Pedro Vera are hosting a Christmas party in 1997, a fire erupts on the second floor. In the chaos, all the children escape safely except for Delimar, the couple's baby daughter. No remains are found, and Luz suspects her child has been kidnapped. Pedro, fearing Luz is delusional, eventually leaves her. Six years later, Luz runs into a six-year-old child who she becomes convinced is her missing daughter.

titles.title: Little Joe
titles.description: A plant created via genetic engineering appears to produce curious changes in the people and animals it comes into contact with.

titles.title: Little Red Wagon
titles.description: Zach (Chandler Canterbury) sets out to help the homeless of America with his wagon.

titles.title: Liz & Dick
titles.description: Actress Elizabeth Taylor (Lindsay Lohan) and actor Richard Burton (Grant Bowler) begin a roller-coaster romance.

titles.title: Lost in America
titles.description: Chronicles homelessness in the United States from the points of view of homeless people, politicians and charitable organizations.

titles.title: Lost in La Mancha
titles.description: Visionary director Terry Gilliam has a dream. He wants to film the classic story of Don Quixote by recasting it as a trippy, time-traveling, mistaken-identity adventure with Johnny Depp as Quixote. After struggling for years to get financing, insurance and a cast in place, Gilliam travels to Spain and promptly watches his dream fall apart. From flash floods to cast no-shows to serious injuries, Gilliam and his crew suffer one setback after another.

titles.title: Love After Lockup
titles.description: The phrase "ball and chain" takes on a whole new meaning in "Love After Lockup." Couples meet their potential future spouses for the first time once the bars are removed from the relationship. The way is full of bumps -- and some strong emotions -- along its rocky road, but these inmates are tasting freedom for the first time in a long while. Viewers follow along as they leave their paper and pen behind and jump straight into dating, meeting the family and experiencing other first-time, nerve-wracking moments.
categories: Upgrade to Watch the Latest Season

episodes.title: From Felon to Fiancé
episodes.description: Johnna plans a wedding after Garrett's prison release, despite her father's doubts; Andrea has a meltdown at her Mormon bridal shower; James' friend fears Alla's addiction past; Scott falls for hustler, Lizzie.

episodes.title: New Warden in Town
