episodes.title: Japan With Milo Ventimiglia
episodes.description: Norman Reedus travels from Kyoto to Osaka, Japan, with actor Milo Ventimiglia, taking in its cultural traditions and meeting some creative locals along the way.

episodes.title: Costa Rica With Dom Rocket
episodes.description: Norman Reedus and DJ Dom Rocket traverse the jungles and coasts of Costa Rica while doing some extreme riding, and exploring its natural beauty.

episodes.title: Uruguay With Becky Goebel
episodes.description: Norman Reedus and Becky Goebel learn about the easygoing country of Uruguay while riding with locals to take in the rich culture it has to offer.

episodes.title: Kentucky With Clifton Collins Jr.
episodes.description: Norman Reedus rides from Louisville to the Red River Gorge with actor Clifton Collins Jr., embracing the quintessential Kentucky experience.

episodes.title: The North Island of New Zealand With Josh Brolin
episodes.description: Norman Reedus explores the harbor city of Auckland before meeting up with actor Josh Brolin; together they discover a rich native Maori culture and an affinity for motor sports amongst the stunning North Island landscape.

episodes.title: The South Island of New Zealand With Dylan McDermott
episodes.description: Actor Dylan McDermott joins Norman Reedus for a scenic trip along New Zealand's majestic South Island; navigating dramatic mountain roads, they take in some of the most rugged, unpredictable landscape in a remote corner of the world.

episodes.title: Journey Down Norman's Memory Lane
episodes.description: Norman Reedus looks back at his favorite moments from the previous four seasons, revisiting trips with Peter Fonda, Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Melissa McBride, and Dave Chappelle and remembering time spent in Japan, Costa Rica, Europe, and Uruguay.

episodes.title: America: Cross Country Adventure
episodes.description: From the Pacific Coast Highway to the city of New York, Norman Reedus recalls his favorite experiences traveling America from coast to coast, on rides through the country with Steven Yeun, Austin Amelio, Sean Patrick Flanery, and Dave Chappelle.

episodes.title: Globetrotting on Two Wheels
episodes.description: From his travels, Norman Reedus has discovered it's the people who make the journey; he looks back on those he's met and the lessons he's learned throughout the world with guests Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Melissa McBride, Ryan Hurst, and Milo Ventimiglia.

episodes.title: The Road Less Traveled: Behind the Scenes
episodes.description: Norman Reedus joins the crew as they revisit their most unusual and surprising experiences on the road throughout the years, telling behind-the-scenes stories and pulling the curtains back to reveal what it took to get there.

episodes.title: The Utah Desert With Keanu Reeves
episodes.description: Norman Reedus and actor Keanu Reeves journey through the otherworldly landscapes of the Utah desert; from the Bonneville Salt Flats to Canyonlands National Park to a motorcycle bash in the canyons of Moab, it's one epic adventure.

episodes.title: Northern Italy With Josh Holloway
episodes.description: Actor Josh Holloway joins Norman Reedus for a ride through rustic Northern Italy; navigating through some of the most scenic roads in Europe, they quench their need for speed in Motor Valley before exploring Josh's old stomping grounds in Bologna.

episodes.title: The Eternal City With Johnny Knoxville
episodes.description: Accompanied by actor Johnny Knoxville, Norman Reedus navigates his way through ancient Rome, the eternal city; taking in the cuisine and culture of the birthplace of Western Civilization.

episodes.title: Portugal: A Journey From Lisbon to Porto
episodes.description: Norman Reedus and artist Adri Law explore one of Europe's hottest destinations: Portugal; on a scenic ride up the country's western shoreline, they discover the impact the recent tourist boom has had on this old world country.

titles.title: Ring of Fire
titles.description: June Carter (Jewel) rises to fame as a country singer, while falling in love with the legendary Johnny Cash (Matt Ross).

titles.title: Road Wars
titles.description: Roadways can be a wild, dangerous and unpredictable place; with violent road rage incidents increasing 500% over the last decade, "road raging" is a human behavior that has become widely known and is one of the many threats to everyone on the road; "Road Wars" takes a deep dive into American roadways, examining extreme human behavior, wild weather and insane accidents causing trouble for drivers all over the country; the series is not all rage and fury, as welcome acts of kindness also tend to arise in these dire situations.

episodes.title: Quite A Load of Bull
episodes.description: An alleged scrape with a luxury car at a California convenience store triggers a street brawl; a woman in Australia repeatedly rams a vehicle with a disabled passenger inside; an escaped bull wreaks havoc on traffic in Brazil; a shooting suspect in a lifted pickup leads police on a wild chase through the streets of Ohio.

episodes.title: Runaway Cowboy
episodes.description: A cowboy takes his mule on a getaway ride from police in Kentucky; a family in Michigan takes on an erratic driver by diving into his window; a malfunctioning railroad gate in Poland traps a van on the tracks; a lane-splitting motorcyclist collides with a lane-changing driver on an overpass in Texas; a driver in Wisconsin fails to heed cross traffic at a stop sign.

episodes.title: Parking Space Invaders
episodes.description: A family's fierce defense of a parking space turns contentious with Florida officers; an SUV passes on the shoulder of a Virginia freeway with disastrous results; a motorist in China is run over by his own sedan; a car carrier's cargo bursts into flames in a New Jersey parking lot; a glitchy stop sign on a school bus causes a traffic jam in New York.

episodes.title: This Boot Was Made For Drivin'
episodes.description: A driver clashes with parking enforcement as they boot his car in Chicago; a stunting biker on a Missouri highway gets a furious response from a pickup; a woman suffers a medical emergency on a Michigan freeway with her child in the car; a California woman loses her phone while filming out her sunroof; a plane attempts an emergency landing on a car-filled Florida interstate.

titles.title: RoboDoc: The Creation of RoboCop
titles.description: An in-depth look into the groundbreaking franchise and featuring new interviews with cast and crew, including Hollywood icons such as Peter Weller, Diane Robin, Ronny Cox, Nancy Allen, Ray Wise, director Paul Verhoeven & more.

episodes.title: Destination Delta City
episodes.description: A deep dive into the making of the sci-fi masterpiece 'RoboCop.'

episodes.title: Verhoeven's Mantra
episodes.description: With the production in full swing, director Paul Verhoeven is pushing the envelope and many people's buttons; the shoot is heating up, and with the unprecedented filming conditions, the cast and crew are pushed to their limits.

episodes.title: Blood, Sweat and Steel
episodes.description: Featuring first-hand accounts from the cast and crew, as they relive the golden era of hands-on, practical filmmaking in the 1980s.

episodes.title: Murphy and The Machine
episodes.description: "The Creation of RoboCop" shows the franchise's impact on the action and science fiction genres, blazing a trail alongside "The Terminator," into the technologically driven cinema scape we see today.

titles.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles
titles.description: After a fatal shooting on the job leaves his career hanging by a thread, LAPD S.W.A.T. Sergeant Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson is forced into retirement, in retaliation for refusing to bury the truth. Two years later, he's back, tasked with building a new tactical unit from the department's most talented outcasts. The team, soon nicknamed the Exiles, includes a live-streaming hotshot, a socially awkward tech genius, a fiercely disciplined operator with something to prove, a wildcard with a troubled past, and a strategist with a hidden agenda. As the squad finds its footing under fire, Hondo uncovers something far more dangerous than any street threat: a mole in his ranks, and a conspiracy reaching into the LAPD's top brass and the Mayor's office; one built to tear S.W.A.T. apart from within.
categories: Upgrade to Watch the Latest Season

episodes.title: Clean Entry
episodes.description: Hondo Harrelson gets one shot at redemption: build an S.W.A.T. unit from LA's overlooked talent; the team clicks under fire, but one of Hondo's own made a promise that has nothing to do with protecting S.W.A.T.

titles.title: School Life
titles.description: Two inspiring teachers working at the only boarding school in Ireland for children ages 7 to 12 are followed for a year, as they begin to prepare for the end of their tenure.

titles.title: Scream Therapy
titles.description: Five female friends head to the desert for a weekend of restorative scream therapy. Their vacation soon takes a sharp turn when they cross paths with a few deadbeats who are on a very pressing deadline.

titles.title: Secrets of Mercy Hospital
titles.description: Returning to the working-class town she fled as a teenager, Kendra confronts the long-buried secret of the baby daughter she left behind. Facing pain, guilt and unanswered questions, she searches for healing, forgiveness and a second chance.

titles.title: Section 8
titles.description: Sentenced to prison for avenging the murder of his family, a former soldier gets a second chance when a shadowy government agency recruits him for an assignment. However, he soon realizes that the very people who freed him are not what they seem.

titles.title: Seduced: Inside the NXIVM Cult
titles.description: An inside look at the Nxivm cult and its enigmatic, manipulative founder Keith Raniere.

episodes.title: Hooked
episodes.description: India Oxenberg, the 28-year-old daughter of actress Catherine Oxenberg, speaks out for the first time about her involvement in NXIVM and how she became a branded sex slave.

titles.title: Seeds
titles.description: Ziggy receives her first internet influencer job offer to promote the seed and fertilizer company Nature's Oath. When her cousin calls her back to the reservation, she is compelled to fight to preserve the history of her people.

titles.title: Selling It in the ATL
titles.description: The Atlanta real estate market was once dominated by men, but women are increasingly making themselves known in the city's housing industry. This docuseries shines the spotlight on seven such women, who use their business acumen and larger-than-life personalities to close deals in the growing city. It's a seller's market as new buyers and investors flock to the ATL, embracing a new, progressive culture that is forcing the old guard to fight to remain relevant. The ladies' client lists include everyone from professional athletes to music industry executives and even foreign diplomats. The featured agents include Tahlia, who specializes in finding high-dollar leases for musicians making albums in the city, and New York native Chrishena, who brings her Big Apple attitude to Atlanta.

episodes.title: Deals in the Heels
episodes.description: Power broker A'lana seeks the biggest and baddest agents in the hot Atlanta market to join her team.

episodes.title: Turnt Up Tour
episodes.description: Sarah's plan to impress A'lana; Jae and Tahlia clash again; A'lana picks her multi-million dollar investor team.

episodes.title: Hired and Fired
episodes.description: Gwen hosts a ladies' brunch to celebrate her return to real estate but rumors about the father of her son threaten her good time; Chrishenna shows a condo to A'lana's investor; Jae and Tahlia are at it again.

episodes.title: Business and Pleasure
episodes.description: After a huge fight, Tahlia leaves LaKyle; Okevia's showing is a disaster; the ladies question Tahlia's behavior with a new male client at a pool party.

episodes.title: Indecent Proposals
episodes.description: Gwen celebrates her return to real estate; Chrishena shows a luxury condo; Tahlia & Jae hash out their differences.

episodes.title: Deals Go South
episodes.description: Jae surprises Alana with shocking accusations; Tahlia's luxury listing is ruined; Chrishena's mixer puts Sarah against Tahlia.

titles.title: Severed Ways: The Norse Discovery of America
titles.description: Two Vikings (Fiore Tedesco, Tony Stone) face a battle for survival in the North American wilderness.

titles.title: Sex Drive
titles.description: Lovable teen Ian has always been the best friend, not the boyfriend, and he thinks he's the last American virgin. Then online he meets Danielle, who is pretty, sweet, and really seems to like him. The trouble is Ian and Danielle live in different parts of the country. When she makes him an offer he can't refuse, Ian steals his brother's '69 GTO and sets out to meet her in person and lose his virginity.

titles.title: Seymour: An Introduction
titles.description: Pianist Seymour Bernstein, who gave up performing for teaching, discusses his passion for music and his philosophy of life.

titles.title: Shaft
titles.description: John Shaft Jr. may be an FBI cybersecurity expert, but to uncover the truth behind his best friend's untimely death, he needs an education that only his dad can provide. Absent throughout his childhood, the legendary John Shaft agrees to help his son navigate the heroin-infested underbelly of Harlem, N.Y. Besides, the locked and loaded Shaft has his own score to settle -- both professional and personal.

titles.title: She Made Them Do It
titles.description: Convicted of murder, Sarah Pender (Jenna Dewan Tatum) escapes from prison and becomes a most-wanted fugitive.

titles.title: Shortwave
titles.description: A researcher and his wife, suffering from the disappearance of their child, become haunted by a cryptic shortwave radio signal that causes hallucinations.

titles.title: Silencer
titles.description: A hit man comes out of retirement to rescue a kidnapped girl from a ruthless drug kingpin. Still haunted by the lives he took as a military sharpshooter, he sets out on a blood-soaked battle to bring the child back home.

titles.title: Silent Madness
titles.description: A psychiatrist (Belinda Montgomery) poses as an ex-sorority sister to stop a slasher freed by a computer error.

titles.title: SisterS
titles.description: Two women born continents apart, one Canadian and the other Irish, realize that they are half-sisters and embark on an eventful road trip in search of their alcoholic father.

episodes.title: They F*** You Up
episodes.description: After the death of Sare's mother, she decides to travel to Ireland to find her father, but she gets more than she bargained for.

episodes.title: Mind That Child
episodes.description: Suze realizes she has run out of options, so she reluctantly agrees to help Sare find their father.

episodes.title: This Too Shall Pass
episodes.description: The sisters are on the road, but it isn't long before they find themselves in a compromising position.

episodes.title: Every Time The Sun Comes Up, I'm In Trouble
episodes.description: After experiencing a betrayal, both Suze and Sare realize they are more alike than they initially thought.

episodes.title: I Can Change
episodes.description: Suze and Sare are back on their quest to find their father, so they travel to Carlingford where they are met by two surprise guests.

episodes.title: Happy Ever After
episodes.description: In an emotional reunion, the sisters finally find their father and realize that maybe he isn't what they needed in the first place.

titles.title: Skinamarink
titles.description: Two children wake up in the middle of the night to find their father is missing, and all the windows and doors in their home have vanished.

titles.title: Sleeping With a Killer
titles.description: The stories of ordinary people who met fatal ends because of jealousy, with a look at the dramatic and true events and the setbacks of the victims whose lives were forever changed.

episodes.title: Ryan Poston
episodes.description: After a woman calls 911 to report shooting her boyfriend in self-defense, investigators uncover a pristine crime scene and disturbing behavior that cast doubt on her story.

titles.title: Sleeping With Other People
titles.description: Twelve years after a one-night stand, a man (Jason Sudeikis) and a woman (Alison Brie) run into each other and try to maintain a platonic relationship despite their mutual attraction.

titles.title: Sleepwalk With Me
titles.description: Anxiety over his stalled career and outside pressure to marry his longtime lover (Lauren Ambrose) push a commitment-shy comic (Mike Birbiglia) to sleepwalk.

titles.title: Slumber Party Massacre II
titles.description: Courtney and her friends go to their condo for a weekend getaway, but Courtney can't get rid of the haunting feeling that a supernatural rockabilly driller killer is coming to murder them all.

titles.title: Sorority House Massacre
titles.description: Hospitalized Beth (Angela O'Neill) faces another massacre in the same house where her family was slain.

titles.title: Sorority Wars
titles.description: A college freshman (Lucy Hale) makes enemies when she refuses to pledge her mother's (Courtney Thorne-Smith) sorority.

titles.title: Soulmates
titles.description: In the very near future, a test is developed that incontrovertibly lets a person know who their soulmate is. The new science is clear, and no matter a person's current relationship status, whether they are single, dating or even married, this test will unmistakably point a person in the direction of their actual, scientifically determined soulmate. People in long-term relationships should not be content in believing they've already made the right choice. Even if a person seems to be deep in love with their current partner, this test may just prove that they are mistaken. After all, science knows best.

episodes.title: Watershed
episodes.description: Nikki and Franklin are happy in their marriage, but when everyone they know starts taking the soul-mate test, they must ask if their relationship is enough.

episodes.title: The Lovers
episodes.description: David's life is turned upside down when Alison presents him with proof she's his soul mate; they start a torrid affair, but everything may not be what it seems.

episodes.title: Little Adventures
episodes.description: Adam and Libby's happy but unconventional marriage is disrupted when Libby's test results come through; when gorgeous, fun-loving Miranda arrives in their lives, Libby struggles to draw lines between her feelings for her husband and her soul mate.

episodes.title: Layover
episodes.description: Mateo and Jonah meet at a bar and immediately hit it off; Mateo is furious when he discovers that Jonah stole his passport, sabotaging his chance to fly to Colombia to meet his soul mate the next day; they go on a wild adventure to get it back.

episodes.title: Break on Through
episodes.description: Devastated to discover that his soul mate is dead, big-hearted Kurt finds faith and opportunity in the arms of The Church of Righteous Transition, an organization that promises to help those whose soul mates have passed on.

episodes.title: The (Power) Ballad of Caitlin Jones
episodes.description: Caitlin has waited years for her soul mate match; her dreams come true when she's matched with a handsome doctor, Nathan; however, she discovers Nathan is harboring a dark secret.

titles.title: Sound of Noise
titles.description: A tone-deaf, music-hating cop tries to track down a group of guerrilla percussionists who are inundating the city with their anarchic concerts.

titles.title: Spartacus
titles.description: Betrayed by the Romans; forced into slavery; reborn as a Gladiator, torn from his homeland and the woman he loves, Spartacus is condemned to the brutal world of the arena where blood and death are prime-time entertainment.

episodes.title: The Red Serpent
episodes.description: A Thracian warrior has his destiny seized by an act of rebellious violence and as punishment he faces death by battling in the gladiatorial arena.

titles.title: Splinter
titles.description: When their plans for a nature trip go awry, Polly Watt (Jill Wagner) and boyfriend Seth Belzer (Paulo Costanzo) decide to check into a motel. On their way, they're carjacked and kidnapped by low-rent crooks Dennis Farrell (Shea Whigham) and Lacey Belisle (Rachel Krebs), who take the victims and their SUV to a nearby gas station. Along the way, they encounter an increasingly terrifying horde of parasites, and if any of them intend to survive, they'll have to outsmart the deadly organisms.

titles.title: Stage Fright
titles.description: A rehearsal for a play based on a real serial killer turns chaotic when the escaped felon comes for the curtain call.

titles.title: Stalked by a Reality Star
titles.description: Kendra is thrilled to meet Brad, a handsome TV star, at a party. When she discovers that Brad is not as charming as he seems, Kendra rejects him, only to realize that he has become obsessed with her and will stop at nothing to be near her.

titles.title: Stan Against Evil
titles.description: John C. McGinley ("Scrubs") stars in this comedy-horror series as sour, judgmental sheriff Stan Miller, who is forced to give up his job because of an angry outburst at a most inopportune moment -- his wife's funeral. Relinquishing authority doesn't come easily for Stan, especially after he finds out he must make way for Evie Barret, the strong-willed and beautiful new sheriff. However, when both soon realize something is not quite right in their sleepy New Hampshire town -- which just so happens to be built on the site of a massive 17th-century witch burning -- Stan and Evie form an unlikely alliance to bravely battle a plague of spine-chilling demons.

episodes.title: Dig Me Up, Dig Me Down
episodes.description: After the death of his wife, Sheriff Miller is forced into retirement and replaced by Evie Barret, who discovers the town is possessed by demons, and that Stan's wife was the only one keeping them at bay; Stan and Evie must join forces to stay alive.

episodes.title: Know, Know, Know Your Goat
episodes.description: Stan's daughter, Denise, goes blueberry picking and comes home with a pet goat, which also just happens to be a demon.

episodes.title: Let Your Love Groan
episodes.description: Stan, Evie and Denise go speed dating and suddenly find themselves involved with their perfect match; they also find themselves growing weak and rapidly aging.

episodes.title: Life Orr Death
episodes.description: Evie attempts to rescue Stan's prized possession, his Bobby Orr hockey stick, from the church donation pile, only to find herself transported into the spirit world where she too, is on trial for witchcraft.

episodes.title: Ouija Bored
episodes.description: A strange crop of flowers starts growing in town, with each bloom bringing a new supernatural horror; Evie attempts to summon Stan's dead wife, Claire, to help her stop them.

episodes.title: I'm Gleaning My Coven
episodes.description: Denise gets mixed up with a group of goth kids who come to town hoping to contact a demon; the goth kids succeed in contacting a demon and Denise finds herself possessed by it, creating a tricky situation for Stan.

episodes.title: Spider Walk With Me
episodes.description: A mysterious stranger shows up at Stan's door with knowledge of the curse he and Evie are fighting; Willard's Mill residents start getting killed by a giant spider.

episodes.title: Level Boss
episodes.description: A mysterious girl runs out into the street, forcing Evie to swerve into a fatal car accident that she must relive over and over and over again.

episodes.title: Black Hat Society Part 1
episodes.description: Stan begins to solve the mystery of Evie's disappearance and along the way, he meets the descendants of a Wiccan coven known as the Black Hat Society; Stan and the coven discover a disturbing way to bring Evie home.

episodes.title: Black Hat Society Part 2
episodes.description: Stan travels back in time to save Evie, not a moment too soon, as she's in a high stakes situation; Evie's rescue hinges on whether Stan can sacrifice a trusted friend in the modern day.

episodes.title: Curse of the Werepony
episodes.description: Evie's ex-husband, Kenny, visits with a new pony and the same old tricks; Stan befriends Kenny until he discovers his unsightly qualities; a mysterious stranger visits Willard's Mill.

episodes.title: Girls' Night
episodes.description: Stan gets trapped in a life-or-death bar bet; Evie and Denise watch a dating show finale that may or may not be hypnotizing them into killing each other.

episodes.title: The Eyes of Evie Barret
episodes.description: Evie buys an antique ring and then starts dreaming of killing people, who turn up dead; Leon kills a dude who may or may not have already been dead.

episodes.title: Hex Marks the Tot
episodes.description: Denise takes a nanny job for a demon baby who feeds off her affection; Kevin gets beaten up by a baby, which is not a coincidence.

episodes.title: Mirror Mirror
episodes.description: Stan summons a spirit to help him travel back in time to save Claire, and in the process, an evil replica is created who thinks only of murder; real Stan must commit an unthinkable crime to complete his time travel mission.

episodes.title: A Hard Day's Night
episodes.description: Stan travels back in time to save Claire, and he succeeds, but dies in the process, forcing Evie to go back and save him; Leon loses his head over a new gal.

episodes.title: Hell Is What You Make It
episodes.description: Evie is arrested for murder and committed to a psychiatric hospital; Stan attempts to rescue her, but everyone thinks he's a demon; there may be a new way to free the souls cursed by Constable Eccles.

episodes.title: The Hex Files
episodes.description: Two eerily familiar paranormal investigators arrive to investigate the Black Hat Society; Stan searches for a bigger evil ally that could help defeat Constable Eccles.

episodes.title: Larva My Life
episodes.description: A disgraced birthday entertainer disrupts the peace in Willard's Mill; Evie's ex-husband, Kenny, comes to town; he transforms into a caterpillar monster and terrorizes Willard's Mill.

episodes.title: The Demon Who Came in From the Heat
episodes.description: A murderous hitchhiker terrorizes Willard's Mill; Stan befriends a laid back demon and attempts to find a spell that will free the souls captured by Constable Eccles; Denise and Kevin go on a date.

episodes.title: Nubbin but Trouble
episodes.description: An antique store owner is murdered by an evil puppet that begins summoning spirits from hell; Stan brews homemade beer with a debilitating side effect.

episodes.title: Vampire Creek
episodes.description: Denise believes she's won a contest, but instead gets trapped in the fictional world of Vampire Creek, a TV show about teenage vampires; Stan, Evie and Kevin must find and rescue her before she is turned into a vampire.

episodes.title: Intensive Scare Unit
episodes.description: Stan goes for a prostate exam but must escape when the hospital turns demonic.

episodes.title: Stan Against Evie
episodes.description: Haurus demands Stan kill Evie in return for killing Constable Eccles and ending the curse on Willard's Mill; another demon tells Stan how to defeat Haurus, but the cost could be high.

titles.title: Standby
titles.description: Former lovers (Jessica Paré, Brian Gleeson) reunite after a bad breakup and gradually realize that they're more compatible than ever before.

titles.title: Step
titles.description: The senior year of a girls' high school step team in inner-city Baltimore is documented, as they try to become the first in their families to attend college. The girls strive to make their dancing a success against the backdrop of social unrest.

titles.title: Stepfather II
titles.description: After cheating death by surviving being both stabbed and shot, psychotic killer Jerry (Terry O'Quinn) is placed in a mental institution, but he soon murders his doctor and escapes. Taking on a dead man's identity, he moves to an upscale neighborhood in Los Angeles and sets his sights on local woman Carol (Meg Foster), slowly winning her heart. Carol's son, Todd (Jonathan Brandis), grows suspicious of his mom's new lover, however, and tensions reach the boiling point at the couple's wedding.

titles.title: Steps
titles.description: The victim of a life-altering robbery and shooting survives, but years later, he must work as a home health aide for his shooter, who is now paralyzed from a shooting.

titles.title: Storage Wars: Miami
titles.description: Bidding for more ratings, "Storage Wars" producers continue to expand the franchise beyond its 2010 flagship show in California. Following stops in Texas and New York, the series introduces a cast of Magic City buyers hoping to find treasures hidden within storage lockers. Local auctioneers Bob Nichols and Jerry Mahaffey officiate the "wars" that break out among longtime buyer Kevin Pew, fiery Cuban couple Jorge Gomez and Maydel Garcia, married duo Greg and Lindsey Atz, and cousins Yorgen Ugalde and Christian Fernandez.

episodes.title: Bienvenido a Miami!
episodes.description: The buyers check out lockers in Hialeah and Miramar, Fla.; Kevin steals a room from Jorge using an old auction trick; Jorge and Maydel's discovery may leave them high and dry.

episodes.title: Miami Wow Machine
episodes.description: The buyers head to Pembroke Pines, Fla., for a Jerry Mahaffey auction; Greg and Lindsey are ready to drink after scoring a room; an old map could bring big dollars for Jorge and Maydel.

episodes.title: Big Booty Foes
episodes.description: The buyers visit Lantana, Fla.; Jorge and Maydel uncover a piece of music history; Greg and Lindsey have a misunderstanding; Yorgen and Christian find a medical device.

episodes.title: Don't Hate the Gator, Hate the Gate
episodes.description: The buyers invade Hialeah, Fla.; Greg and Lindsey uncover a shiny treasure trove; Jorge and Maydel visit a sugary wonderland; Kevin attempts to break the other bidders.

episodes.title: Deuces Wild
episodes.description: The buyers return to Miramar, Fla.; Kevin lands a locker with bite; Greg and Lindsey take an interest in appliances; Christian's gamble leads to Yorgen's fall.

episodes.title: To Hell and Backpack
episodes.description: The buyers visit Florida City, Fla.; Maydel spots something from her past; Kevin looks for a big locker with big money; Greg and Lindsey go cuckoo over their unit; Yorgen and Christian gamble on a backpack.

episodes.title: Interview With the Vampirologist
episodes.description: Keven imposes a neighborhood tax when the buyers visit Cooper City, Fla.; Jorge and Maydel score big on a first date; Yorgen and Christian find a fancy pair of scissors.

episodes.title: O Brother, Where Art My Money?
episodes.description: Jorge arrives in Hialeah, Fla., with a manly attitude; Yorgen and Christian discover old dominoes; Lindsey keeps a hold on Greg's money; Kevin uncovers car parts.

episodes.title: There's No Place Like Foam
episodes.description: The buyers spend big in Miramar, Fla.; Yorgen and Christian devise a small plan; Jorge discovers an upscale treat for Maydel; Kevin unearths an old helmet.

episodes.title: Fit Lauderdale
episodes.description: The buyers visit Fort Lauderdale, Fla.; a strange suit intrigues Yorgen and Christian; Greg and Lindsey come up with a unique way to remove the pounds; Jorge and Maydel try to stay awake; Kevin doubles down.

titles.title: Street Trash
titles.description: A case of contaminated alcohol has a debilitating effect on the vagabonds haunting the streets and junkyards of Brooklyn.

titles.title: Sugarcane
titles.description: The race against a sadistic serial killer is on as a trafficking survivor relentlessly works to track down a teenage girl whose fate becomes increasingly grim with each passing hour since her abduction.

titles.title: Sunset on the River Styx
titles.description: A chance meeting of two morose lovers sends them spiraling down a surreal rabbit hole. Their relationship will be challenged by their pasts, their futures, their perception of time, and a vampire death cult.

titles.title: Sunset Song
titles.description: With World War I brewing and her family scattered across the countryside, a Scottish farm girl struggles to find her way.

titles.title: Super
titles.description: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante.

titles.title: Surfwise
titles.description: Forsaking a traditional home life, Dorian "Doc" Paskowitz and his wife raise their large brood in a 24-foot camper and spend their time surfing.

titles.title: Surviving Compton: Dre, Suge & Michel'le
titles.description: R&B singer Michel'le lives through the turbulent days of N.W.A, being signed to Ruthless Records and becoming romantically involved with Dr. Dre and Suge Knight.

titles.title: Survivor's Remorse
titles.description: Cam Calloway is about to find out the price he'll pay for stardom, love and loyalty. A basketball star in his early 20s, Calloway's life changes after he signs a multimillion-dollar contract with a team in Atlanta. He arrives in Georgia bright-eyed and eager to begin his career, joined by cousin and confidant Reggie Vaughn, who tries to keep Cam focused and free from distractions caused by Cam's blunt-but-loyal sister M-Chuck and opportunistic mom Cassie. Feeling a responsibility to support needy family and friends, Cam wrestles with the rewards and pitfalls of sudden wealth and fame. "Survivor's Remorse" is a half-hour comedy series executive produced by Mike O'Malley ("Yes, Dear") and Tom Werner, among others.

episodes.title: In the Offing
episodes.description: Newly signed basketball star Cam Calloway is embraced by the city of Atlanta, but an entourage consisting of family members proves to be a liability.

titles.title: Suspiria
titles.description: Suzy (Jessica Harper) travels to Germany to attend ballet school. When she arrives, late on a stormy night, no one lets her in, and she sees Pat (Eva Axén), another student, fleeing from the school. When Pat reaches her apartment, she is murdered. The next day, Suzy is admitted to her new school, but has a difficult time settling in. She hears noises, and often feels ill. As more people die, Suzy uncovers the terrifying secret history of the place.

titles.title: Swamp Dogg Gets His Pool Painted
titles.description: Cult musician Swamp Dogg, alongside housemates Moogstar and Guitar Shorty, turn their home into an artistic playground. Together, they forge a unique and inspiring path as they navigate the tumultuous waves of the music industry.

titles.title: Swamp Thing
titles.description: An experimental potion mutates Dr. Alec Holland into Swamp Thing, a part-man/part-plant superhero.

episodes.title: The Un-Men Unleashed
episodes.description: Swamp Thing's roots are revealed; Anton Arcane creates the Un-Men to capture his rival.

episodes.title: To Live Forever
episodes.description: Dr. Arcane travels to the Amazonian Rainforest to investigate trees that never die and enslaves a local Indian tribe to harvest their sap, causing damage to the ecosystem; Swamp Thing liberates the Indians and uses the sap to restore the rainforest.

episodes.title: Falling Star
episodes.description: Swamp Thing teams up with Bayou Jack and Tomahawk to help NASA recover the satellite before its radioactivity causes permanent harm the ecology of the area.

episodes.title: The Legend of Lost Cavern
episodes.description: Dr. Arcane desecrates an Indian burial ground in search of Lost Cavern, home of the fabled Fountain of Youth; he unearths a tablet covered with ancient pictographs and forces Tomahawk to decode the writings.

episodes.title: Experiment in Terror
episodes.description: Swamp Thing is captured by scientists, who take him to New Orleans for government experiments; J.T. and Delbert come to his aid and help him escape.

titles.title: Sweetbitter
titles.description: A new life awaits 22-year-old Tess when she arrives friendless in New York City and lacking any specific ambitions beyond finding a job. Her charm and observational nature lead to an invitation to train at one of the city's best restaurants. She thinks it is a temporary place to wait for her life's big break, but Tess is quickly intoxicated by the people she meets and by the chaotic world behind the scenes -- tasting expensive wine, exploring dive bars, learning whom to trust. Her co-workers become her family, and through them she finds a sense of belonging that she has never encountered before.

episodes.title: Salt
episodes.description: Tess, a 22-year-old, moves to New York City without friends or a specific ambition; after an interview at one of the best restaurants, she's invited to train there; Tess attempts to keep up while observing her new co-workers.

titles.title: Sweetpea
titles.description: Rhiannon Lewis doesn't make much of an impression - people walk past her in the street without a second glance; that is until she is pushed over the edge and loses control; Rhiannon's life transforms.

episodes.title: Sorry for Your Loss
episodes.description: When her father dies, and her school bully returns to town, a quiet wallflower is triggered to a violent breaking point.

titles.title: Taken in Broad Daylight
titles.description: Teenager Anne Sluti is kidnapped by a madman, and by manipulating her captor, she manages to negotiate her safe release after six days.

titles.title: Terror Train
titles.description: During a hazing, a fraternity of pre-med students has a particularly sinister prank in store for one their more timid pledges (Derek MacKinnon). With the help of a coed, Alana Maxwell (Jamie Lee Curtis), they pull off the prank so well that the pledge needs to be institutionalized as a result. After several years pass and people forget the incident, those involved with the prank are ready to celebrate their graduation by having a costume party on a train, but they haven't escaped their past yet.

titles.title: Terry McMillan Presents: Paradise With You
titles.description: An NFL superstar on the brink of retirement begins a passionate romance with an interior decorator on a Caribbean island. However, things soon turn complicated when they discover they're competing for the same coveted estate.

titles.title: The 19th Wife
titles.description: BeckyLyn (Patricia Wettig), a member of a fundamentalist cult, is accused of killing her husband. Queenie (Chyler Leigh), another wife in the sect, thinks she is innocent, and asks her excommunicated son to help solve the case.

titles.title: The 39 Steps
titles.description: While on vacation in London, Canadian Richard Hannay becomes embroiled in an international spy ring related to the mysterious "39 steps." Then he meets agent Annabella Smith, who is soon killed in his apartment. He must elude the police, who are hunting him for murder, while he tries to stop Professor Jordan from sending secrets out of the country. Hannay is assisted by Pamela, an unwilling accomplice who discovers the truth.

titles.title: The 50 Worst Movies Ever Made
titles.description: A look at some of the truly terrible moments in film history. This documentary consists of clips from what many believe to be some of the worst movies ever to make it - or not make it - into theaters.

titles.title: The 6000 Lb Diaries With Dr. Now
titles.description: Following ten morbidly obese individuals who collectively have a combined weight of 6,000 pounds and fight to transform their lives.

episodes.title: Chelsey
episodes.description: Chelsey has battled weight her whole life, avoiding Dr. Now's program since age 9; now 25, she's ready to leave her unhealthy home and see the world; but first, she must prove she's ready to commit to the steps that will transform her future.

episodes.title: Destinee & Dynastiee -- Part 1
episodes.description: As identical twins, Destinee and Dynastiee have always done everything together, including gaining weight; at over a collective 1200 lbs, they both are determined to get healthy and lose the weight with Now's help.

episodes.title: Destinee & Dynastiee -- Part 2
episodes.description: Destinee and Dynastiee continue their weight loss journey, but after only one of them qualifies for surgery, the thought of moving ahead without the other is too much; they decide to do it together or not at all, knowing if one fails they both fail.

episodes.title: Grace
episodes.description: Grace has always found comfort in food; at over 600 lbs, she decides to join Dr. Now's program; that leads to the hardest decision of her life: to change her relationship with her sisters or lose the closest people in her life to get healthy.

episodes.title: Trista
episodes.description: After losing her son and her marriage, Trista turned to food, reaching over 600 lbs.; ready to heal, she seeks Dr. Now's help.

episodes.title: Caleb
episodes.description: After the deaths in his family, Caleb's struggle with his weight has gotten even worse; at only 20, he's already hit the 800lb mark; Caleb knows his health is reaching a breaking point unless he can get Dr. Now's help before it's too late.

episodes.title: Crystal
episodes.description: After Crystal's weight spiraled out of control, she became bedridden; she has to depend on her father and best friend to take care of her and her teenage daughter; she hopes to get Dr. Now's help, but traveling to him may not be possible for her.

episodes.title: Sam
episodes.description: Sam's dream is to do more with his wife and son, with his weight fast approaching 700 lbs, his body keeps him from doing that; determined to change, he tries to join Dr Now's program to get weight loss surgery before he loses any more time with them.

episodes.title: Lauren
episodes.description: Confined to her apartment for three years, Lauren's near-death experience inspires her to lose weight; Dr. Now is her last hope, but she must overcome his program's challenges to reclaim her life and reconnect with the dreams she thought were lost.

episodes.title: Nefi
episodes.description: At 25 and 626 lbs, Nefi has been a momma's boy his whole life; when he goes to Dr. Now for help, addressing their dynamic becomes the focus; will both of them be able to change their relationship for Nefi to succeed or will old habits win in the end?

titles.title: The Advent Calendar
titles.description: An ex-dancer is given a mysterious advent calendar.

titles.title: The Adventurer: The Curse of the Midas Box
titles.description: After his parents and brother are kidnapped, a Victorian-era British teen learns about an artifact that can turn anything into gold.

titles.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
titles.description: A television adaptation of some of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's popular stories.

episodes.title: The Case of Lady Beryl
episodes.description: A woman confesses to a murder she didn't commit.

episodes.title: The Case of Blind Man's Bluff
episodes.description: A chicken claw tied with black ribbon is left behind at the scene of several murders.

episodes.title: The Case of Harry Crocker
episodes.description: Holmes sets out to prove that a famous escape artist is not a murderer.

episodes.title: The Case of the Split Ticket
episodes.description: Holmes and Watson find Brian O'Casey waiting for them at their flat.

episodes.title: The Case of the Greystone Inscription
episodes.description: Miss Channing seeks Holmes' help after her fiancé disappears at Greystone Castle.

episodes.title: The Case of the Laughing Mummy
episodes.description: Holmes and Watson investigate a mummy that makes strange noises.

episodes.title: The Case of the Deadly Prophecy
episodes.description: People begin dying after a schoolboy writes their names on the church steps.

episodes.title: The Case of the Christmas Pudding
episodes.description: A prisoner escapes shortly after he receives Christmas pudding.

episodes.title: The Case of the Night Train Riddle
episodes.description: Holmes investigates a kidnapping after a circus clown helps a boy escape from a moving train.

episodes.title: The Case of the Baker Street Nursemaids
episodes.description: A delivery boy leaves Holmes with a baby and a mysterious note.

episodes.title: The Case of the Impostor Mystery
episodes.description: Holmes tries to catch an impostor.

episodes.title: The Case of the Exhumed Client
episodes.description: Holmes believes Sir Charles is murdered by one of his heirs.

episodes.title: The Case of the Baker Street Bachelors
episodes.description: Holmes is jailed after visiting the Cupid's Bow Marriage Bureau.

episodes.title: The Case of the Neurotic Detective
episodes.description: Dr. Watson is suspicious of Holmes.

episodes.title: The Case of the Unlucky Gambler
episodes.description: A boy wants to find his missing father.

titles.title: The Adventures of the Wilderness Family
titles.description: Skip Robinson (Robert F. Logan) leads his wife, Pat (Susan Damante Shaw) ; son, Toby (Ham Larsen) ; and daughter, Jenny (Hollye Holmes) on an exodus from the concrete jungle of Los Angeles. At the site of their new home in the majestic Rocky Mountains, Skip builds a log cabin, and the children befriend wild animals. As the intrepid Robinsons make a simpler life for themselves off the grid, they discover that, in the wilderness, each day brings its own adventure.

titles.title: The Arrival
titles.description: After astronomer Zane Zaminsky discovers a radio transmission that originated from space, he tells his boss, Phil, who ignores him. Zane is promptly fired, and decides to investigate the signal himself. When he discovers a return radio transmission from Mexico, he goes to explore. There he meets climate scientist Ilana Green, who is studying anomalies in gases in the area. Zane soon makes a finding that puts him in great danger.

titles.title: The Artist
titles.description: In the 1920s, actor George Valentin (Jean Dujardin) is a bona fide matinée idol with many adoring fans. While working on his latest film, George finds himself falling in love with an ingénue named Peppy Miller (Bérénice Bejo) and, what's more, it seems Peppy feels the same way. But George is reluctant to cheat on his wife with the beautiful young actress. The growing popularity of sound in movies further separates the potential lovers, as George's career begins to fade while Peppy's star rises.

titles.title: The Babadook
titles.description: A troubled widow (Essie Davis) discovers that her son is telling the truth about a monster that entered their home through the pages of a children's book.

titles.title: The Beach House
titles.description: College sweethearts on a romantic getaway struggle for survival when unexpected guests exhibit signs of a mysterious infection.

titles.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
titles.description: This series follows the Clampett family from the Ozarks to posh Beverly Hills after they strike oil and become millionaires. Banker Mr. Drysdale tries to keep them from foolishly spending their newfound wealth, and he also tries to "civilize" them -- usually succeeding in making a fool of himself in the process.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Strike Oil
episodes.description: A rural family reluctantly exchanges a one-room mountain cabin for $25 million and a 35-room mansion, after they strike oil on their land.

episodes.title: Getting Settled
episodes.description: Jed and his family are mistaken for a staff of crazy servants when they move into their new mansion.

episodes.title: Meanwhile, Back at the Cabin
episodes.description: The Clampett family miss being back at their old home in the mountains; Pearl tries to win over the oil man at the cabin as he takes her to a nearby phone.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Meet Mrs. Drysdale
episodes.description: When Mr. Drysdale describes Mrs. Drysdale as being a hypochondriac, the Clampetts assume she is a drunk.

episodes.title: Jed Buys Stock
episodes.description: Jed takes Drysdale's suggestion about buying good stock to heart and quickly purchases cows, pigs and chickens.

episodes.title: Trick or Treat
episodes.description: The homesick Clampetts, unaware that it's Halloween, decide to go calling on their Beverly Hills neighbors.

episodes.title: The Servants
episodes.description: Drysdale attempts another step in the social renovation of the Clampetts by lending them his servants.

episodes.title: Jethro Goes to School
episodes.description: A private school teacher is shocked to learn that her new fifth-grade student is Jethro.

episodes.title: Elly's First Date
episodes.description: Elly May's first date in Beverly Hills ends in a riot of confusion before it even starts.

episodes.title: Pygmalion and Elly
episodes.description: Sonny tries to court Elly May, as he determines that she needs to change from a hillbilly into an upper-class lady; Granny offers the use of her love charms to spice up their affair.

episodes.title: Elly Races Jethrine
episodes.description: The Clampetts try to get Sonny to propose to Elly before Cousin Pearl can get her daughter Jethrine married to him.

episodes.title: The Great Feud
episodes.description: The Clampetts load their shootin' irons for a match with the Drysdales when Sonny jilts and infuriates Elly May.

episodes.title: Home for Christmas
episodes.description: When Granny, Uncle Jed, Elly May and Jethro decide to return to the country for the holidays, they discover airline travel.

episodes.title: No Place Like Home
episodes.description: The Clampetts, home for Christmas, help Cousin Pearl woo Mr. Brewster, the big oil company executive.

episodes.title: Jed Rescues Pearl
episodes.description: Pearl's attempts to snag Mr. Brewster seem hopeless until he suddenly makes an outrageous public proposal.

episodes.title: Back to Californy
episodes.description: Jed is confronted with too many cooks and not enough vittles when he invites Pearl and Jethrine to Beverly Hills.

episodes.title: Jed's Dilemma
episodes.description: Trying to cool a feud between Granny and Pearl, Jed takes his family on a sightseeing tour of Beverly Hills.

episodes.title: Jed Saves Drysdale's Marriage
episodes.description: Drysdale's marriage is threatened when he looks to the Clampetts for a housekeeper while his wife is away.

episodes.title: Elly's Animals
episodes.description: Police and Elly's animals converge on the Clampett estate when Pearl starts giving yodeling lessons.

episodes.title: Jed Throws a Wingding
episodes.description: Two of Cousin Pearl's most ardent former suitors come to visit her in Beverly Hills; Jed doesn't know what to suggest.

episodes.title: Jed Plays Solomon
episodes.description: Granny's plan to stop Pearl's yodeling backfires when the police she called find her illegal still.

episodes.title: Duke Steals a Wife
episodes.description: Jed's bloodhound Duke takes on the role of matchmaker for his master and a glamorous woman from France.

episodes.title: Jed Buys the Freeway
episodes.description: A confidence man tries to sell Jed the Hollywood Bowl, Griffith Park and the Hollywood Freeway.

episodes.title: Jed Becomes a Banker
episodes.description: Jed is promoted to the position of bank vice president in order for him to participate in an interbank skeet shoot.

episodes.title: The Family Tree
episodes.description: An authority on American history finds evidence that Jed's ancestors preceded the Mayflower to America.

episodes.title: Jed Cuts the Family Tree
episodes.description: Cousin Pearl gets a glamour treatment and tries to groom the Clampetts for high society.

episodes.title: Granny's Spring Tonic
episodes.description: Jed takes a dose of Granny's tonic and ends up on Lovers Lane with a gold-digging secretary.

episodes.title: Jed Pays His Income Tax
episodes.description: Grannie manages to chase away an IRS agent with a shotgun, prompting a story from Mr. Drysdale about how the family came to live in Beverly Hills in the first place.

episodes.title: The Clampetts and the Dodgers
episodes.description: Los Angeles Dodgers coach Leo Durocher finds a new pitcher in Jethro.

episodes.title: Duke Becomes a Father
episodes.description: Love blooms again for Jed when Mlle. Denise returns from Paris to herald the arrival of a litter of poodles.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Entertain
episodes.description: The board chairman of Drysdale's bank is determined to meet Jed Clampett, the bank's financial wizard.

episodes.title: The Clampetts in Court
episodes.description: Jed acts as his own attorney when he's sued by a couple seeking $100,000 in damages for a fictitious auto accident.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Get Psychoanalyzed
episodes.description: The Clampetts take Jethro to Mrs. Drysdale's psychiatrist for an assessment so that he can pass the fifth grade; when Pearl accompanies him, she is worried about being asked to lie on the couch.

episodes.title: The Psychiatrist Gets Clampetted
episodes.description: Jethro is finally told that he can finish the fifth grade by Doctor Twombly, but the doctor still wants to see Grannie; her love potion for Pearl misfires, leaving Twombly confused.

episodes.title: Elly Becomes a Secretary
episodes.description: Jed takes over Drysdale's job for one afternoon and wins him the Banker of the Year title; Drysdale accidentally uses the wrong speech for his conference, and a new teller makes an impact.

episodes.title: Jethro's Friend
episodes.description: One of Jethro's school friends spends a day at the Clampett mansion, and the hillbillies show the over-protected boy how to have fun.

episodes.title: Jed Gets the Misery
episodes.description: To humor Granny, Jed fakes illness so that she can resume the doctoring that brought her fame in the hills.

episodes.title: Hair Raising Holiday
episodes.description: Granny defies medical opposition to her own brand of mountain medicine.

episodes.title: Granny's Garden
episodes.description: Granny's neighbors try to stop her when she attempts to create a vegetable garden in the front yard of the mansion grounds.

episodes.title: Elly Starts to School
episodes.description: Elly sparks a new trend in understated fashion when she enrolls in a finishing school.

episodes.title: The Clampett Look
episodes.description: The Clampetts are taken for the new avant-garde social leaders.

episodes.title: Jethro's First Love
episodes.description: Jethro shares a heart-to-heart conversation with Jed, and goes on to find himself a girlfriend in record time.

episodes.title: Chickadee Returns
episodes.description: Love-struck Jethro decides he wants to marry Chickadee Laverne, a brassy burlesque dancer he brings home.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Are Overdrawn
episodes.description: Jed is shocked when he receives news that his multimillion-dollar bank account has been overdrawn by $34 million.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Go Hollywood
episodes.description: The Clampetts, under the noxious influence of J.D. Clampett, impostor and unemployed actor, go to Hollywood.

episodes.title: Turkey Day
episodes.description: Plans for a holiday feast at the Clampett mansion go awry when Elly makes a pet of the Thanksgiving turkey.

episodes.title: The Garden Party
episodes.description: Mrs. Drysdale, giving a lavish garden party, finds to her horror that she is losing her guests to the Clampetts.

episodes.title: Elly Needs a Maw
episodes.description: Jed decides that his tomboy daughter Elly, who has taken up motorcycle riding, needs a mother to make her a lady.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Get Culture
episodes.description: The Clampetts try to participate in some of the more civilized pleasures of Beverly Hills.

episodes.title: Christmas at the Clampetts'
episodes.description: The Clampett family is somewhat befuddled when they receive lavish Christmas presents that all seem to come from Mr Drysdale.

episodes.title: A Man for Elly
episodes.description: Quirt Manly, celebrated star of television Westerns, is invited to the Clampett mansion to try to tame Elly May.

episodes.title: The Giant Jackrabbit
episodes.description: An Australian banker sends Drysdale a kangaroo as a joke, and Granny thinks she has discovered a giant jackrabbit.

episodes.title: The Girl From Home
episodes.description: A beauty-contest winner from the hills and her father come to visit Jethro with marriage on their minds.

episodes.title: Lafe Lingers On
episodes.description: Backwoods freeloader Lafe Crick lingers on at the Clampett mansion as an unwanted guest in search of an easy fortune.

episodes.title: The Race for Queen
episodes.description: Elly May decides to enter a beauty competition to become the queen of Beverly Hills, with some help from Miss Jane and the Drysdales; when Granny hears about the race, she wants to enter as well.

titles.title: The Birthday Boys
titles.description: Executive produced by Bob Odenkirk ("Breaking Bad") and Ben Stiller, "The Birthday Boys" is a scripted original sketch show starring the Los Angeles comedy group of the same name. The Birthday Boys are Jefferson Dutton, Dave Ferguson, Mike Hanford, Tim Kalpakis, Matt Kowalick, Mike Mitchell and Chris VanArtsdalen, whose collective credits include "Parks and Recreation," "The Office," "Portlandia," "Funny or Die," "Comedy Bang! Bang!" and "Conan." Episodes combine a mix of stand-alone and multiact sketches that twist real-life situations and cultural touchstones, taking a page from absurd yet intelligent classic sketch shows "Monty Python," "Kids in the Hall" and Odenkirk's "Mr. Show With Bob and David."

episodes.title: Paychecks!
episodes.description: An alternate story of the inventors of the personal computer who were a group of nerds consumed with their garage hangouts; an introduction to Car-y, a magical automobile that travels to the Land of Pretend.

episodes.title: Goofy Roofers
episodes.description: The ups and downs of a group of residential roofers whose antics got them an American sitcom; a moronic rap-rocker who sings about America's problems-only to discover he can't find any; Laraine Newman; French Stewart.

episodes.title: Catching up on Shows
episodes.description: Tim gets confused trying to keep up with the complicated story lines of TV shows including a variety show; teens dare each other to inspect an old hermit's cabin, but are horrified when they look at the old man's website.

episodes.title: Rock and Roll
episodes.description: Interviews with the modern giants of Rock, Rap, and Dubstep about the foundation of all modern popular music; one of the wildest bachelor parties of all time; Ben Stiller.

episodes.title: Cool Machine
episodes.description: The development of a scientific contraption that promises to turn the guys into cool versions of themselves; a sneak peek into the underground world of Amish juicing.

episodes.title: Helpful Tips
episodes.description: The seven Pinkus brothers, owners and founders of The 7 Brothers' Brewery. Their love of beer-making includes backstroking through their vats of beer; the shady world of pool hustlers.

episodes.title: Skewered!
episodes.description: A man who discovered flight before the Wright Brothers-only to be mocked because his flying machine looked funny and got lost in the mix of goofier inventions; The Birthday Boys review today's hot-button topics.

episodes.title: All Your Favorites Are Back
episodes.description: The Birthday Boys are booked on a comedy event proclaiming that All Your Favorites Are Back! The line-up goes on and on and on; a restaurant owner who puts more care into advertising the price of the food than the meal itself.

episodes.title: Going All the Way
episodes.description: The Birthday Boys revisit their high school days with a pact to each lose their virginity before they graduate that they made on graduation day; a student brings his Dad to the prom; a pseudo-intellectual evaluates the Contemporary Family.

episodes.title: Dumb Public
episodes.description: A visit with Glanard Frugner, the worst animator of all time, including an introduction to some of his less-than-legendary creations; an evaluation of how smart the public is.

episodes.title: Snobs and Slobs
episodes.description: A fashion designer, a man raised in nature and a struggling indie rock band may seem like they have nothing in common, but they're all trying to find where they belong in the world.

episodes.title: Wet Dreams May Come
episodes.description: A Polish immigrant father does what he can to care for his seven DJ sons; in their attempt to kill Adolf Hitler, two time-travelers hit a speed bump.

episodes.title: Women Are Funny
episodes.description: The debate is over with definitive proof that women are funny; the cost of such proof may or may not have been worth it.

episodes.title: Freshy's
episodes.description: Jack Black is the jaded star of a movie franchise reboot; the guys fall for a fast food chain's social marketing campaign.

episodes.title: Love Date Hump
episodes.description: Romance seen through a group of swinging guys; a married couple that hasn't been out in a long time.

episodes.title: Getting Preachy
episodes.description: A rowdy seminary school; a man possessed by El Diablo; a preacher's crusade against preaching.

episodes.title: Plight of the Working Class
episodes.description: Unemployment and the economy; a doomed lumber mill.

episodes.title: The U.S. Healthcare System
episodes.description: Taking on the U.S. healthcare system; the importance of rectal and colon health.

episodes.title: Cerf's Folly
episodes.description: A declaration that the World Wide Web is a failure; losing sleep over online opinions; soldiers capitalize on their viral potential; how people got attention before the Internet.

titles.title: The Brain
titles.description: A teen (Tom Breznahan) and his girlfriend (Cyndy Preston) find a monster brain at a TV psychologist's (David Gale) thought-control institute.

titles.title: The Bride With White Hair
titles.description: Zhuo (Leslie Cheung), a master swordsman, is in charge of an army chosen to protect China from an evil cult. During a battle with the enemy, Zhuo falls in love with Lian (Brigitte Lin), a young woman who was raised by wolves and then adopted by the Siamese twins who lead the cult. The two seek a life of peace and quiet, but when Zhuo's colleagues are mysteriously slaughtered, survivors believe Lian is the culprit. Zhuo finds himself forced to turn against his beloved.

titles.title: The Carpenter's Son
titles.description: A remote village in Egypt explodes into spiritual warfare when a carpenter, his wife and their son Jesus are targeted by supernatural forces.

titles.title: The Children
titles.description: Gas leaking from a nuclear-power plant turns children into zombies who burn those they touch.

titles.title: The Chrisleys: Back to Reality
titles.description: "The Chrisleys: Back to Reality" begins during the wake of the family's controversy and upheaval with Todd and Julie in federal prison and follows the family as their parents are eventually pardoned, released from prison and return home. The series shows a side of the Chrisleys that has never been seen before with exclusive access to the family--Julie and Todd from prison and upon their release, Savannah, Chase, Grayson, Chloe, Nanny Faye, and for the first time, Julie's parents Harvey and Pam.

episodes.title: Savannah Knows Best?
episodes.description: With former reality TV stars Todd and Julie Chrisley in prison, daughter Savannah fights to secure a pardon for them while balancing work, guardianship of her younger brother and sister, and navigating fractured relationships with family.

episodes.title: O Brother Where Art Thou
episodes.description: Grayson's attempt to talk some sense into Chase backfires horribly, while Nanny Faye struggles to accept Chase's girlfriend Jodi; the family recounts the rise of Chrisley Knows Best.

episodes.title: A Tale of Two Daughters
episodes.description: Savannah grieves a difficult breakup without the help of her parents, while the Chrisleys reveal shocking betrayals that helped put Todd and Julie behind bars.

episodes.title: Praying for Pardon
episodes.description: Chase decides to take a big step that leads to an argument with Julie, while the family implodes when Harvey crosses Savannah just as she gets news of a possible pardon for Todd and Julie.

episodes.title: Chasing Chase
episodes.description: Savannah and Grayson reel from the news that the pardon will not be going through this time, triggering painful memories; Chase finally decides to let his guard down and seek therapy; Faye attempts to get Savannah and Grayson to see the light.

episodes.title: Freedom Frenzy
episodes.description: Todd and Julie are suddenly pardoned overnight, sending the Chrisleys into a frenzy to bring them home; Chase, Faye, Pam, and Harvey are excluded from plans to bring them home, leading to increasing tensions.

episodes.title: Life After Lockup
episodes.description: Julie struggles to readjust to life back home as Pam and Harvey find themselves out in the cold; Chase is enraged when he is excluded from a family interview.

episodes.title: The Chrisley Comeback
episodes.description: Todd and Julie look at the complicated road ahead; Chase does his best to brush off hurt by his family and stand on his own two feet.

titles.title: The Church

titles.title: The Curse of Oak Island
titles.description: Oak Island is a tree-covered island on the south shore of Nova Scotia that has intrigued treasure hunters for more than 200 years. It is believed that the island is hiding one of the greatest treasures of all time, but no one has been able to find it. Enter Rick and Marty Lagina, brothers from Michigan who have bought the rights to much of the island to try to solve the mystery. The two use modern technology and good old American know-how to look for the treasure. But it won't be easy as the search is expensive and dangerous -- several people have died trying to strike it rich on Oak Island, inspiring the titular curse. The Laginas hope to avoid the curse long enough to find the treasure before they run out of money... or worse.

titles.description: Northern Ireland, 1960: Father Thomas Riley and Father John Thornton are dispatched by the Vatican to investigate reports of a miracle, a statue of the Virgin Mary weeping blood, at a remote Catholic asylum for immoral women. Armed with 16mm film cameras to record their findings, the priests instead discover a depraved horror show of sadistic nuns, satanism and demonic possession. Supernatural forces are at work here, but they are not the doing of God.

titles.title: The Dick Van Dyke Show
titles.description: Considered to be one of television's classics, "The Dick Van Dyke Show" centers on the personal and professional lives Rob Petrie, a writer on the fictional Alan Brady Show. He's happily married to former dancer Laura, and they have a young son, Ritchie. titles.title: The Divide

Working to exonerate him, she clashes with Page, who would uphold the verdict and his reputation. Faced with the question of a man's innocence but motivated by their history -- their own divide -- they struggle within the justice system.

titles.description: A washed-up screenwriter (Hugh Grant) reluctantly takes a college teaching job and meets a single mother (Marisa Tomei) who changes his life in more ways than one.
