titles.description: The Rev. Eric Roman and Brucey B pick up the pieces of Earl Roman's empire in Buffalo.

titles.title: The Room
titles.description: A couple discover a strange room in their new house that grants material wishes, but all they want is a child.

titles.title: The Roy Rogers Show
titles.description: Television cowboy Roy Rogers fights for law and order in the West.

episodes.title: Jailbreak
episodes.description: Dale helps a falsely accused man escape from jail.

episodes.title: The Treasure of Howling Dog Canyon
episodes.description: A saloon hostess threatens her stepson to gain control of the final piece of a treasure map.

episodes.title: Badman's Brother
episodes.description: Dale and Roy must convince an 11-year-old boy help catch his outlaw brother.

episodes.title: The Unwilling Outlaw
episodes.description: A bank employee (Stanford Jolley) is forced to join a gang after being framed for embezzlement.

episodes.title: Carnival Killer
episodes.description: A young carnival worker is framed for the murder of his boss.

episodes.title: Flying Bullets
episodes.description: Pat Brady is elected sheriff just in time to catch a notorious killer.

episodes.title: Death Medicine
episodes.description: Roy and Dale race the clock to find a kidnapped elderly diabetic.

episodes.title: Money to Burn
episodes.description: Dale unknowingly buys a stove containing stolen payroll money from a local peddler (Dub Taylor).

episodes.title: The Milliner From Medicine Creek
episodes.description: An attractive milliner and her grandfather are suspects in a plot to rob the Wells Fargo office.

episodes.title: The Young Defenders
episodes.description: Two children of a kidnapped fur trapper are left alone in their cabin.

episodes.title: Backfire
episodes.description: Roy and Dale question the identity of a man claiming to be a friend of the local minister.

episodes.title: Last of the Larabee Kid
episodes.description: A mysterious outlaw hijacks stolen loot from stagecoach bandits.

episodes.title: Boy's Day in Paradise Valley
episodes.description: When students become lawmen for a day, the new "sheriff's" uncle takes advantage.

episodes.title: Bad Neighbors
episodes.description: Roy and Dale are caught between feuding cattlemen and homesteaders.

episodes.title: Strangers
episodes.description: A new family in Paradise Valley mistakes outlaws for a welcoming committee.

episodes.title: Hidden Treasure
episodes.description: Outlaws misinterpret a comment made by Roy and Dale.

episodes.title: Outcasts of Paradise Valley
episodes.description: Gang of crooks locks Roy in his own jail. (1951)

episodes.title: The Big Chance
episodes.description: Pat and Nellybelle are kidnapped by a gang of outlaws.

episodes.title: Dead End Trail
episodes.description: A young man decides to escape his overbearing father by joining the Carlson gang.

episodes.title: The Brothers O'Dell
episodes.description: Brothers are at odds when an outlaw gang robs an express office.

episodes.title: Three Masked Men
episodes.description: A shooting occurs when an outlaw gang tries to kidnap the governor.

episodes.title: Ambush
episodes.description: A young miner is kidnapped when it's learned that he's stumbled upon a bonanza.

episodes.title: Johnny Rover
episodes.description: A tyrannical Boston financier travels to Mineral City to confront his son.

titles.title: The Salem Witch Trials
titles.description: Delving deep into the case surrounding the deadliest example of witch hunt hysteria in the history of colonial North America.

titles.title: The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch
titles.description: Skinwalker Ranch and the surrounding area have been referred to as "UFO alley" since the 1950s when numerous anomalous events and strange activity began occurring. A team of scientists and experts conducts a thorough and daring search of the infamous 512-acre property in Utah's Uinta Basin in an attempt to find out the answers behind more than 200 years of UFO sightings, strange animal mutations, and paranormal related mysteries. Scientists use the latest in cutting-edge technology, like ground-penetrating radar and drones, to seek shocking discoveries.

episodes.title: All Fired Up
episodes.description: After new tests reveal clues about the ceramic materials that were extracted from the Mesa, the team fires extreme heat above the Triangle, which leads to phenomena appearing in the sky.

episodes.title: Flying High
episodes.description: The team runs a new test in the Mesa that produces loud and clear evidence of buried metallic objects; a new aerial experiment yields solid clues about a giant force field in the middle of Skinwalker Ranch.

episodes.title: Setting Boundaries
episodes.description: As the team begins a large-scale drilling operation to uncover a possible metal object in the Mesa, they launch a swarm of one hundred drones that reveals a major answer about the mystery of the Bubble.

episodes.title: Smoking Guns
episodes.description: After a new test deepens the mystery of the ceramics that were found in the Mesa, the team smokes out stunning new clues at the Triangle and along the boundary of the Bubble.

episodes.title: Home Sweet Homestead
episodes.description: The team encounters a series of mind-bending phenomena when a Navajo Shaman performs a sacred ritual at Homestead Two.

episodes.title: All Mesa'd Up
episodes.description: As the mystery deepens in the Mesa, the team makes a bewildering new discovery at the center of the Bubble.

episodes.title: High Voltage
episodes.description: The team shoots bolts of electricity in the Bubble, leading to shocking new clues surrounding the Blob.

episodes.title: Rocket Men
episodes.description: While investigating a region high above the Triangle with specialized rockets, the team makes a discovery that may explain the mysterious phenomena on Skinwalker Ranch.

episodes.title: Up in Smoke
episodes.description: As the team works to smoke out answers at Homestead Two, strange things appear at an unexpected area of the ranch.

episodes.title: The Twilight Zones
episodes.description: When the team looks for possible connections between two old decaying homesteads, they are surprised by what they discover.

episodes.title: On the Radar
episodes.description: The team uses Doppler radar to study the Bubble only to discover new, unexplained phenomena hiding in plain sight.

titles.title: The Serpent Queen
titles.description: "The Serpent Queen" is a cunning account of one of the most influential women ever to wear a crown: Catherine de' Medici; considered an immigrant, common and plain, de' Medici marries into the 16th century French court as an orphanedteenager, expected to bring a fortune in dowry and produce many heirs; she quickly discovers that her husband is in love with an older woman, her dowry is unpaid, and she is unable to conceive; yet, with only her intelligence and determination, she manages to keep her marriage alive and masters the bloodsport that is the monarchy better than anyone else, ruling France for 50 years.

episodes.title: Medici Bitch
episodes.description: Queen Catherine begins to tell the story of her life to Rahima, a servant girl, revealing how she came to enter the French Royal Court at the age of 14.

titles.title: The Shining
titles.description: Jack Torrance (Jack Nicholson) becomes winter caretaker at the isolated Overlook Hotel in Colorado, hoping to cure his writer's block. He settles in along with his wife, Wendy (Shelley Duvall), and his son, Danny (Danny Lloyd), who is plagued by psychic premonitions. As Jack's writing goes nowhere and Danny's visions become more disturbing, Jack discovers the hotel's dark secrets and begins to unravel into a homicidal maniac hell-bent on terrorizing his family.

titles.title: The Slumber Party Massacre
titles.description: Someone with a power drill shows up uninvited to Trish's (Michele Michaels) high-school pajama party.

titles.title: The Sorcerer and the White Snake
titles.description: A sorcerer (Jet Li) battles against a barrage of demon temptresses to save a man's soul from an ancient serpent that was brought to life and disguised as a woman.

titles.title: The Stanford Prison Experiment
titles.description: In 1971, Stanford's Professor Philip Zimbardo (Billy Crudup) conducts a controversial psychology experiment in which college students pretend to be either prisoners or guards, but the proceedings soon get out of hand.

titles.title: The Stepfather
titles.description: Jerry Blake (Terry O'Quinn) is a family man, but he happens to have a series of families, with each one on the receiving end of his murderous ways. When Jerry sets his sights on a lovely widow named Susan (Shelley Hack) and her headstrong daughter, Stephanie (Jill Schoelen), it appears that his brutal pattern of killings will continue. However, Stephanie begins to suspect that there's something wrong with the seemingly well-adjusted Jerry, and a violent confrontation is inevitable.

titles.title: The Summit
titles.description: Filmmaker Nick Ryan uses footage, interviews and re-enactments to piece together events in August 2008 that resulted in the deaths of 11 people on Mount Everest.

titles.title: The Tenth Circle
titles.description: A family (Kelly Preston, Ron Eldard, Britt Robertson) becomes the focus of a murder investigation when the daughter's accused rapist dies suspiciously.

titles.title: The Terror
titles.description: A series of bizarre deaths haunt a Japanese American community during World War II while Chester Nakayama and his friends and family face persecution from the American government in a Japanese internment camp.
categories: Upgrade to Watch the Latest Season

episodes.title: Go for Broke
episodes.description: An accident at sea cripples a Royal Navy expedition 200 miles from finding the Northwest Passage, forcing its captains to make a dire choice.

episodes.title: Gore
episodes.description: After a long winter trapped in the ice, scouting parties are sent out in search of open water; one of the teams makes a frightening discovery.

episodes.title: The Ladder
episodes.description: With something now stalking the ships, the captains debate their options, testing their loyalty to one another against their duty to their crews.

episodes.title: Punished, as a Boy
episodes.description: A cunning attack on the ships proves the men are not battling an ordinary bear and that the region's Inuit culture may hold a key to their survival.

episodes.title: First Shot a Winner, Lads
episodes.description: A strange illness begins to show itself while another more familiar one jeopardizes the expedition's most valuable resource: its captain's judgment.

episodes.title: A Mercy
episodes.description: With the end of their provisions in sight, officers contemplate an 800-mile walkout while planning a party to raise the men's worsening spirits.

episodes.title: Horrible From Supper
episodes.description: As the men begin their long march south, shocking events underscore how vulnerable and exposed their situation has become.

episodes.title: Terror Camp Clear
episodes.description: The death of an officer under mysterious circumstances creates paranoia among the men; Capt. Crozier discovers some of the crew members may be considering mutiny.

episodes.title: The C, the C, the Open C
episodes.description: While hope comes in strange forms, the question of what the men are willing to do to survive begins to be settled in both noble and horrifying ways.

episodes.title: We Are Gone
episodes.description: The expedition's journey reaches its climax as men find themselves in a final confrontation with the Inuit mythology they've trespassed into.

episodes.title: Infamy: A Sparrow in a Swallow's Nest
episodes.description: In 1941, Chester Nakayama is caught between his insular Japanese-American neighborhood on Terminal Island and his current all-American life; extreme circumstances push his community and personal life to the brink, all while someone watches closely.

titles.title: The Three Stooges
titles.description: Starring in movies, Larry, Moe, Curly -- and sometimes Shemp -- manage to find time to get into slapstick situations and engage in plenty of comic violence. "Nyuk, nyuk, nyuk!"

episodes.title: Disorder in the Court
episodes.description: The boys are murder witnesses.

episodes.title: Brideless Groom
episodes.description: Shemp must wed to inherit.

episodes.title: Malice in the Palace
episodes.description: The boys seek a pharaoh's diamond.

titles.title: The Toxic Avenger
titles.description: A 98-pound nerd (Mark Torgl) from New Jersey lands in a vat of toxic waste and becomes a benevolent monster (Mitchell Cohen).

titles.title: The Toxic Avenger Part III: The Last Temptation of Toxie
titles.description: Tromaville's mutated superhero unwittingly becomes Satan's employee when he takes a job at a sinister megacorporation.

titles.title: The Toxic Avenger, Part II
titles.description: The Avenger (Ron Fazio, John Altamura) goes to Japan in search of his father, an underworld fishmonger called Big Mac.

titles.title: The Triangle
titles.description: A shipping magnate hires specialists to investigate the Bermuda Triangle.

episodes.title: Night 1
episodes.description: Billionaire shipping magnate Eric Benirall commissions a diverse team of experts to solve the mystery of the Bermuda Triangle.

episodes.title: Night 2
episodes.description: Benirall's team is captured and interrogated in an underwater facility; Emily and Bruce team up to investigate a strange weather phenomenon.

episodes.title: Night 3
episodes.description: The team races to prevent a catastrophic disaster while facing insurmountable odds.

titles.title: The Trip to Bountiful
titles.description: A determined woman (Cicely Tyson) escapes from the clutches of her overprotective son (Blair Underwood) to travel to her hometown.

titles.title: The Trip to Italy
titles.description: During a tour of Italy, two friends (Steve Coogan, Rob Brydon) enjoy sumptuous meals and lively conversations about such eclectic topics as Batman's vocal range.

titles.title: The Trip to Spain
titles.description: Steve and Rob sample the restaurants and hotels of the Spanish coastline, trading jokes and impressions over their lunches.

titles.title: The Ultimate Gift
titles.description: Jason Stevens (Drew Fuller) lives a life of wealth and privilege. When his grandfather (James Garner) dies, Jason expects to receive a hefty inheritance. Instead, however, Jason must set out on a journey of self-discovery to earn the true gift his grandfather meant for him to have. Along the way, Jason befriends a dying girl (Abigail Breslin) and her mother (Ali Hillis) and learns what is really important in life.

titles.title: The Unauthorized Beverly Hills, 90210 Story
titles.description: The secrets of "Beverly Hills, 90210" in its first four seasons and the drama between cast, crew and creators.

titles.title: The Unauthorized Full House Story
titles.description: Actors Bob Saget, John Stamos, Dave Coulier and the Olsen twins rise to fame while starring in the hit TV series "Full House."

titles.title: The Unauthorized Melrose Place Story
titles.description: Actors Heather Locklear (Ciara Hanna), Marcia Cross (Teagan Vincze), Daphne Zuniga (Ali Cobrin), and other young stars appear in the hit television show "Melrose Place."

titles.title: The Unauthorized Saved by the Bell Story
titles.description: Young actors Mark-Paul Gosselaar (Dylan Everett), Mario Lopez (Julian Works), Elizabeth Berkley (Tiera Skovbye), Dustin Diamond (Sam Kindseth) and others adjust to life in the spotlight while appearing on the hit TV show "Saved by the Bell."

titles.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
titles.description: Host Dan Aykroyd uncovers some of the most mysterious and bizarre inventions, creatures, people and things throughout history, by using dynamic visuals, archival images, and expert interviews.
categories: Upgrade to Watch the Latest Season

episodes.title: Odd Origins
episodes.description: Uncover the wild beginnings behind ordinary objects, legendary figures, and even the sayings we use every day; why did Abraham Lincoln once step into the wrestling ring? How do million-dollar birds procreate? What's the story behind a dog that ignited an international conflict? These are the strangest origin tales you've never heard-and won't believe!

episodes.title: Epic Fails
episodes.description: A miracle cure with a deadly catch; A romantic gesture explodes in a president's face; A simple home repair spirals wildly out of control; Sometimes the biggest disasters begin with the best intentions.

episodes.title: Peculiar Places
episodes.description: A bleeding house; a near-boiling river; a desert of unexplained encounters; these are peculiar places on Earth.

episodes.title: Incredible Spectacles
episodes.description: From donkey baseball and octopus wrestling to a scientist who swallows uranium, these are the jaw-dropping spectacles that left crowds in awe.

episodes.title: Astonishing Beings
episodes.description: The world is full of creatures who make you look twice; from a baboon who becomes a reliable employee at a 19th-century train station, to a Moulin Rouge performer who builds a career on controlled flatulence, to a military combat unit of undeniably adorable pooches; these are the stories of beings so strange, so spectacular, they're unbelievable.

episodes.title: Super Secret Weapons
episodes.description: Bombs full of scorpions, exploding dummy paratroopers and spy kits hidden where the sun don't shine, these super-secret weapons are as bizarre as they are deadly.

episodes.title: Wild Encounters
episodes.description: From a mysterious meat storm to exploding toads and a deadly trap hiding in plain sight, these are the unbelievable moments when mother nature takes a wildly unexpected turn.

titles.title: The Undefeated
titles.description: Unaware that the Civil War has ended, Col. John Henry Thomas (John Wayne) successfully attacks a Confederate company led by James Langdon (Rock Hudson). With the remnants of Langdon's squadron fleeing to Mexico, Thomas and his adopted Native American son, Blue Boy (Roman Gabriel), gather a herd of horses and head for the border with their company, to sell them. After Langdon's caravan is captured by a Mexican general (Tony Aguilar), Thomas nobly sacrifices the horses to free them.

titles.title: The Unknowable: Darkland
titles.description: Exploring the complex characters and supernatural forces behind the Darkland Amusement Park where the mysterious disappearance of a local teen, Tammy, reignites the obsession of private investigator Atticus Fairbanks.

episodes.title: Lost & Found
episodes.description: In Oklahoma, 1978, Tammy and her friends break into the abandoned Darkland Amusement Park, but by morning, most of the teens are dead and Tammy is mysteriously missing; this draws the attention of private investigator Atticus Fairbanks.

episodes.title: Visions
episodes.description: 1940s California: Failed actor Dexter Venito works at a carnival freak show ruled by the sadistic Vladislav; Dexter's romance with the show's star attraction inspires the pair to flee for a better life.

episodes.title: Jackpot
episodes.description: Detective Fairbanks and Elsa are reeling from the discovery of Theodosia Birchwood still alive after having been missing for 25 years; desperate to break through to the catatonic woman, Fairbanks recalls the foggy details of her case.

episodes.title: Ink & Paint
episodes.description: In the 1950s Oklahoma, FBI Agents Reed and Milner are tasked with infiltrating a cult run by Dexter Venito; as Milner embraces the cult, Reed grows closer with Dexter's wife, Theodosia, and he becomes alarmed at the cult's aims.

episodes.title: Blue prints
episodes.description: 1978 Oklahoma: Fairbanks, Elsa and Theodosia confront Braxton Chamberland, the architect of the Darkland Amusement Park; Braxton shines a light on the cult's rise, Dexter's abusive behavior toward Theodosia and what led to the park's shuttering.

episodes.title: The Family Birchwood
episodes.description: 1940s Florida: Theodosia Birchwood's father, Mordechai, returns from his treasure hunting expedition with a cursed sarcophagus; despite his warning, she opens the relic and finds a ring that takes her into a dreamworld haunted by the Nightmare Man.

Oklahoma, 1978: Obsessed with Dexter Venito, Tammy convinces her friends to break into the abandoned Darkland park; during a wild night, she dares them to perform a ritual in Dexter's name, unaware she holds the key to his return.

episodes.title: Reanimated
episodes.description: Ollie escapes and returns to the Darkland bunker to awaken Dexter from a cryogenic chamber; now, Dexter controls all the elements needed to open a portal to the Erendu; Fairbanks, Elsa and Theodosia infiltrate the park and confront Dexter.

titles.title: The Unknown Girl
titles.description: Jenny, a talented doctor, refuses to open the door of her practice to a mysterious late-night caller. The next morning, she learns that the caller was a girl who has been found dead, and the police have no way of identifying her. Shocked and guilt-stricken by the news, Jenny resolves to discover the name of the girl so she will not be buried anonymously and to ensure she doesn't disappear as if she had never lived.

titles.title: The Warlords
titles.description: China is torn apart by civil war, and in the chaos three men emerge who might bring the country back from the brink: Gen. Pang (Jet Li) and a pair of bandits (Takeshi Kaneshiro, Andy Lau). Pang is the only survivor from a violent clash with rebels and -- after being taken in by a beautiful woman (Jinglei Xu) -- saves the life of one of the bandits. Soon the three men are blood brothers, and they embark on a quest to rid their land of rebels once and for all.

titles.title: The Wave
titles.description: A Norwegian geologist (Kristoffer Joner) and his family (Ane Dahl Torp, Jonas Hoff Oftebro) fight for survival when a massive landslide causes a 250-foot tidal wave.

titles.title: The White Queen
titles.description: War ravages England in 1464 during a blood feud between the House of York and the House of Lancaster over who is the country's true king. Young Edward IV, heir to the House of York, is crowned king with help from master manipulator Lord Warwick, known as "The Kingmaker," who has a plan to control the throne. But that plan comes crashing down when Edward falls in love with Lancastrian commoner Elizabeth Woodville. A violent struggle for the crown ensues between Woodville, adversary Margaret Beaufort and Anne Neville, a pawn in her father's power game.

episodes.title: In Love With the King
episodes.description: The romance between Lancastrian commoner Elizabeth Woodville and Yorkist King Edward IV leads to a secret wedding and a new queen of England; two female rivals for the crown vow to take the queen down.

titles.title: The Windigo
titles.description: A Native American teenager and his grandmother resurrect an ancient demon to protect their family from backwoods meth dealers. However, they soon discover that the creature's lust for killing can't be controlled.

titles.title: The Witches of Eastwick
titles.description: Three small-town friends, Alexandra (Cher), Jane (Susan Sarandon) and Sukie (Michelle Pfeiffer), each having lost the man in their lives, are feeling unfulfilled -- until a furtive stranger, Daryl Van Horne (Jack Nicholson), arrives and begins courting each of them in turn. Eventually, Daryl tells them that they are witches. But as the three friends spend more time at his mansion, enjoying themselves and learning about their powers, they begin to worry about Daryl's ultimate intentions.

titles.title: The Witches of Hollywood
titles.description: Exploring the archetype of the witch in Hollywood cinema from the 1930s to the present and how it is linked to the social history of female power.

titles.title: The Witching Hour
titles.description: The investigators of Argos Paranormal investigate locations that the locals fear.

episodes.title: Belle Grove Plantation, Port Conway
episodes.description: The team investigates Belle Grove Plantation, the birthplace of the 4th President of the U.S.

episodes.title: The Graffiti House
episodes.description: The team travels to Brandy Station, Virginia to spend the night in the Graffiti House.

episodes.title: Occoquan Inn
episodes.description: The team travels to Occoquan, Virginia to conduct an overnight investigation at the Occoquan Inn.

episodes.title: Occoquan Inn
episodes.description: A team of paranormal investigators spends the night at a haunted inn to uncover the truth behind a mysterious murder.

episodes.title: The Old Warrenton Jail
episodes.description: The team conducts an overnight investigation inside the Old Warrenton Jail Museum.

episodes.title: Retun to Fleetwood Church
episodes.description: Argos Paranormal investigates a haunted church in Virginia, uncovering secrets and disturbances caused by nearby construction.

episodes.title: Eisenhower Bridge
episodes.description: Argos Paranormal concludes their three-part Gettysburg investigation by returning to Eisenhower Bridge, also known as Suicide Bridge, two years after a non-human entity had physically attacked a member of the team.

episodes.title: Fleetwood Church
episodes.description: Argos Paranormal returns to Brandy Station, VA, to investigate the hauntings inside the Fleetwood Church, a historical icon of both Culpeper County and the Brandy Station community.

episodes.title: Sachs Bridge
episodes.description: Argos Paranormal's investigation of Gettysburg's most haunted locations continues as the team investigates the hauntings of Sachs Bridge and the local legend regarding The Witch's Tree!

episodes.title: The Cabin on 360
episodes.description: Argos Paranormal investigates The Cabin on 360 in Mechanicsville, Virginia.

episodes.title: The Grove
episodes.description: In the season 3 premiere of The Witching Hour, our team along with local paranormal investigators in the Gettysburg region investigate one of Gettysburg's most notorious sites for discovering paranormal anomalies, The Grove.

episodes.title: The Lord Baltimore Hotel
episodes.description: The teams conduct an overnight investigation inside the Lord Baltimore Hotel.

episodes.title: York's Underground City
episodes.description: Argos Paranormal and guest investigators, Portsmouth Paranormal Society, travel to York, Pennsylvania, to investigate an abandoned morgue and an old underground speakeasy that was also the site of a mob headquarters and a brothel.

titles.title: The Witching Hour
titles.description: Argos Paranormal's investigators go where the locals fear.

episodes.title: Havre De Grace Opera House
episodes.description: Lecture by Bill Dedman.

titles.title: The World's Fastest Indian
titles.description: New Zealander Burt Munro spent years perfecting his classic Indian motorcycle. The year is 1967, and Burt takes his machine to Utah's salt flats, where he attempts the impossible, using his dream bike to set a new world's record for speed. Based on a true story, the record Munro set more than three decades ago still has not been broken to this day.

titles.title: The Wrecking Crew
titles.description: The son of guitarist Tommy Tedesco pays tribute to his late father and a core group of studio musicians who played on some of the biggest hits of the 1960s and '70s, including "California Girls" and "Mrs. Robinson."

titles.title: This Is GWAR
titles.description: Filmmaker Scott Barber follows the heavy metal band GWAR, through its early days coming up through the late '80s to near-commercial success, including dark times and triumph over adversity.

titles.title: Three Women
titles.description: Writer Gia convinces three women to tell her their stories; entrepreneur Sloane, homemaker Lina and student Maggie are on a crash course to radically overturn their lives.

episodes.title: Three Women
episodes.description: Grieving writer Gia decides to write a book about women's desire; she interviews entrepreneur Sloane, homemaker Lina and student Maggie as they overturn their lives.

titles.title: Tiger House
titles.description: A young gymnast (Kaya Scodelario) battles a group of bank robbers at the home of her boyfriend.

titles.title: Timecrimes
titles.description: Nacho Vigalondo's time-travel thriller opens with Hector spying on a beautiful woman undressing in the woods near his property. Investigating, he finds her assaulted and he in turn is attacked by a man whose head is swathed in bandages. Fleeing, Hector encounters a scientific facility where a scientist persuades him to hide in a time machine. Traveling back in time just a few hours, he observes himself.

titles.title: Titan Find
titles.description: An alien-thing stalks corporate rivals from U.S. and German spaceships on one of Saturn's moons.

titles.title: Toxic Crusaders
titles.description: After a dip in toxic waste, a nerd develops superpowers and uses them to fight environmental crime.

episodes.title: The Making of Toxie
episodes.description: After falling into a barrel of toxic waste left behind by evil alien mastermind Dr. Killemoff, nerdish Melvin mutates into superhuman Toxie.

episodes.title: This Spud's for You
episodes.description: Toxie and his mutant friends have to stop people from eating junk food made with a chemical that turns them old and senile.

episodes.title: Club Fred
episodes.description: Dr. Killemoff lures Toxie and his friends to a fake island resort; a humanoid mutant dog wants to join the Toxic Crusaders.

episodes.title: Tree Troubles
episodes.description: Dr. Killemoff takes over the Crusaders' factory so he can make smog in a can.

episodes.title: The Pollution Solution
episodes.description: Dr. Killemoff plans to use the people of Tromaville to help him create more smog.

episodes.title: A Site for Sore Eyes
episodes.description: The Smogulan scientists find a large pool of high smogtane crude that is perfect for their evil plans, but it's underneath the Crusaders' home base.

episodes.title: Mr Earth-Superhero
episodes.description: A mysterious stranger arrives; Dr. Killemoff plans to put remotely activated smog inducers in every house in Tromaville.

episodes.title: Toxie Ties the Knot
episodes.description: Princess Gerba of Smogula gives Toxie a choice: marry her or her father Czar Zosta will destroy the earth.

episodes.title: Invasion of the Biddy Snatchers
episodes.description: New Smogulan boss General Garbage wants to clone old ladies, but Dr. Killemoff would rather figure out how to get rid of him.

episodes.title: The Snail Must Go Through
episodes.description: A race car driver gets superpowers after he drives off a bridge and lands on a boat carrying a load of snails.

episodes.title: Nab That Toxie Cab
episodes.description: The Crusaders build a cab, unaware that Dr. Killemoff and the mayor are scheming against them.

episodes.title: Still Crazy After All These Shears
episodes.description: The citizens of Tromaville don't know that the seeds the mayor wants them to plant around the city will grow into vicious vines designed by Dr. Killemoff.

episodes.title: That's No Villain, That's My Mom
episodes.description: Dr. Killemoff hires a new secretary, not knowing she is Toxie's mother.

titles.title: Trishna
titles.description: A poor woman's (Freida Pinto) romance with the privileged son (Riz Ahmed) of a hotel owner (Roshan Seth) leads to tragedy.

titles.title: Trollhunter
titles.description: While investigating reports of illegal poaching, three student filmmakers encounter a man (Otto Jespersen) who slays trolls for the Norwegian government.

titles.title: TURN: Washington's Spies
titles.description: After scoring a hit with a series set in the 1960s, AMC travels much further back in time for "TURN: Washington's Spies," a Revolutionary War-era drama based on the same-named Alexander Rose novel. The series goes beyond the battlefront to a conflict involving everyday men and women, taking place in a cryptic world of double agents, covert operations and code-breaking. It revolves around Abe Woodhull, a young farmer torn between loyalty to his Tory background and respect for those who fight for the Patriot cause. Living on British-occupied Long Island, Abe joins a group of his childhood friends to form what becomes known as the Culper Ring, a spy network charged with sniffing out British military strategy. Under the direction of Gen. Washington, Abe and his fellow agents help turn the war to the Continentals' favor, and their daring efforts ultimately serve as the foundation for modern espionage.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: America's first spy ring; in the early years of the Revolutionary War, a Long Island farmer is recruited to spy on the British army.

episodes.title: Who by Fire
episodes.description: To prevent Anna being blamed for the murder of a Royal Officer, Abe must find the culprit; Ben and Caleb interrogate Simcoe.

episodes.title: Of Cabbages and Kings
episodes.description: Ben is betrayed by his own militia while on the run from the British; Abe and Richard travel to New York; Mary confronts Anna.

episodes.title: Eternity How Long
episodes.description: Abe and Richard grapple with orders to dig up gravestones; Ben and Caleb try to get their intelligence to General Washington.

episodes.title: Epiphany
episodes.description: Celeb and Ben follow mysterious orders; Washington's army crosses into enemy territory.

episodes.title: Mr. Culpeper
episodes.description: Abe is ambushed by a desperate patriot while on the way to New York; Ben is charged with the task of creating a spy.

episodes.title: Mercy Moment Murder Measure
episodes.description: An old threat returns to Setauket; Abe tries to protect Anna; Rogers travels to a prison ship in search of a mysterious man.

episodes.title: Challenge
episodes.description: Anna searches for intelligence at Andre's exclusive gentleman's party.

episodes.title: Against Thy Neighbor
episodes.description: Simcoe plans to weed out rebel conspirators in Setauket through a political witch hunt; Ben is assigned to a secret mission.

episodes.title: The Battle of Setauket
episodes.description: Mary struggles with the knowledge that Abe is a spy for the rebels; Ben and Caleb lead a raid on Setauket.

episodes.title: Thoughts of a Free Man
episodes.description: A London spy sends an urgent message to America; Mary interferes when Abe tries to restart the spy ring; Benedict Arnold arrives in camp.

episodes.title: Hard Boiled
episodes.description: Abe gathers intelligence in New York; Simcoe escapes punishment; John Andre meets Peggy Shippen at a Philadelphia ball.

episodes.title: False Flag
episodes.description: Ben sets out to catch a traitor in camp; Richard learns that Abe is conspiring with Maj. Hewlett; Caleb and Robert Rogers collide.

episodes.title: Men of Blood
episodes.description: Abe tries to recruit a new agent; Caleb and Rogers race to hunt down intelligence from London; Andre's history is exposed.

episodes.title: Sealed Fate
episodes.description: Abe makes one last effort to recruit a spy inside New York; Ben must determine who is a double agent.

episodes.title: Houses Divided
episodes.description: Mary begs Richard to help get Abe free from prison; Anna tries to seduce Simcoe; Ben and Caleb rescue Hewlett.

episodes.title: Valley Forge
episodes.description: Washington faces a personal crisis with help from his slave, Billy Lee; Abe tries to maintain his cover while in prison.

episodes.title: Providence
episodes.description: Caleb sails into New York Harbor; France makes an alliance with the American Patriots; Andre and Peggy plan to elope.

episodes.title: Gunpowder, Treason, and Plot
episodes.description: Abe plots Major Hewlett's assassination; Ben fights at the Battle of Monmouth; Benedict Arnold longs for Peggy.

titles.title: Two Days One Night
titles.description: A factory worker (Marion Cotillard) has just one weekend to convince her colleagues to give up their bonuses so that she can keep her job.

titles.title: Two Lovers
titles.description: Following a broken engagement, sometime photographer Leonard Kraditor (Joaquin Phoenix) moves in with his parents in Brighton Beach. He soon becomes involved with Sandra (Vinessa Shaw), an honest and sensible young woman. They appear to be a perfect match, then Michelle (Gwyneth Paltrow) enters the picture. Beautiful but manipulative, she wraps him around her finger, even though she has a rich, married boyfriend.

titles.title: UFOs: Best Evidence Ever Caught on Camera
titles.description: Analyses by NASA authorities and UFO researchers accompany compelling video and film footage of flying saucers.

titles.title: Ugliest House on the Block
titles.description: Home makeover show.

episodes.title: Lisa's House
episodes.description: A modeling agent's home receives a makeover.

episodes.title: Mama Dukes
episodes.description: The design team confronts 30 years of neglect to transform Mama Dukes' house into something the whole street can be proud of.

episodes.title: The Bailey Family
episodes.description: The Baileys have failed to maintain their house due to medical setbacks and their time spent raising grandchildren and volunteering for multiple organizations.

episodes.title: The Izquierdos
episodes.description: The neighbors pitch in with the design team to turn an eyesore into something that the whole neighborhood can be proud of.

episodes.title: The McGuire Family
episodes.description: After 30 years and three kids, the McGuire home has become the ugliest house on the block.

episodes.title: The Rivas Family
episodes.description: With the help of a professional design team, the neighborhood is coming together to make the Rivas house a perfect visual masterpiece for their storybook, tree-lined road.

titles.title: Ultra City Smiths
titles.description: The creators of "Robot Chicken" present a mystery series using their unique animation style. The all-star cast of voice actors includes Julian Barratt, Terry O'Quinn, Luis Guzmán, Tim Heidecker, Sunita Mani, Tim Meadows, Bebe Neuwirth, John C. Reilly, Dax Shepard, Da'Vine Joy Randolph, Debra Winger, Alia Shawkat and Kurtwood Smith. The plot involves two detectives who must contend with dangerous corruption as they investigate the mysterious disappearance of the last honest politician in their dark city; a group of unlikely suspects emerges -- each with the last name of Smith.

episodes.title: Ultra City, She Don't Care
episodes.description: Things get heavy during Detective David Mills' first day on the job in Ultra City; Carpenter K. Smith, the last honest politician in the dark city, goes out for a pack of cigarettes and disappears.

episodes.title: The King of the Night
episodes.description: Mills and Gail try to piece together the movements of the missing mayoral candidate, employing extraordinarily specific detective work along the way; Carpenter K. Smith was supposed to make Ultra City a gentler place.

episodes.title: Hot Clues
episodes.description: Questions arise about the mayor openly conspiring with a major crime lord and a police captain at the feet of strippers; Gail faces a demotion; Trish's secret goes public; Mills brings his new partner to the crime scene to search for hot clues.

episodes.title: The Little Baby Hand Pinky Grip Thing
episodes.description: Mills and Nico start to connect the dots; Gail tries to reach her son who is quickly slipping away; Congressman Chris Pecker gives a lesson in the history of artistic nudes; Street Hustler Boy risks it all for love.

episodes.title: O-o-h Child
episodes.description: Dire circumstances bring both Mills and Gail to the hospital; Little Grace learns of the damage she's caused; a devastating shift of allegiance may derail Donella's campaign just as it's gaining traction.

episodes.title: Family of Orphans
episodes.description: A darkness comes down on Ultra City; now alone, Mills must figure it out and stop it.

titles.title: Unanswered Prayers
titles.description: A happily married father (Eric Close) encounters the woman (Mädchen Amick) of his high-school fantasies.

titles.title: Unit 262
titles.description: The FBI joins forces with Unit 262, a specialized Israeli fighting force, to take on an international crime boss who's trafficking nuclear weapons.

titles.title: V/H/S/94
titles.description: A mysterious VHS tape reveals a sinister cult that has prerecorded material that uncovers a horrifying conspiracy.

titles.title: Valleyheart
titles.description: In the middle of the hot California summer, Jane Francis must decide how far she's willing to go to help her small-time criminal brother get out of a jam with the Russian mob.

titles.title: Vampire at Midnight
titles.description: A Los Angeles police detective (Jason Williams) hunts a hypnotic killer whose victims are drained of blood.

titles.title: VHS
titles.description: Hired to steal a rare VHS tape from a remote house, a ragtag band of crooks finds a dead body, old TVs and a lot of cryptic footage.

titles.title: Viceroy's House
titles.description: In 1947, British statesman Lord Mountbatten serves as India's last Viceroy and is charged with handing India back to its people.

titles.title: Vida
titles.description: "Vida" is a drama series about two Mexican-American siblings from East Los Angeles. Party girl Lyn lives a carefree life in the Bay Area. She couldn't be more different than, or distanced from, her sister Emma, with whom she has no relationship. A death in their family forces them to return to their old stomping grounds, where they confront long-repressed feelings and learn the surprising truth about their mother's identity.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.description: Circumstances force estranged sisters Lyn and Emma to return to their old neighborhood, where they are confronted by their past and surprised by family revelations.

titles.title: Waiting to Exhale
titles.description: Navigating through careers, family and romance, four friends bond over the shortcomings in their love lives -- namely, the scarcity of good men. Both as the "other woman," Savannah (Whitney Houston) and Robin (Lela Rochon) carry on relationships with married men, each believing their lovers will leave their wives for them. On the flip side, Bernadine (Angela Bassett) ends up alone when her husband divorces her for his mistress. Meanwhile, Gloria (Loretta Devine) finds love with a new neighbor.

titles.title: We Are the Best!
titles.description: Three rebellious teenagers form an all-girl punk band in the 1980s Stockholm.

titles.title: We Are X
titles.description: Glam rock band X Japan ignited a musical revolution in Japan during the late 1980s. Twenty years after disbanding, Yoshiki X, the leader of the band, wrestles with physical and spiritual demons to bring the band's music to the world.

titles.title: We Need to Talk About Kevin
titles.description: Eva Khatchadourian is a travel writer/publisher who gives up her beloved freedom and Bohemian lifestyle to have a child with her husband, Franklin. Pregnancy does not seem to agree with Eva, but what's worse, when she does give birth to a baby boy named Kevin, she can't seem to bond with him. When Kevin grows from a fussy, demanding toddler into a sociopathic teen, Eva is forced to deal with the aftermath of her son's horrific act.

titles.title: We Were the Mulvaneys
titles.description: The Mulvaneys, a seemingly perfect family, are nearly destroyed after daughter Marianne is raped at the school prom. Patriarch Michael descends into alcoholism afterward, while mother Corinne tries to deny the incident happened. As her relationship with her parents becomes cold and distant, Marianne is sent away to a relative's home, and her once-pristine reputation is left to be dragged through the mud until one of her brothers takes action.

titles.title: Werewolves Within
titles.description: A snowstorm traps town residents together inside the local inn, where newly arrived forest ranger Finn and postal worker Cecily must try to keep the peace and uncover the truth behind a mysterious creature that has begun terrorizing the community.

titles.title: West of Thunder
titles.description: Henry Seed, a mysterious stranger, visits a town in South Dakota in 1899, where atrocities are committed against the Lakota people. Little Thunder, the tribe's spiritual leader, considers whether to seek revenge or to remain true to Lakota values.

titles.title: What's Love Got to Do With It
titles.description: Based on the life of the legendary soul singer, Tina Turner (Angela Bassett) -- born Anna Mae Bullock -- discovers her love of singing in her Tennessee church choir. She moves to St. Louis to pursue a career, and there she meets the charismatic Ike Turner (Laurence Fishburne), who rechristens her Tina and offers to help her succeed. As a musical team, Ike and Tina take the charts by storm. But as his physical abuse worsens, Tina has to make the tough decision to leave Ike and set out on her own.

titles.title: When a Stranger Calls
titles.description: A retired police detective hunts a deranged British seaman out to re-create a babysitter's horror.

titles.title: When the Screaming Starts
titles.description: When Norman Graysmith is invited to the home of aspiring serial killer Aidan Mendle, he thinks he's found the subject of a documentary that will save his failing career.

titles.title: White Bird in a Blizzard
titles.description: A teenager (Shailene Woodley) relishes her newfound freedom after her disturbed mother (Eva Green) vanishes, but the strange facts of the disappearance soon begin to haunt her.

titles.title: White God
titles.description: Failing in his efforts to find his beloved owner (Zsófia Psotta), an abandoned dog eventually joins a canine revolt against their human abusers.

titles.title: Who Is Clark Rockefeller?
titles.description: German con artist Christian Karl Gerhartsreiter (Eric McCormack) poses as a member of the Rockefeller family.

titles.title: Whose Streets?
titles.description: An account of the Ferguson uprising as told by the people who lived it. The filmmakers look at how the killing of 18-year-old Michael Brown inspired a community to fight back and sparked a global movement.

titles.title: Wildlife
titles.description: Fourteen-year-old Joe is the only child of Jeanette and Jerry -- a housewife and a golf pro -- in a small town in the 1960s Montana. Nearby, an uncontrolled forest fire rages close to the Canadian border, and when Jerry loses his job -- and his sense of purpose -- he decides to join the cause of fighting the fire, leaving his wife and son to fend for themselves. Suddenly forced into the role of an adult, Joe witnesses his mother's struggle as she tries to keep her head above water.

titles.title: Witchboard
titles.description: When Jim (Todd Allen) and Linda (Tawny Kitaen) decide to throw a party, Linda's ex-boyfriend -- and Jim's ex-friend -- Brandon (Stephen Nichols) brings out a Ouija board to contact a pleasant, childish spirit named David with whom he communicates often. Apparently, the lines get crossed, because they instead reach across the supernatural divide to the decidedly less pleasant Malfeitor, who uses his connection to the world of the living to wreak havoc and terrify his new acquaintances.

titles.title: Witchery
titles.description: A photographer and others are stranded at a Massachusetts island hotel which is haunted by a woman in black.

titles.title: Wolves
titles.description: Anthony is a standout player on his Manhattan high school's basketball team with seemingly everything going for him: a killer three-point shot, a loving girlfriend, and a chance at a scholarship to Cornell. But Anthony's dreams of playing college ball are jeopardized by his volatile father, a hard-drinking writer whose compulsive gambling threatens to derail the lives of both his wife and son.

titles.title: Woman at War
titles.description: Halla is a 50-year-old environmental activist who crusades against the local aluminum industry in Iceland. As her actions grow bolder, her life changes in the blink of an eye when she's finally granted permission to adopt a girl from Ukraine.

titles.title: Woman Thou Art Loosed
titles.description: When Michelle is only 12 years old, she is raped by Reggie, the boyfriend of her mother. When her mother does not believe her accusations, Michelle runs away and begins a downward spiral that includes drugs and prostitution, eventually landing in prison. There she hears of Bishop T.D. Jakes (playing himself), a preacher who works with women like her. Jakes takes an interest in Michelle's case and visits her.

titles.title: World's Greatest Dad
titles.description: When the son of high school English teacher Lance Clayton accidentally kills himself, Clayton writes a fake suicide note to evade scandal. At first uninterested in the death, the school is taken by the letter after it is published in the school paper. Hoping to claim the literary renown he has always wanted, Lance writes a diary, too. Fame and intrigue follow and Lance receives the attention he always wished for, but finds keeping his cool might be easier written than done.

titles.title: Would You Rather
titles.description: Iris (Brittany Snow) and seven other desperate people become trapped in Shepard's (Jeffrey Combs) mansion. Shepard forces them to play a sadistic game for a large sum of money -- but the dilemmas become increasingly deadly.

titles.title: Xterminator and the AI Apocalypse
titles.description: The universe's most dangerous outlaw war machine, Xterminator, is finally apprehended while pulling an intergalactic bank heist.

titles.title: You're All Gonna Die
titles.description: A group of social justice warriors, in a quest to free an innocent man, search an abandoned campground for a serial killer. All of them is picked off one by one until it comes down to last person against the killer.

titles.title: Your Sister's Sister
titles.description: A man (Mark Duplass) falls into bed with his best friend's (Emily Blunt) sister (Rosemarie DeWitt), leading to an unexpected love triangle when his friend arrives the next day.

titles.title: Zappa
titles.description: An in-depth exploration of Frank Zappa's private life and his rich, often controversial musical career. Featuring unfettered access to the Zappa vault and a deep cache of archival footage.

titles.title: Zombie
titles.description: A New York reporter (Ian McCulloch) follows a woman (Tisa Farrow) to an island where a doctor (Richard Johnson) faces an epidemic of the undead.

titles.title: Zombie at 17
titles.description: A 17-year-old girl begins exhibiting strange symptoms and realizes she's turning into a zombie. Desperate to find a cure, she turns to a loner who claims to be an expert in all things paranormal.
